companies.styleNote: The promoter Ankur Shah is Managing Director and runs the business; his wife Preyal Shah is the non-executive Chairperson (not listed as an executive). Promoters own about 60%.

people.name: Ankur Ashwin Shah
people.relation: Promoter; husband of the Chairperson Preyal Ankur Shah
people.stake: 36.52% (54,53,890 shares, March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 59.96%
people.bio: Ankur Shah holds a Bachelor of Engineering (Production) from the University of Bombay. Before this company his last job was at Godrej & Boyce, according to the FY26 annual report. He has about 25 years of experience in steel work, including smelting, rolling, drawing and heat treatment. He has been on the board since the company was set up in September 2013, became Managing Director in April 2015 and was re-appointed in 2021 and again in 2026. He runs the overall business and led its expansion from shipbuilding steel into naval products, composites and underwater vehicles. He was paid ₹1.2cr in FY26, and the AGM is asked to allow up to ₹17.5 lakh a month.

people.name: Harshadsinh Mahida
people.since: June 2026 (director); earlier senior manager, defence production
people.bio: Harshadsinh Mahida is a mechanical engineer with more than 29 years of experience. He has run multi-site operations covering pipes and tooling, the CNC shop, the machine shop, maintenance and production planning. Before joining the board he was Senior Manager (Operations) in the company's defence manufacturing unit. The board made him a whole-time director on 17 June 2026 for five years, filling the gap left by the death of Sandeep Kadam, subject to shareholder approval. He is not related to any director.

people.name: Manish Shah
people.bio: Manish Shah is a chartered accountant (ICAI) and a Certified Public Accountant (Australia). He has over 28 years of experience in finance leadership at large organisations in India, Europe, the USA and Australia, including as Finance Transformation Leader at Tata Consultancy Services. His stated strengths are profit improvement, cost control and process change. He became CFO on 11 April 2026, after Piyush Patel resigned on 7 April 2026.

people.name: Ajinkya Gaikwad
people.bio: The FY26 annual report names Ajinkya Gaikwad as CEO of the composite division in its senior-management page. Elsewhere in the same report he appears as head of product development and received stock options in FY26. No details of his education or earlier career are given.

people.name: Mayur Chaudhari
people.bio: Mayur Chaudhari has a bachelor's degree in veterinary science and animal husbandry from Sardarkrushinagar Dantiwada Agricultural University. He has about 13 years of experience, with NDDB Dairy Services and Banas Dairy (part of Amul). He joined as CEO of the company's dairy-equipment division on 1 April 2026, as senior management.

companies.changes: Whole-time Director Sandeep Kadam died on 27 March 2026. CFO Piyush Patel resigned on 7 April 2026; Manish Shah became CFO on 11 April 2026. Harshadsinh Mahida joined the board as whole-time director on 17 June 2026. Company Secretary Gunjan Bhagtani resigned on 14 August 2026; no successor had been announced by late September.

companies.styleNote: The founding promoters (the Chitrakar family) own only about 6.5% and do not run the business; co-founder P. A. Chitrakar sits on the board as a non-executive director. The company is run by long-serving professional managers. None of the directors are related to each other.

people.name: Dr. M. V. Reddy
people.role: Joint Managing Director; Managing Director from 1 October 2026
people.bio: M. V. Reddy is an electronics engineering graduate with an MBA. He joined Astra in February 1998 from Arm Limited and has about 34 years of experience in marketing and business operations for defence, space and telecom customers in India and abroad. He joined the board in April 2013 and has been Joint Managing Director, looking after marketing and business. On 10 August 2026 the board re-designated him Managing Director from 1 October 2026, for the rest of his term to April 2028, subject to shareholder approval. He was paid ₹3.38cr in FY26.

people.name: Atim Kabra
people.bio: Atim Kabra holds an honours degree in economics from Hindu College, Delhi University, and a master's in management studies from NMIMS, Mumbai. He spent over three decades in global financial markets, with senior roles at ABN AMRO Bank and ANZ Grindlays Bank; at ABN AMRO in New York he set up the subcontinent equity sales desk. He then founded Frontline Strategy, which advises two Mauritius-based India private-equity funds, and lived in the US and Singapore for many years. He joined Astra's board as a non-executive director in 2019 and became a whole-time director in January 2023, running strategy, new product lines, partnerships and investor relations. He is also a director of Indo Rama Synthetics and was paid ₹1.31cr in FY26.

people.name: Srinivasarao Devathi
people.bio: Srinivasarao Devathi is a chartered accountant with over 22 years of experience in finance and accounts, in senior roles at other companies, according to the company's February 2026 filing. He became CFO on 12 February 2026, replacing Rahul Rungta, who moved to the space subsidiary Astra Space Technologies. The filing does not name his earlier employers.

people.name: T. Anjaneyulu
people.bio: T. Anjaneyulu is the Company Secretary and a general manager, and is one of the company's key managerial personnel. The annual report gives no further details of his background.

companies.changes: Managing Director S. Gurunatha Reddy (with the company since 1993) chose not to continue and leaves on 30 September 2026, with a ₹1.36cr payment for the rest of his term; M. V. Reddy takes over as MD on 1 October 2026. CFO Rahul Rungta moved to the space subsidiary in February 2026; Srinivasarao Devathi replaced him.

companies.styleNote: Founder S. Rangarajan is Chairman and Managing Director, and his wife Rekha Murthy Rangarajan is a whole-time director. The promoter family owns 42.4%. Day-to-day operations, technology and finance are run by long-serving insiders who joined in 1989–2000.

people.name: Srinivasagopalan Rangarajan
people.since: Founder; with the business since 1985, company incorporated 1998
people.relation: Founder; husband of Whole-time Director Rekha Murthy Rangarajan
people.stake: 22.80% (1,27,65,315 shares, March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter family together 42.40%
people.bio: S. Rangarajan holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from A.C. College of Technology, University of Madras, and a master's in science from IIT Madras. He has over three decades of experience in business development, corporate affairs, finance and marketing, and has led the business since its start; the annual report dates his employment from March 1985. He built Data Patterns into a maker of defence electronics, including the BrahMos launch and fire-control system, radars and electronic-warfare systems. He was the first defence entrepreneur on the Hurun India Rich List (2022). He was re-appointed CMD in August 2025 and was paid ₹1.26cr in FY26.

people.name: Rekha Murthy Rangarajan
people.relation: Promoter; wife of the Chairman & MD
people.bio: Rekha Murthy Rangarajan holds a BA in economics, English and psychology from Bangalore University and an MA in applied psychology from Madras University. Before Data Patterns she worked at Sterling Computers. She has been with the company since it was set up and has over two decades of experience in administration, facilities, human resources, process engineering and special projects. She also leads the company's sustainability (BRSR) work. She was re-appointed in August 2025 and was paid ₹1.02cr in FY26.

people.name: Vijay Ananth K
people.role: Whole-time Director, Chief Operating Officer & Chief Information Security Officer
people.since: Joined 1998; COO since 2016; director since February 2022
people.bio: Vijay Ananth holds a bachelor's in computer science from Manonmaniam Sundaranar University and a master's in computer applications from the University of Madras. He joined the group in September 1998 as a software engineering trainee and rose through software and IT support to head delivery (2000) and operations (2008). He has been Chief Operating Officer since 2016 and Chief Information Security Officer since 2011. He joined the board in February 2022, and the board has proposed re-appointing him for five years from July 2026. He was paid ₹1.02cr in FY26.

people.name: Desinguraja Parthasarathy (Desingurajan P)
people.bio: Desingurajan P holds a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from the University of Madras. He joined in December 1989 as an R&D engineer, became manager of hardware design in 1996, general manager of technical operations in 2002 and Chief Technical Officer in 2004. He has about 32 years of experience in product development and is one of the company's highest-paid employees (₹1.03cr in FY26).

people.name: Venkatachalam Venkata Subramanian
people.bio: V. V. Subramanian holds a commerce degree from Madurai Kamaraj University and is a fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He joined in November 2000 as finance manager and was promoted to general manager, finance, in April 2019. He has over two decades of experience in finance and is now the Chief Financial Officer, signing the FY26 accounts with the CMD.

people.name: Thomas Mathuram Susikaran
people.bio: Thomas Mathuram holds a bachelor's in electrical and electronics engineering from Madurai Kamaraj University and an M.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Madras. He joined in September 2000 as senior marketing manager, became head of rugged military electronics in 2005 and senior vice president of business development in 2019. He has over two decades in business development and marketing and is named by the company as senior management.

people.name: Prakash R
people.bio: Prakash R holds a master's in law (business law) from Tamil Nadu Dr. Ambedkar Law University and a master's in commerce from the University of Madras. He is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and is enrolled with the Bar Council of Tamil Nadu. He has about 10 years of experience in secretarial and legal work, previously at Expleo Solutions, where he handled mergers, a buyback and CSR matters.

companies.changes: No changes in key managerial personnel during FY26. Independent director Sastry Vadlamani left on 9 September 2026 at the end of his term; Mathew Cyriac was re-designated an independent director from July 2026.

companies.styleNote: Promoter P. Srinivas Reddy is Managing Director, and two more promoter-family members (A. Praveen Kumar Reddy and his relative Anushman Reddy) are executive directors. A relative of the MD, Rohith Loka Reddy, is a non-executive director. The board is chaired by an independent director. The promoter group, spread across several related families, owns about 30%. A hired CFO, COO and CCO run finance, operations and sales.

people.name: Parvat Srinivas Reddy
people.relation: Promoter; related to Non-executive Director Rohith Loka Reddy
people.stake: 3.88% (11,92,903 shares, March 2026, after selling 2,00,000 in FY26; FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 30.4%
people.bio: P. Srinivas Reddy holds a bachelor's in industrial engineering from the University of Mysore and a master's in industrial engineering from Louisiana Tech University. He has over 33 years of experience in clean energy, aerospace and defence. He joined the board in March 2015 and became Managing Director in September 2020, with overall charge of the company. He is also a non-executive director of Ravileela Granites. He was paid ₹3.10cr in FY26.

people.name: Akepati Praveen Kumar Reddy
people.since: With the company 20+ years; director since December 2020
people.relation: Promoter group; related to Whole-time Director Anushman Reddy
people.bio: Praveen Kumar Reddy is an engineering graduate of Andhra University with over 27 years of industry experience. He has been with MTAR for more than 20 years and was earlier a vice president in the company, so he knows its operations well; the board lists his skills as nuclear and conventional systems design and engineering. He joined the board in December 2020 and became a whole-time director in August 2022, re-appointed for three years from August 2025. He was paid ₹0.99cr in FY26.

people.name: Anushman Reddy Mitta
people.role: Whole-time (Executive) Director; head of exports and supply chain
people.relation: Promoter group; related to Whole-time Director A. Praveen Kumar Reddy
people.bio: Anushman Reddy holds a bachelor's in mechanical engineering from JNTU, an MS in global supply-chain management from the Marshall School of Business (University of Southern California) and an executive postgraduate diploma from NMIMS. He worked at AeroVironment before joining MTAR in December 2016 and has about a decade of manufacturing experience. He heads the export division and supply chain, drives the export and defence businesses, and oversees new plants and administration. He joined the board in August 2022, was re-appointed for three years from August 2025, and was paid ₹1.49cr in FY26.

people.name: Gunneswara Rao Pusarla
people.bio: Gunneswara Rao Pusarla is a chartered accountant and cost accountant (CA, CMA). He spent 11 years at Tata Sikorsky Aerospace before joining MTAR as CFO in November 2021, and has about 23 years of finance experience across planning, P&L management, fund raising, accounting and setting up new plants. He runs the company's finances and investor communication and was paid ₹2.12cr in FY26.

people.name: Raja Sheker Bollampally
people.bio: Raja Sheker Bollampally holds a master's in materials science. He joined MTAR as Chief Operating Officer in May 2023 from Ohmium, a hydrogen electrolyser maker, according to the FY26 annual report. He runs operations across the company's Hyderabad plants and was paid ₹1.33cr in FY26.

people.name: Arun Kumar Ojha
people.bio: Arun Ojha holds a B.Tech and an MBA. He has about 25 years of experience in supply chain, business development and manufacturing at Schlumberger, Alstom, L&T and Andritz, and joined from Schlumberger in May 2024. At MTAR he is responsible for business development and supply chains for multinational customers. He was paid ₹1.19cr in FY26.

people.name: Priyanka Agarwal
people.bio: Priyanka Agarwal is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, named as such in the FY26 annual report. The report gives no further details of her background.

companies.changes: No changes in directors or key managerial personnel announced since the FY26 annual report (July 2026).

companies.styleNote: Founder S. Sekhar Vasan is Chairman and Managing Director and co-promoter F. R. Singhvi is an executive director (becoming Executive Vice Chairman). Day-to-day running is being handed to the non-promoter Group CEO B. R. Preetham, who is being made Joint Managing Director from August 2026. None of the directors are related. The promoter group owns about 30%.

people.name: S. Sekhar Vasan (Subramonia Sekhar Vasan)
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 16.47% (1,02,63,164 shares, March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 30.09%
people.bio: Sekhar Vasan holds a B.Tech from IIT Madras and a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Bangalore. He founded Sansera and has been a director since it was incorporated in December 1981. He has over 44 years of experience in technology, engineering, quality and manufacturing. He was re-appointed CMD for five years in 2025 (term to July 2030) and was paid ₹5.48cr in FY26.

people.name: Fatheraj Singhvi (F. R. Singhvi)
people.role: Joint Managing Director; Executive Vice Chairman from 24 August 2026
people.since: Board 1991–2018; Joint MD again since August 2024
people.relation: Promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: F. R. Singhvi is a fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He was a senior partner at the audit firm Singhvi, Dev & Unni from 1981 to 2006 and has over 44 years of experience in finance, audit and strategy in auto and non-auto businesses. He first joined the board in 1991, left in 2018 and returned as Joint Managing Director in August 2024 for five years. From 24 August 2026 he is re-designated Executive Vice Chairman, handing day-to-day work to the Group CEO while keeping lender, JV-partner and investor relationships. He is founder-president of the Aerospace India Association and a past chairman of an ACMA pillar. He was paid ₹5.48cr in FY26.

people.name: B. R. Preetham (Bindiganavile Raghunath Preetham)
people.role: Executive Director & Group CEO; Joint Managing Director & Group CEO from 24 August 2026
people.since: Joined 1992; Group CEO since 2013; director since September 2023
people.relation: Not a promoter
people.bio: B. R. Preetham holds a mechanical engineering degree from Bangalore University and began his career in manufacturing. He joined Sansera in 1992 and worked across quality, manufacturing, marketing, new product development and engineering before becoming CEO in 2013. The company says revenue grew from ₹551cr then to about ₹3,498cr in FY26, and he led the 2021 IPO and the October 2024 QIP. He joined the board in September 2023 (term to September 2028) and is being made Joint Managing Director from August 2026 as part of succession planning. He was paid ₹4.46cr in FY26.

people.name: Hari Krishnan
people.role: Additional Executive Director & CEO, Aerospace, Defence & Semiconductor (ADS) Division
people.bio: Hari Krishnan holds a B.E. (Hons) in mechanical engineering from BITS Pilani. He has over 30 years of leadership experience in forging and auto components. Before Sansera he was CEO of CIE Automotive India's Bill Forge and forging division, Joint Managing Director of Bill Forge, and a director of Apten Forgings. He runs the aerospace, defence and semiconductor division and joined the board on 12 August 2026 for five years, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Vikas Goel
people.bio: Vikas Goel is a chartered accountant. Before Sansera he held finance leadership roles at Ingersoll Rand India, Stanley Black & Decker India and the Weir Group (Weir Minerals India), with experience in turnarounds, M&A and ERP projects, according to his public professional profile. He is one of the company's key managerial personnel and signs the CEO/CFO certificate with the Group CEO.

people.name: Rajesh Kumar Modi
people.role: Chief Legal Officer, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
people.bio: Rajesh Kumar Modi is the Chief Legal Officer, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, and a fellow member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He is one of the company's key managerial personnel. The annual report gives no further details of his background.

companies.changes: Board changes in 2026: Hari Krishnan joined as executive director and ADS division CEO on 12 August 2026. From 24 August 2026, F. R. Singhvi moves from Joint MD to Executive Vice Chairman and B. R. Preetham becomes Joint MD & Group CEO (both subject to AGM approval). Chief Quality Officer Anil Patil resigned in February 2026; Amit Gautam became CTO in November 2025.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Gautam Hari Singhania is Chairman and Managing Director. He also chairs the demerged Raymond Lifestyle and Raymond Realty. No other family member is on the board. The engineering, aerospace and defence businesses are run by hired professionals, including Gautam Maini, whose family's Maini Precision Raymond bought. The promoter group owns 48.87%, mostly through J.K. Investors (Bombay) and other group companies.

people.name: Gautam Hari Singhania
people.since: Director since April 1990; MD since 1999; Chairman since 2000
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late Dr. Vijaypat Singhania (died 28 March 2026)
people.stake: 29 shares in his own name (FY26 annual report); promoter group, mainly through group holding companies, 48.87%
people.bio: Gautam Singhania holds a B.Com from H.R. College of Commerce and Economics, Mumbai. He joined the family's JK Group in 1986 and Raymond's board in 1990, became Managing Director in 1999 and Chairman in 2000. He sold non-core businesses such as synthetics, steel and cement, and has since split Raymond into separately listed lifestyle, real-estate and engineering companies. Raymond Limited is now an engineering, aerospace and defence company. He is also Chairman and MD of Raymond Lifestyle and non-executive Chairman of Raymond Realty.

people.name: Rakesh Tiwary
people.bio: Rakesh Tiwary is a chartered accountant and cost accountant with an MBA. He has over 25 years of finance leadership experience in cement, airports, power, solar, steel and oil. He was CFO at Adani Cement, Adani Airports, Adani Electricity and Adani Solar, and earlier held senior roles at JSW Steel, Reliance Industries and Indian Oil. He became Group CFO on 3 December 2025, when Amit Agarwal moved to the lifestyle business.

people.name: Gautam Maini
people.bio: Gautam Maini holds a B.Com (Hons) from Shri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi. He was Managing Director of Maini Precision Products, the Bengaluru precision-parts and aerospace maker that Raymond bought and merged into its engineering arm in July 2025. He now signs the annual report as Managing Director of the engineering business (JK Maini Precision Technology), which makes auto and industrial parts and aerospace components.

people.name: Sanjeev Sharma
people.role: Joint MD & CEO, Precision Technology and Auto Components Business
people.bio: Sanjeev Sharma is Joint Managing Director and CEO of the precision technology and auto components business, which the FY26 annual report says combines tools and hardware, Ring Plus Aqua and Maini Precision in 15 plants. The annual report gives no details of his education or earlier career.

people.name: Bhanu Prakash Srivastava
people.bio: Bhanu Prakash Srivastava holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT-BHU, Varanasi (1986) and an MBA. He spent about four decades at Bharat Electronics, working on radios, military telecom, C4I systems, radars, sonars, naval fire-control systems and a naval surface-to-air missile project. He was Chairman and Managing Director of BEL from 2022 to 2024. Raymond appointed him CEO of its defence business on 6 July 2026.

people.name: Deepal Shah
people.bio: Deepal Shah is a chartered accountant who has done management programmes at ISB, JBIMS and Kellogg. He has over two decades of experience in business and finance, including CEO and CFO roles in India and abroad, with work on IT transformation, acquisitions and mergers. He has worked at Allcargo, DHL and the ITC group. He joined Raymond on 31 July 2026 to lead group-wide strategy.

people.name: Rakesh Darji
people.bio: Rakesh Darji is the Company Secretary (ICSI membership A13085) and one of the company's three key managerial personnel. The annual report gives no further details of his background.

companies.changes: Group CFO Amit Agarwal moved to the lifestyle business on 2 December 2025; Rakesh Tiwary replaced him. Former BEL chief Bhanu Prakash Srivastava joined as CEO, Defence in July 2026, and Deepal Shah as President, Strategy in July 2026. Former Executive Director Harmohan Sahni moved to run Raymond Realty and stays on this board as a non-executive director.

companies.styleNote: Founder Aravind Melligeri is Executive Chairman and CEO; a long-serving hired MD, Rajeev Kaul, runs day-to-day operations. No other family members are in management. The promoter group owns about 59%, mostly through Aequs Manufacturing Investments and the Melligeri Private Family Foundation; the Foundation is putting in ₹650cr through warrants (EGM on 22 Oct 2026), taking the group to about 61%. A Melligeri promoter foundation has pledged shares to raise a ₹200cr loan.

people.name: Aravind Melligeri
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.stake: 0.15% directly (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 59%, mainly Aequs Manufacturing Investments 43.4% and Melligeri Private Family Foundation 15.0%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in mechanical engineering from NIT Karnataka (then under Mangalore University) and a master's in mechanical engineering from Penn State. Before Aequs he worked at StatDesign Inc. and Penn State's mechanical engineering department, and in 1997 he co-founded QuEST Global, the engineering services firm, where he is still a board member. He started Aequs in 2000 as QuEST Global Manufacturing and built India's first notified precision-engineering SEZ at Belagavi, which won Airbus's Global Innovation Award in 2016. He took Aequs into consumer products in 2016 (toys, then a consumer-goods cluster in 2021). Penn State named him an Outstanding Engineering Alumnus in 2023.

people.name: Rajeev Kaul
people.relation: Called a co-founder by the company; not a promoter and not related to any director
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a bachelor's in mathematics from the University of Delhi. He worked at A.F. Ferguson & Co. and QuEST Global Engineering Services before joining Aequs in April 2007. He ran the company's finances as CFO before becoming Managing Director. He now oversees both the aerospace and the consumer-goods businesses and has over 22 years in finance and aerospace.

people.name: Reenah Joseph
people.bio: Has an MBA in finance from ICFAI Business School and executive programmes at Harvard, IIM Calcutta and ISB. She has nearly two decades in corporate finance, M&A and strategic planning. Before Aequs she was Deputy Group CFO at PDS Ltd, and earlier Chief of Corporate Finance and Investor Relations at Future Group, after starting at Credit Suisse. She joined as CFO on 31 August 2026, two months after the previous CFO left.

people.name: Ravi Guttal
people.role: CTO & Senior Vice President, Engineering and Quality
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in civil engineering from Mangalore University and master's degrees and a PhD from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute. He came from KLE Technological University and joined Aequs in February 2022. He leads process optimisation and R&D, and moved to the consumer subsidiary (ACPPL) in August 2023.

people.name: Mohamed Bouzidi
people.bio: Trained in materials processing at the National Higher School of Mines, Paris. He worked at Aubert & Duval and Snecma Moteurs (now part of Safran) before joining Aequs in April 2020. He leads the aerospace operations of the French subsidiary. His FY25 pay of ₹1.9cr was the highest among the hired managers in the RHP.

people.name: Kapil Mahajan
people.role: Senior Vice President & Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: An XLRI Jamshedpur alumnus and certified coach with about 26 years in HR. He spent over seven years at Tata Advanced Systems and earlier worked at Reliance Communications, Aditya Birla Retail and Pfizer. He joined Aequs in June 2025 to lead people strategy.

people.name: Ravi Hugar
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Karnatak University and an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He has been with Aequs since July 2007 and has over 19 years in governance and compliance. He worked on the company's acquisitions, joint ventures and its IPO.

companies.changes: CFO Dinesh Iyer resigned (letter 24 Mar 2026, effective 30 Jun 2026, personal reasons); Reenah Joseph became CFO on 31 Aug 2026. Board approved a ₹650cr warrant issue to the Melligeri Private Family Foundation in Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by its four founders from the IIT Bombay days, all whole-time directors: Ankit Mehta (CEO), Rahul Singh (engineering), Ashish Bhat (product) and CFO Vipul Joshi, who was named a promoter in Sep 2025. They are not related to each other. Together the promoters own only about 33%, so they do not have outright control; the chairman is an independent director, Srikanth Velamakanni of Fractal. Florintree (8.3%), founded by board member Mathew Cyriac, is the largest outside holder.

people.name: Ankit Mehta
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to other directors
people.bio: Holds a dual degree (B.Tech and M.Tech) in mechanical engineering from IIT Bombay (2005). He co-founded ideaForge in February 2007 and turned a student project into a drone maker ranked third globally in dual-use drones in 2024. Under him the SWITCH drone became the first to get the Army's Fit-for-Military-Use certification from DGQA in 2025. He sits on the government's Drone Task Force and BVLOS and UTM committees, co-chairs FICCI's drone committee, is vice-chairman of the Drone Federation of India and joined NASSCOM's Executive Council in 2025. FY26 pay was ₹1.5cr.

people.name: Rahul Singh
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT Bombay. A co-founder, he has led ideaForge's engineering for nearly two decades, from early prototypes to drones that have flown over 9.5 lakh missions, with a focus on working under jamming and GPS denial. He holds 17 granted patents with 24 more filed as of March 2026. He has won the National Technology Award and spoke at the UN disarmament office's talks on AI in the military in Geneva in June 2026.

people.name: Ashish Bhat
people.role: Vice President – Product Development & Whole-time Director
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in electrical engineering from IIT Bombay (2007). A co-founder, he leads the design, engineering and field-readiness of ideaForge's drones, and his products have won tenders in field trials against US, Israeli and European systems. MIT recognised him in 2010 for building the world's smallest and lightest autonomous drone, and IIT Bombay gave him its Young Alumnus Achiever Award in 2020.

people.name: Vipul Joshi
people.relation: Named a promoter in Sep 2025
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in accounting from Jai Narain Vyas University, Jodhpur, and an MBA in international management from the University of Business & Finance, Switzerland. He joined ideaForge in October 2008 and has led finance since, covering planning, treasury, capital structure and risk. He joined the board as a whole-time director on 6 September 2025, when shareholders also named him a promoter alongside the three founders.

people.name: Vishal Saxena
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in science and technology and a postgraduate qualification in management from the Indian School of Business. He previously worked at Cisco Systems and served in the Indian Army. He leads sales and business development.

people.name: Nilesh Jaywant
people.bio: A law graduate and qualified company secretary. He previously worked at Huhtamaki India. He handles ideaForge's legal, secretarial and compliance work.

companies.changes: Vipul Joshi (CFO) joined the board as whole-time director and was named a promoter from 6 Sep 2025. Non-executive director Ganapathy Subramaniam resigned on 8 Jul 2025. No executive changes found since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: A family company: founder Dr Abburi Vidyasagar is Chairman and MD, his wife Abburi Sarada is whole-time director and CFO, and their son Siddhartha Sagar is executive director for strategy. In July 2026 a long-serving insider, P. Bala Bhaskar Rao, joined the board as Director (Operations), the first non-family executive director. Named family promoters held about 37% at March 2026 (Vidyasagar 16.9%, Siddhartha 8.5%, Sailaja Abburi 6.1%, Sarada 5.5%), plus the family's Lakshmee Foundation, which also receives the company's CSR spending.

people.name: Dr Abburi Vidyasagar
people.relation: Founder; husband of CFO Abburi Sarada and father of Siddhartha Sagar
people.stake: 16.93% (FY26 annual report); named family promoters together about 37%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from JNTU Kakinada, an M.Tech from IIT Kharagpur, an MBA from Osmania University and a PhD from JNTU Hyderabad on e-learning methods. He began as a design engineer at HAL working on avionics, communication and electronic-warfare systems, then was a manager at the Andhra Pradesh State Financial Corporation appraising projects, and a general manager at Satyam Computers. He founded Avantel in the early 1990s and has run it for over three decades, building satellite communication, software-defined radio and HF systems used on Indian Navy ships, submarines, aircraft and helicopters. He also founded the Lakshmee Foundation Trust. FY26 pay was ₹1.37cr.

people.name: Abburi Sarada
people.relation: Wife of the Chairman & MD; mother of Siddhartha Sagar
people.bio: Holds a B.Com from Osmania University, a bachelor's in communication and journalism from Padmavathi University and an MBA from Madurai Kamaraj University. She has been with Avantel since 1992 and has over 30 years in finance and banking. She became a whole-time director in May 2014 and is also the CFO. FY26 pay was ₹1.16cr.

people.name: Abburi Siddhartha Sagar
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD and the CFO
people.bio: Aged 38, he holds a master's in computer science and an MBA. He spent over ten years as a solution architect for several S&P 500 companies before joining the board in March 2021. At Avantel he drives strategy, business development, production and IT, and he is also a director of the family's Imeds Global and Wiki Kids. He co-founded Simply Science, an education initiative. The board approved his reappointment for 2027–2032 in July 2026. FY26 pay was ₹0.95cr.

people.name: P. Bala Bhaskar Rao
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from IETE and an MBA in manufacturing management from BITS Pilani. He joined Avantel in 1995 as an RF design engineer and has worked across R&D, production, projects, quality and marketing, including programmes for the Navy, Coast Guard, DRDO and ISRO. Before joining the board he was Vice President – Marketing & Customer Support and headed HR, marketing, quality, materials and customer support. He was appointed Director (Operations) for three years from 11 July 2026.

people.name: D. Rajasekhara Reddy
people.bio: He is the company secretary and compliance officer and a key managerial person. The annual report gives no further background. The other senior managers named in the annual report are vice presidents for technical, quality and projects, and a general manager for finance.

companies.changes: P. Bala Bhaskar Rao appointed Director (Operations) from 11 Jul 2026 (subject to postal ballot). Board changes among independents: Mini Ipe resigned Feb 2026, Myneni Narayana Rao ceased Jun 2026, two new independents from Apr 2026. Promoter Venkateswara Rao Abburi died during FY26 and his shares passed on.

companies.styleNote: A state-owned company: the President of India (Ministry of Defence) owns 74%. There is no family promoter. The Ministry appoints the Chairman & MD and the two functional directors for fixed terms, and a Joint Secretary sits on the board as government nominee (Meera Mohanty since 17 Sep 2026). The whole executive team turned over in 2025: a new CMD from ISRO in April, and two insiders promoted to Director (Finance) and Director (Production & Marketing). None of the directors are related, and executives own almost no shares.

people.name: Dr S.V.S. Narayana Murty
people.bio: A metallurgist with a B.E. from Andhra University, an M.E. from IISc Bangalore and a PhD from IIT Bombay, followed by post-doctoral research at Japan's National Institute for Materials Science (2003–2006). He joined ISRO's Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre in 1993 and worked on ultra-high-strength steels and titanium, super and aluminium alloys. He then moved to ISRO's Liquid Propulsion Systems Centre as a general manager for materials development and production, working on indigenising critical materials for the space programme. He took charge as CMD on 28 April 2025, with a term running to his superannuation in December 2029. His FY26 pay was about ₹61 lakh.

people.name: Madhubala Kalluri
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in commerce from Andhra University and is a Fellow of the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. She joined MIDHANI as an accounts officer in 1993 and over 32 years worked across accounting, costing, budgeting, projects, tax and audit, rising to General Manager (Finance & Accounts). She became Director (Finance) on 21 July 2025 and CFO on 13 August 2025, with a term running to her superannuation in August 2027.

people.name: Padavittan Babu
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in metallurgical engineering from Madras University and an MBA from Dr B.R. Ambedkar Open University. He joined MIDHANI in 1997 and has over three decades in special steels, superalloys and titanium alloys, working in marketing, production and strategic planning; in marketing he opened new markets and revived exports. He was General Manager (Technical Services) before becoming Director (Production & Marketing) on 7 October 2025 for five years. He is also on the board of Utkarsha Aluminium Dhatu Nigam, MIDHANI's aluminium joint venture.

people.name: Paul Antony
people.bio: He is MIDHANI's company secretary and compliance officer and a key managerial person (ICSI membership A29037). The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Govt nominee director changed twice: Amit Satija to Prakash Rajpurohit (5 Jun 2026), then Meera Mohanty (17 Sep 2026). Three independent directors' terms ended 17 Apr 2026; Sameer Mundra (21 Aug 2026) and Pugazhendhy Arumugam (25 Aug 2026) appointed. No change in the executive team since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A family company: founder Madhusudhan Varma Jetty is Chairman & MD, his wife Radhika is a whole-time director, and their sons Shashank (CEO) and Hitesh are both whole-time directors, so the family holds all four executive board seats. The family owns 64.3% (Mar 2026), almost all of it held by the two parents. The hired CFO and company secretary joined in 2025, ahead of the January 2026 IPO on BSE SME.

people.name: Madhusudhan Varma Jetty
people.relation: Founder; husband of Radhika Varma Jetty, father of Shashank and Hitesh
people.bio: Holds a BA from Sri Venkateswara University, Tirupati, a diploma in business administration from Annamalai University and a postgraduate qualification in public administration from Kota Open University. He served in the Indian Air Force for 15 years (1979–1994), retiring as a sergeant, and trained there in radar fitting and in electronics, radio and communication engineering. With his wife and others he first set the business up as a partnership making data-acquisition and ground check-out systems, then incorporated the company in December 2011. He has over 38 years in defence and space, test and measurement, and business development.

people.name: Jetty Shashank Varma
people.relation: Elder son of the Chairman & MD; brother of Hitesh
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from VIT Vellore and completed IIM Bangalore's general management programme for aerospace and aviation executives, run with Toulouse Business School. He joined the company in August 2013 and has over ten years in automated test equipment, data acquisition, RF applications, system integration and LabVIEW/PXI platforms, alongside business development. He joined the board in January 2020 and is now CEO, with a term to July 2028.

people.name: Radhika Varma Jetty
people.relation: Wife of the Chairman & MD; mother of Shashank and Hitesh
people.bio: Holds a BA from the University of Madras. She co-founded the original partnership firm with her husband and has been with the company since it began. She has 17 years of experience in organisational strategy, business development, resource management and governance. Her current term as whole-time director runs to July 2028.

people.name: Hitesh Varma Jetty
people.relation: Younger son of the Chairman & MD; brother of the CEO
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from Osmania University, a postgraduate diploma in embedded systems design from C-DAC Hyderabad, and a master's in electrical and computer engineering from Western Ontario University, Canada. He joined the company in September 2020 and has about four years of experience in automated test equipment, data acquisition and RF applications using LabVIEW and PXI platforms. He joined the board in January 2025.

people.name: Sriharsha Vadakattu
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from Andhra University and a postgraduate certificate in business management from Xavier School of Management. Before joining as CFO in March 2025 he was CFO of Vishwanath Projects, head of finance at Milklane Dairy Services, vice president of finance at Sids Farms, senior finance manager at R & R Salons and earlier at Acer India. He has over ten years in finance.

people.name: Kameswara Rao Vempati
people.bio: Holds commerce degrees from Andhra University and IGNOU and a law degree from Osmania University, and is an associate of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He practised as an advocate (2007–2011) and as a company secretary in practice (2019–2024), and was company secretary of Evey Trans before joining in February 2025.

people.name: M. Srinivasulu Naidu
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from Osmania University. He joined in August 2010 as senior manager (technical) when the business was still a partnership, was one of the company's first subscribers, and rose to general manager in July 2020. He specialises in National Instruments data-acquisition hardware and LabVIEW, automated test equipment, simulators and military data buses.

companies.changes: No executive changes found since the January 2026 IPO; three independent directors joined in July 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Karunakar Reddy Baddam is Managing Director and the single promoter; the chairman is an independent director. The other two executive directors are long-serving insiders, not family. The promoter group held about 50% at June 2026 (Karunakar 45.5%, his sons Chanakya and Kanishka 2.3% each), down from 55% a year earlier after share issues, and about a third of Karunakar's shares are pledged. In July 2026 the company agreed to buy the promoter's 41.3% of Premier Explosives for cash.

people.name: Karunakar Reddy Baddam
people.relation: Founder and promoter; father of Chanakya and Kanishka Reddy (promoter-group shareholders, not in management)
people.stake: 45.46% (Jun 2026 shareholding), about a third of it pledged; family together 49.98%
people.bio: Holds a BA from Osmania University. He started the business in 1991 as a partnership doing job work and developing electronic systems, ran it as a proprietorship after the partnership dissolved in 1994, and incorporated Apollo Micro Systems in 1997. He has over 41 years of business experience and has taken the company from a design house to a supplier of complete subsystems and systems for defence and space programmes, with a focus on miniaturisation and import substitution. He has been an executive director since incorporation.

people.name: Krishna Sai Kumar Addepalli
people.relation: Not related to the promoter
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in electronics and telecommunication engineering from the University of Madras. He worked at JVR Infotech before joining Apollo in 2003 and joined the board in July 2011. With over 24 years across marketing, finance and operations, he runs overall operations, has widened the customer base into new markets and non-defence sectors, and strengthened quality processes and the supply chain.

people.name: Venkata Siva Prasad Chandrapati
people.relation: Not related to the promoter
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech in digital signal processing from Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya, Indore. He joined Apollo in 1999 after more than eight years at other companies and has been on the board since July 2011. He leads R&D and has over 26 years in design and product development, including weapon-system electronics for indigenous defence programmes and payload check-out and telemetry systems for space programmes.

people.name: Sudarshan Chiluveru
people.bio: An associate of the Indian Institute of Bankers, he spent his earlier career at State Bank of Hyderabad before joining Apollo in April 2017, shortly before its IPO. He handles cash management and banking relationships, and was also compliance officer from June 2023 until a new company secretary took over. He was 64 at the time of the 2017 IPO prospectus.

people.name: G. Seshadri Vasan
people.bio: A Fellow of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (FCS 11842) with experience in company law and listing rules. He took over as company secretary on 1 June 2026 after Rukhya Parveen resigned.

people.name: Venkateswara Rao Aluri
people.bio: Holds an MBA from Shivaji University. He worked at Trident Infosol, Realtime Techsolutions and HBL Power Systems before joining Apollo in July 2016 as senior general manager (sales), and now heads marketing.

people.name: Commodore B.P. Singh, VSM (Retd)
people.bio: A retired Indian Navy commodore and recipient of the Vishisht Seva Medal. He leads strategic projects. The annual report gives no further detail on his background.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Rukhya Parveen resigned from 31 May 2026; G. Seshadri Vasan appointed from 1 Jun 2026. Promoter stake fell from 55.1% to about 50% through share issues.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Kabra family. In June 2025 the two elder brothers, Executive Chairman Tribhuvanprasad Kabra and MD Shreegopal Kabra, left the board under a succession plan. Their brother Mahendrakumar Kabra is now MD, and his two nephews Mahhesh and Rajesh Kabra became Joint MDs in June 2026. The chairman, Ramesh Chandak (ex-MD of KEC International), is independent and not family. Hired professionals run finance, operations and exports. Promoters own 61.65%.

people.name: Mahendrakumar Kabra
people.since: Board since 1995; Joint MD 2014–2025; MD since June 2025
people.relation: Promoter; brother of former Executive Chairman Tribhuvanprasad Kabra and former MD Shreegopal Kabra; paternal uncle of Joint MDs Mahhesh and Rajesh Kabra
people.stake: 5.83% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his son Hemant Kabra holds another 5.83%; promoter group together 61.65%
people.bio: Holds a licentiate diploma in mechanical engineering from Veermata Jijabai Technological Institute (VJTI), Mumbai. He has been with the company since it started and on its board since February 1995, with more than four decades in the electrical industry. He was a director of MEW Electricals earlier. He served as Joint MD from 2014 and took over as MD in June 2025, when his elder brothers stepped down. He is also a director of group company Ram Ratna Wires, a listed maker of winding wires. He is 69.

people.name: Mahhesh Kabra
people.role: Joint Managing Director (heads FMEG and switches)
people.since: On the board 2010–2022; rejoined June 2025; Joint MD since June 2026
people.relation: Nephew of MD Mahendrakumar Kabra; cousin of Joint MD Rajesh Kabra
people.stake: 5.19% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); his wife Vvidhi Kabra holds 4.20%
people.bio: A commerce graduate with over 26 years in the electrical industry. He first joined the board in November 2010 and was a whole-time director until he resigned in December 2022. He came back as an executive director in June 2025 and was made Joint MD from 1 June 2026. He leads the consumer electricals (fans, lights, appliances) and switches business and works with the MD on capex, new products and capital allocation. He is 49.

people.name: Rajesh Kabra
people.role: Joint Managing Director (heads wires and cables)
people.since: Board since June 2025; Joint MD since June 2026
people.relation: Nephew of MD Mahendrakumar Kabra; cousin of Joint MD Mahhesh Kabra
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in business administration and an M.Sc. in engineering business management. Before joining the board he was Managing Director of group company Ram Ratna Infrastructure, which the company says became India's largest supplier of automated car-parking systems; there he ran sales, operations and finance. He joined the board as an executive director in June 2025 and became Joint MD from 1 June 2026. He leads the wires and cables business and expansion at home and abroad, and meets institutional investors. He is 38.

people.name: Jigar Mehta
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 20 years in finance, audit and governance. He spent nearly 20 years at KPMG in senior roles, working with manufacturing, infrastructure, real-estate, pharma and services clients. He joined RR Kabel as VP-Finance about two years before his promotion to CFO on 1 November 2025.

people.name: Rajesh Jain
people.since: With the company over 25 years; COO since November 2025
people.bio: A commerce graduate, associate cost accountant (ICWAI) and licentiate company secretary. He has been with RR Kabel for over 25 years and was its CFO for about eight years, including through the 2023 IPO. In November 2025 he handed over the CFO role and became COO of the wires and cables business.

people.name: Sanjay Taparia
people.bio: A science graduate from the University of Bombay. He joined in November 2010 and is responsible for the export business and its expansion overseas.

people.name: Shishir Sharma
people.bio: A science graduate from Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda. He heads sales and marketing for wires and cables. Before joining in December 2008 he worked at Godrej-GE Appliances, Whirlpool of India and Electrolux Voltas.

companies.changes: Executive Chairman Tribhuvanprasad Kabra and MD Shreegopal Kabra left the board on 31 May 2025. CFO Rajesh Jain moved to COO and Jigar Mehta became CFO on 1 Nov 2025. Mahhesh and Rajesh Kabra became Joint MDs on 1 Jun 2026.

companies.styleNote: No promoter sits on the board. The Chhabria family and its companies own about 35.8% (Orbit Electricals alone 30.70%), and sister company Finolex Industries holds another 14.51%, but the family is split into two camps fighting in court over voting control. Former Executive Chairman Deepak Chhabria lost his re-appointment vote at the 2023 AGM. Since then long-serving employees run it: plant head Ratnakar Barve is Chairman, and CEO Mahesh Viswanathan leads day to day. The annual report says no directors are related to each other.

people.name: Mahesh Viswanathan
people.since: Joined 2008; CFO, then Deputy CEO & CFO; CEO since June 2026
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant with 42 years of experience. He came from Philips Electronics India and joined Finolex Cables in October 2008. Over 18 years he handled internal audit, treasury, controllership and M&A, and served as CFO and later Deputy CEO & CFO. He became CEO on 1 June 2026. He was the best-paid person in the company in FY26 at ₹4.96cr, most of it incentive. He is 66.

people.name: Ratnakar Barve
people.since: Board since September 2021; re-appointment to 2031 put to the Sep 2026 AGM
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in electronics and telecommunication engineering and an MBA in operations management, and is a Six Sigma Black Belt. He started in 1987 at Goa Telecommunications & Systems, joined Bharti Teletech (Airtel's manufacturing arm) in 1995 and became a plant head there in 2002. He joined Finolex Cables in 2009 and heads all its units at Verna, Goa. He joined the board as executive director (operations) in 2021 and is now Chairman. He is 60.

people.name: Pravin Ahire
people.bio: A B.Tech with over 25 years in manufacturing, process engineering and product development in wires and cables. He worked at General Cable India Energy before joining Finolex Cables in July 2009. He has helped build its optical fibre, communication cable and power cable manufacturing and has commissioned new plants. He joined the board as executive director for operations in October 2024. He is 51.

people.name: Sachin Naik
people.bio: Has about 26 years of finance experience. He was earlier CFO and head of legal and secretarial at Shalimar Paints. He joined as CFO on 1 June 2026, when Mahesh Viswanathan moved up to CEO.

people.name: Sunil Upmanyu
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech, a BE, a diploma in business management and a PG diploma, with 37 years of experience. He came from Aksh Optic Fibre and joined Finolex Cables in May 2000. He was its second-best-paid employee in FY26.

people.name: Amit Mathur
people.bio: Has 27 years of sales experience. He came from Havells India and joined Finolex Cables in April 2015, where he runs sales.

companies.changes: Mahesh Viswanathan became CEO and Sachin Naik became CFO on 1 Jun 2026. Company Secretary Siddhesh Mandke resigned on 11 Jun 2026; Nirnoy Sur took over on 11 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A founder-family company. Founder Kushal Hegde (87) is Executive Chairman, his son Rajesh Hegde is MD, and his daughter Rakhi Shetty is a whole-time director. His other son Rohit Hegde stepped down as Joint MD in January 2026 but stays on the board as a non-executive director and owns 14.80%. Since April 2026 a hired CEO, Hukumchand Lakhotiya, runs operations under the family. Promoters own 74.58%.

people.name: Kushal Subbayya Hegde
people.relation: Founder; father of MD Rajesh Hegde, director Rohit Hegde and whole-time director Rakhi Shetty
people.stake: 35.23% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); promoter family together 74.58%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in arts from Bombay University. He is one of the founders and has been on the board since the company was set up in 1979, with over 45 years in strategy and management. Outside the company he has been president of the Bunts Sangha and the Kannada Sangha, a Lions Club district governor and chairman of the Kaveri group. He was paid ₹2.88cr in FY26, the most of any director. He is 87.

people.name: Rajesh Kushal Hegde
people.relation: Son of the founder-Chairman Kushal Hegde; brother of director Rohit Hegde and whole-time director Rakhi Shetty
people.bio: Holds a B.S. in mechanical engineering from Michigan Technological University and a master's in manufacturing systems engineering from Oklahoma State University, both in the US. He joined the company in September 1996 and has over 28 years in strategy and management. As MD he runs the business and led the December 2025 IPO and the build-out of the new Supa plant. He is 55.

people.name: Rakhi Shetty
people.since: With the company since 2006; whole-time director since 2025
people.relation: Daughter of the founder-Chairman Kushal Hegde; sister of MD Rajesh Hegde and director Rohit Hegde
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in arts (psychology) from the University of California and a master's in science from the University of South Florida. She has been with the company since 2006, with over 18 years in corporate social responsibility and management, and chairs its CSR committee. She is president of the National Council of Women in India and the Poona Women's Council.

people.name: Hukumchand Lakhotiya
people.bio: Holds an M.Tech in industrial management from IIT Bombay and a bachelor's in electrical engineering from Government College of Engineering, Amravati, where he was a gold medallist. He has over 30 years in the electrical and power sectors, more than 25 of them at CG Power & Industrial Systems and Schneider Electric (Singapore). At CG Power he led the transformer, switchgear and EPC business across Asia, several Asian plants and exports. Just before joining KSH he was COO for waste-to-energy at SAEL Industries. He became CEO on 2 April 2026.

people.name: Amod Joshi
people.bio: A chartered accountant who has also done a senior management programme at IIM Ahmedabad and holds an ACCA diploma in international financial reporting. He has over 15 years in logistics, audit and manufacturing, and earlier worked at the audit firms S.R. Batliboi & Co. and BSR & Co. He joined KSH in August 2017 and runs finance.

people.name: Ganesh Prasad
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Karnatak University, Dharwad and a diploma in management studies from the University of Mumbai. He worked at Otis Elevator (India) before joining KSH in January 2002. He runs production and product development and is a key managerial person (not a board director).

companies.changes: Rohit Hegde stepped down as Joint MD on 1 Jan 2026 and stays as a non-executive director. CEO Sandesh Bhagwat resigned (left 31 Mar 2026); Hukumchand Lakhotiya became CEO on 2 Apr 2026. Company Secretary Sarthak Malvadkar left on 31 Mar 2026; Nakul Patil took over on 1 Apr 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Mangal family of Jaipur. Ashish Mangal is MD and runs the business; his brother Rahul Mangal is the non-executive Chairman and also runs sister company Mangal Electrical Industries. Ashish's wife and two children hold senior management jobs. The family owns 68.18%, including their mother Saroj Mangal's 13.62%. A hired CFO runs finance.

people.name: Ashish Mangal
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman Rahul Mangal; husband of Shalu Mangal; father of Aditi and Rasik Mangal
people.stake: 31.81% (31 Mar 2026, FY26 annual report); family together 68.18%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Rajasthan with over 30 years in the wires and cables industry. He oversees production, marketing, finance and the supply chain, and the company credits him with technology choices and new-business investments. He was re-appointed MD from July 2022. He is also a director of sister company Mangal Electrical Industries and other family companies, and with his brother has given personal guarantees on the company's bank loans.

people.name: Murari Lal Poddar
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from the University of Rajasthan. Before Dynamic Cables he was senior manager (finance and accounts) at Wires and Fabriks, and worked at Shree Silica Products and Saboo Sodium Chloro. He earlier also served as the company's Company Secretary and now runs finance as CFO.

people.name: Shalu Mangal
people.relation: Wife of MD Ashish Mangal
people.bio: Listed by the company as senior management, heading accounts as Vice-President. She has also given a personal guarantee for the company's bank loans. The annual report gives no further detail on her education or career.

people.name: Aditi Mangal
people.role: Head of Human Resources & Corporate Communication
people.relation: Daughter of MD Ashish Mangal
people.bio: Listed by the company as senior management, heading HR and corporate communication. The annual report gives no further detail on her education or career.

people.name: Rasik Mangal
people.since: Joined July 2024; GM Marketing since June 2026
people.relation: Son of MD Ashish Mangal
people.bio: A graduate of New York University's Stern School of Business, majoring in management and operations. He joined in July 2024 as senior manager, marketing, and was made general manager, marketing and senior management on 16 June 2026. He works on business promotion and marketing strategy. The July 2026 AGM was asked to raise his pay to up to ₹40 lakh a year.

companies.changes: Rasik Mangal (MD's son) promoted to General Manager, Marketing on 16 Jun 2026. Neeraj Bali joined as an independent director on 16 Jun 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Kolkata family company. Deepak Goel is Chairman & MD, and his sons Devesh (CEO) and Akshat are whole-time directors; his wife Rakhi Goel is a promoter but has no role. The family owned all of it before the July 2026 IPO and about 75.3% after it. A hired COO and CFO support them.

people.name: Deepak Goel
people.relation: Promoter; father of Devesh and Akshat Goel; husband of promoter Rakhi Goel
people.stake: 45.41% before the July 2026 IPO (RHP), and he sold shares in it; promoters together about 75.3% after the IPO
people.bio: Has been with the company since it was incorporated and has more than 36 years in the cable and power industry. He has no formal education, as the offer document states. He sets strategy and oversees operations and governance. He won the TV9 Young Business Leader (Dare 2 Dream) award in 2021 and a Hurun Industry Achievement Award in 2024 for power transmission and distribution.

people.name: Devesh Goel
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Deepak Goel and promoter Rakhi Goel; brother of Akshat Goel
people.stake: 25.00% before the July 2026 IPO (RHP), and he sold shares in it
people.bio: Completed higher secondary school. He was briefly a director in 2010–11, rejoined in April 2015 as head of marketing and joined the board in August 2024. As CEO he runs operations, business expansion, customer relationships and R&D in insulation and cable design. He won the India 500 CEO Award for Quality Excellence in 2021, is co-chair of the CII eastern region's energy sub-committee for 2025-26, and has chaired IEEMA's eastern region committee.

people.name: Akshat Goel
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Deepak Goel and promoter Rakhi Goel; brother of CEO Devesh Goel
people.bio: Completed higher secondary school. He joined in June 2016 as head of operations and joined the board in August 2024. He now handles corporate strategy, marketing plans, new markets and brand positioning.

people.name: Navin Kumar Saffar
people.role: Executive Director (not on the board) & Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Calcutta with over 13 years in operations, business development, M&A, corporate finance and accounts. He worked at Lumino Industries before joining in October 2017 as a whole-time director. He now runs day-to-day operations and key decisions on finance and risk as COO, but no longer sits on the board.

people.name: Amit Kumar Goel
people.bio: A chartered accountant with a commerce degree from the University of Delhi and over 22 years in finance. He previously worked at Lux Industries, DTDC Express, Vodafone Idea, Tata Teleservices, Virgin Mobile India and Genpact, among others. He joined as CFO in November 2024 and handles planning, reporting, tax, compliance and risk. He is not listed as related to the promoter family.

people.name: Praveen Kumar Paul
people.bio: A science graduate from Vidyasagar University with over 27 years in manufacturing and marketing. He previously worked at Royle Extrusion Systems, the Royle Systems Group and Sterlite Optical Technologies. He runs production, quality control and plant safety.

people.name: Debashish Rout
people.bio: Holds a diploma in mechanical engineering and a B.Tech in electrical engineering from Janardan Rai Nagar Rajasthan Vidyapeeth. He has over 14 years in project management and operations and runs project planning and execution.

companies.changes: Listed on NSE and BSE on 16 Jul 2026. Company Secretary Payal Agarwal (named in the Sep 2025 draft offer document) has been replaced by Debendra Banthiya, per the July 2026 offer document.

companies.styleNote: The Suranna/Surana family runs it: the founder Narrindra Suranna is Chairman & MD and his son Ddev Surana is Whole-time Director & CEO. The compounding business was demerged from the family's Kkalpana Industries in 2022. Promoters own 75%, almost all through Bbigplas Poly Pvt Ltd (74.99%); the family members hold only a few hundred shares directly.

people.name: Narrindra Suranna
people.relation: Founder; father of Ddev Surana
people.stake: 550 shares, about 0% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together 75%, mainly via Bbigplas Poly Pvt Ltd
people.bio: Narrindra Suranna is a commerce graduate with a law degree (LLB) from Calcutta University. He has spent his career in the plastics industry and led the group's move into polymer compounding, which grew into one of India's larger compound makers. The business sat inside the listed Kkalpana Industries (India) Ltd until it was demerged into DDev Plastiks in 2022. He is also an executive director of Kkalpana Industries, so he runs two listed group companies.

people.name: Ddev Surana
people.since: Whole-time Director; CEO since the 2022 listing
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Narrindra Suranna
people.bio: Ddev Surana holds a B.Com (Hons), an MSc in Management for Business Excellence from the UK and an MBA from the USA. He is one of the promoters and is described by the company as the key driving force of the business, with skills in project management, HR, administration and IT. He signs the annual report's CEO letter and leads the new product and battery-storage plans. He is also a non-executive director of Kkalpana Industries (India) Ltd.

people.name: Rajesh Kothari
people.since: Board since Dec 2020; Whole-time Director since Mar 2022
people.bio: Rajesh Kothari is a commerce graduate (B.Com) from Rajasthan University, Ajmer. He began his career in 1985 at Kanoria Chemicals & Industries and joined the group in 1997; he was earlier a whole-time director of Kalpana Industries. He has over three decades in marketing, after-sales service and market research for wire and cable compounds and handles key domestic and export customers. He runs the company's plants in western India. He retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is proposed for re-appointment.

people.name: Arihant Bothra
people.since: CFO (in place through FY26; no change during the year)
people.bio: Arihant Bothra, born in 1989, graduated from Calcutta University in 2010 and is an associate member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He has over a decade of experience in finance, accounting, insurance, information systems and project financing. The company says he is pursuing a CFO programme with IIM Calcutta.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. Independent director Ramya Hariharan resigned in Jul 2026 for professional reasons; Rajni Mishra joined as independent director in Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Choudhary family company: Anurag Choudhary is Chairman, MD & CEO, his father Shyam Sundar Choudhary (a founder) and brother Amit Choudhary are whole-time directors. Promoters own 52.5%; the family members hold about 15% in their own names and the rest mainly through Modern Hi-Rise Pvt Ltd (36.8%).

people.name: Anurag Choudhary
people.since: Joined 1992; CEO since 2006; MD & CEO since Aug 2019
people.relation: Son of Shyam Sundar Choudhary; brother of Amit Choudhary
people.stake: 8.59% (4.33 crore shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 52.5%
people.bio: Anurag Choudhary, born 1972, holds a B.Com (Hons). He joined the family business in 1992 at about eighteen, became CEO in 2006 and MD & CEO in August 2019; his current term runs to August 2029. He led the change from a coal tar pitch maker into an integrated carbon chemicals group, adding carbon black, battery materials (anode and LFP cathode) and the Birla Tyres acquisition. Business Today named him India's Best CEO 2026 in chemicals. He is also a director of several group and battery-materials subsidiaries.

people.name: Shyam Sundar Choudhary
people.relation: Founder; father of Anurag and Amit Choudhary
people.bio: Shyam Sundar Choudhary, aged about 78, is a commerce graduate and one of the founders who set up the company in 1987. He has been on the board ever since and has decades of industrial and commercial experience. The company credits him with commissioning plants ahead of schedule. His present term as whole-time director runs to March 2028.

people.name: Amit Choudhary
people.since: With the business since 1994; board since Jun 2021
people.relation: Son of Shyam Sundar Choudhary; brother of Anurag Choudhary
people.bio: Amit Choudhary, aged about 50, is a commerce graduate from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata, with management education at IESE Business School, Spain. He has worked in the business since 1994 and oversees project expansions, plant operations and human resources. The company credits him with the Mahistikry specialty carbon black complex, the LFP cathode plant and the turnaround of Birla Tyres. He chairs the international advisory committee of the Asia Pacific Carbon Black Conference.

people.name: Kamlesh Kumar Agarwal
people.bio: Kamlesh Kumar Agarwal has been CFO since March 2014 and presents the results on the company's earnings calls. His education and earlier employers are not stated in the annual report or on the company website.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report; independent directors Girish Vanvari and Gopal Malpani were re-appointed for second terms in 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Makharia brothers: Punit Makharia is Chairman & MD and Gautam Makharia is Joint MD. Punit's son Raghav joined the board as a non-executive director in Aug 2026 and runs the Madhya Bharat Phosphate subsidiary. Promoters own 69.4%; the brothers' mother Bhanu Makharia holds 55.3% on her own.

people.name: Punit Gopikishan Makharia
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Gautam Makharia; father of Raghav Makharia
people.stake: 5.00% (16.2 lakh shares, FY26 annual report); family together 69.4%
people.bio: Punit Makharia, aged 55, holds a B.Com from Mumbai University. He is a promoter and has been a director since the company was set up in March 1993. He has more than two decades in dyes, dye intermediates and fertilisers and sets the group's strategy and customer relationships. He was re-appointed Chairman & MD from April 2026 and is also a director of group companies Madhya Bharat Phosphate, Kleur Speciality Chemicals and Krishvanta Fertchem.

people.name: Gautam Gopikishan Makharia
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Punit Makharia; uncle of Raghav Makharia
people.stake: 5.00% (Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); he was also allotted 7.36 lakh warrants in Dec 2025
people.bio: Gautam Makharia, aged 52, holds a bachelor's in electronics and telecommunications from Mumbai University and an MBA from Manchester Business School, UK. Before the family business he worked at General Electric (USA), Procter & Gamble (UK), Barclays Bank and the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre. He runs production and quality control at the Lote Parshuram plants in Ratnagiri. He was re-appointed Joint MD from April 2026.

people.name: Deepak Beriwala
people.bio: Deepak Beriwala, aged 38, holds a B.Com from the University of Rajasthan and is a qualified Chartered Accountant and Company Secretary. Before joining as CFO in June 2019 he worked in finance at a Mumbai shipping company, handling accounts, audit and strategy work.

people.name: Dr. N. N. Mahapatra
people.bio: Dr. Mahapatra, aged 67, studied textile chemistry at UDCT (now ICT) Mumbai, holds an MSc and a doctorate in applied chemistry from Utkal University and an MBA from IMM Kolkata. He has 39 years in textiles in India and abroad with the Birla groups, Reliance Industries, Raymond (Kenya) and the Churchgate Group (Nigeria). He joined in August 2018 to run the dyes business.

companies.changes: Non-executive director Ramakant Nayak resigned in Aug 2026 due to age; Raghav Makharia (son of the Chairman) joined the board as a non-executive director from 13 Aug 2026. No executive changes.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Rajesh Rathi is Chairman & MD, but the promoter group now owns only about 9.3%: other Rathi family branches were reclassified as public shareholders in 2025, and the former chairman P. R. Rathi left the board in May 2025. The rest of the executive team is professional and, since the Heubach purchase, partly German.

people.name: Rajesh Balkrishna Rathi
people.since: With the company for over three decades; also Chairman since May 2025
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Ajay B. Rathi (a promoter, not on the board)
people.stake: 5.15% at 31 Mar 2026 (FY26 annual report); about 6.3% after converting 9.8 lakh warrants in Jun 2026; promoter group together 9.32%
people.bio: Rajesh Rathi holds a BE (Mechanical) from MIT Pune, a BSc (Chemical) from Ohio University and an MBA from the University of Pittsburgh. He has worked at Sudarshan for more than three decades and led the March 2025 purchase of Germany's Heubach Group, which made it a global pigment maker with a second head office near Frankfurt. He became Chairman in May 2025 in addition to MD. In June 2026 he put in close to ₹100cr to convert his warrants, at a premium to the market price.

people.name: Ashish Vij
people.since: Whole-time Director since May 2018; with the company over 15 years
people.stake: 17,461 shares after ESOP exercise, about 0.02% (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Ashish Vij is a chemical engineer (BE, UDCT, Punjab University) and a certified Six Sigma Black Belt and lean practitioner. He has been with Sudarshan for more than 15 years and on the board as whole-time director since May 2018; the company now lists him as Chief Operating Officer. He is also a director of the listed subsidiary Sudarshan Colorants India (the former Heubach Colorants India). He is not related to any director.

people.name: Nilkanth Natu
people.bio: Nilkanth Natu is a Chartered Accountant and a graduate of the University of Pune. Before joining as CFO in July 2020 he worked at Wipro, Thermax, Automobile Corporation of Goa and Satyam Computer Services, covering planning, reporting, treasury, budgeting and audit. From May 2026 he is also interim CFO of the listed subsidiary Sudarshan Colorants India.

people.name: Dr. Klaus-Dieter Baumgart
people.bio: Dr. Baumgart has more than four decades of international experience in the pigment industry. He is the group's Chief Technology Officer and Managing Director of the German unit Sudarshan Germany Horizons GmbH, and has led the technology integration after the Heubach purchase.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Mandar Velankar resigned on 1 Sep 2026; Amit Deshpande joined as General Counsel (senior management) on 21 Sep 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Jhunjhunwala family: Suresh Jhunjhunwala is Executive Chairman, his son Anirudh is MD & CEO and his son Anuj is Whole-time Director & CFO. Promoters own 71%.

people.name: Suresh Jhunjhunwala
people.since: With JG Chemicals for over 30 years
people.relation: Promoter; father of Anirudh and Anuj Jhunjhunwala
people.stake: 9.95% plus 0.10% through his HUF (Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); family together 71%
people.bio: Suresh Jhunjhunwala holds a B.Com from Calcutta University and has over 50 years of business experience. Before and alongside JG Chemicals he ran businesses in refractories, ceramics, mining, glassware and electrical components. He has been with JG Chemicals for over 30 years and is responsible for strategy and new growth areas.

people.name: Anirudh Jhunjhunwala
people.since: Leads the business; over 20 years in the industry
people.relation: Son of Suresh Jhunjhunwala; brother of Anuj Jhunjhunwala
people.bio: Anirudh Jhunjhunwala holds a B.Com from Calcutta University and an MBA from the University of Warwick. He has more than 20 years of experience in chemicals and specialty chemicals and is responsible for all business activities of the company. He signs the MD & CEO statement in the annual report.

people.name: Anuj Jhunjhunwala
people.since: Director of the company and subsidiaries since 2010; board since Mar 2022
people.relation: Son of Suresh Jhunjhunwala; brother of Anirudh Jhunjhunwala
people.bio: Anuj Jhunjhunwala, born 1983, holds a B.Com from Calcutta University, an MSc in Finance from ICFAI University and an MBA from Said Business School, University of Oxford; he also took a derivatives course at the London School of Economics. He was an investment professional at Greater Pacific Capital in London and a strategy consultant at SEB AG in Frankfurt. He has been a director of the company and its subsidiaries since 2010 and runs finance, treasury and new project development.

companies.changes: No executive changes. Independent director Ashok Bhandari died on 3 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Arvind Mafatlal Group. The promoter Hrishikesh Mafatlal is Executive Chairman, but the business is run day to day by a hired MD, Anand V. S. (ex-BASF). His son Priyavrata Mafatlal sits on the board as a non-executive director. Promoters own 33.8%.

people.name: Hrishikesh A. Mafatlal
people.since: On the board since 1984; Executive Chairman since Aug 2016 (re-appointed to Aug 2031)
people.relation: Promoter; father of non-executive director Priyavrata Mafatlal
people.stake: 0.47% directly (7.91 lakh shares, FY26 annual report); plus 18.2% as trustee of Gurukripa Trust; promoter group together 33.8%
people.bio: Hrishikesh Mafatlal, aged 71, holds a B.Com (Hons) from Sydenham College (1975) and completed Harvard Business School's Advanced Management Programme in 1993. He chairs the Arvind Mafatlal Group; before becoming NOCIL's Executive Chairman in 2016 he was with Navin Fluorine International. He served 12 years on IIM Ahmedabad's Board of Governors and was Vice Chairman of the Cotton Textiles Export Promotion Council. Shareholders re-appointed him Executive Chairman for five years from August 2026.

people.name: Anand V. S.
people.since: Joined Mar 2023; MD since Aug 2023 (term to Jul 2028)
people.bio: Anand V. S., aged 52, holds a BE in chemical engineering from Siddaganga Institute of Technology, Bangalore and a PGDM in marketing from MDI Gurgaon. He has about 28 years in the chemical industry, mostly across BASF divisions in India and abroad. Before NOCIL he was Managing Director of Chemetall India, a BASF Group company. He was appointed MD from August 2023.

people.name: P. Srinivasan
people.bio: P. Srinivasan, aged 60, holds a B.Com and is a Chartered Accountant. He joined NOCIL in January 2005 from Flamingo Pharmaceuticals and has been with the company since. He is a key managerial person.

people.name: Prasanna Pandit
people.bio: Prasanna Pandit, aged 56, holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from LIT Nagpur and has about 32 years of experience. He joined NOCIL in April 2024 from Gujarat Fluorochemicals and is a key managerial person responsible for plants and technology.

companies.changes: No executive changes. Independent director Vilas Gupte's term ended in May 2026; Sanjiv Lal (ex-MD of Rallis India) and Sabyaschi Patnaik joined as independent directors in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: Part of the RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group. Dr. Sanjiv Goenka is non-executive Chairman and his wife Preeti Goenka is a non-executive director; a hired MD, Nilesh Koul (ex-Hindalco), runs the company. Promoters own 53.4%, mostly through Rainbow Investments (47.4%).

people.name: Nilesh Koul
people.bio: Nilesh Koul is a graduate of G. B. Pant University and holds a PGDBM from IIM Ahmedabad. He has about 28 years of leadership experience in metals, building materials, oil and gas and FMCG at Hindalco, BP, Castrol India and LafargeHolcim, in strategy, sales, manufacturing, digital change and P&L roles abroad. His last job was Senior President and CEO of Hindalco's aluminium downstream business. He replaced Kaushik Roy, who resigned for personal reasons, on 3 Nov 2025.

people.name: Raj Kumar Gupta
people.bio: Raj Kumar Gupta has been CFO and a key managerial person since October 2024 and speaks on the company's results calls. The annual report does not give his education or earlier employers.

people.name: Rohit Maindwal
people.bio: Rohit Maindwal holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from NIT Warangal and has about 32 years of industry experience, including Reliance Industries and JBF RAK LLC.
