His last role was Senior Executive Vice President at Reliance Industries. He joined on 20 Aug 2026 to run the specialty carbon black business and is designated senior management.

people.name: Vaneet Kumar
people.bio: Vaneet Kumar holds a B.Tech in instrumentation engineering from Punjab Technical University and an M.Tech from IIT Bombay. He has more than 20 years in energy storage, automotive and battery technology at SVOLT Energy Technology, ACME Cleantech Solutions and Great Wall Motors. His last role was SVP & CTO – Battery at Adani New Industries. He joined on 9 Jun 2026 to lead the battery-materials business.

companies.changes: MD Kaushik Roy resigned for personal reasons on 3 Nov 2025 and Nilesh Koul took over. New senior hires: Vaneet Kumar (batteries, Jun 2026) and Rohit Maindwal (specialty blacks, Aug 2026). Company Secretary Kaushik Mukherjee retires on 30 Sep 2026; Ravi Varma takes over from 1 Oct 2026. Independent director R. K. Agarwal left in Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: The founder Manish Kiri is Chairman & MD; the two whole-time directors are long-serving professionals. Promoters own 41.7% (up from 26.7% in 2023 through warrants), including Anupama Kiri (14.6%), Manish Kiri (8.3%), Hemil Kiri (4.9%) and Aruna Kiri (4.9%).

people.name: Manish Kiri
people.relation: Founder and promoter
people.bio: Manish Kiri, born 1972, holds a BE in electronics and communication from Gujarat University and an MBA from Wayne State University, USA. He founded the company in 1998, set up the Lonsen Kiri joint venture with China's Longsheng in 2008 and bought into DyStar in 2010. He led the long Singapore court fight with Senda over DyStar, which Kiri won. He now drives the move into copper smelting and fertilisers, and chairs ASSOCHAM's Gujarat chemical committee.

people.name: Yagnesh Mankad
people.since: Joined as COO of the dyes division (date not disclosed)
people.bio: Yagnesh Mankad is a mechanical engineer with a postgraduate degree in business management. He has over four decades of experience across engineering, plastics, textiles and chemicals, covering operations, marketing, large projects and corporate affairs. He joined Kiri as Chief Operating Officer of the dyes division and still oversees the whole dyes business.

people.name: Dr. Girish Tandel
people.bio: Dr. Girish Tandel holds an MSc, an MPhil in polymer chemistry and a doctorate in polymer synthesis. He has over 35 years in chemicals, focused on new dyes and process improvement. He has been Kiri's Chief Technology Officer since June 2015 and sits on technical committees of the Bureau of Indian Standards and Gujarat's textile-sector best-practice group.

people.name: Jayesh Vyas
people.bio: Jayesh Vyas is the CFO and a key managerial person who signs the accounts with the Chairman. The annual report does not give his education or earlier employers.

companies.changes: No executive changes found since the FY26 annual report. Independent director Veena Padia left in Sep 2025 and Reema Parikh joined.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Meghmani group, founded by five families (Jayanti Patel, Ashish Soparkar, Natwarlal Patel, Ramesh Patel and Anand Patel). The second generation runs it: Maulik Patel is Chairman & MD and Kaushal Soparkar is Executive Director. Maulik's cousins Ankit, Karana and Darshan Patel sit on the board as non-executive directors; they run sister company Meghmani Organics. Promoters own 68.8%.

people.name: Maulik Patel
people.relation: Promoter; son of Meghmani co-founder Jayanti Patel; cousin of non-executive directors Ankit, Karana and Darshan Patel
people.bio: Holds a BE (Chemical) from Sardar Patel University, Anand, an MS in Chemical Engineering from the University of Southern California and an MBA from Long Island University. He has about 17 years in the chemical industry, all within the Meghmani group. At Epigral he runs operations, project expansions, team building and new product selection, and has led the move from caustic soda and chlorine into derivatives such as CPVC and epichlorohydrin. He has set a goal of about ₹5,000cr revenue by FY31. He is also a non-executive director of Meghmani Organics.

people.name: Kaushal Soparkar
people.relation: Promoter; son of Meghmani co-founder Ashish Soparkar
people.bio: Holds a BS (Chemical) from the University of New Haven and an MS in Engineering Management from Northeastern University, USA. He has about 16 years in the chemical industry. At Epigral he runs finance, IT and human resources. He is also a non-executive director of Meghmani Organics.

people.name: Rakesh Agrawal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with more than 29 years in accounts, finance, taxation, cost management and MIS. Before joining Epigral he held a senior finance and accounts role at a listed company (not named in the filing), covering planning, budgeting, internal control and compliance. He replaced Sanjay Jain, who left in September 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Sanjay Jain resigned with effect from 30 Sep 2025; Rakesh Agrawal became CFO on 10 Nov 2025. No executive changes filed since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: The Dalmia family controls it with 19.9%. Chairman Anurag Dalmia is non-executive; his son Neelabh Dalmia is an executive director for growth projects. Day-to-day the company is run by a long-serving hired team: MD R S Jalan (since 2006) and CFO Raman Chopra, both career Dalmia-group professionals.

people.name: Ravi Shanker (R S) Jalan
people.bio: A commerce graduate (Hons.) and chartered accountant with over four decades of experience. Before GHCL he worked at Modi Investment Corporation, Sanjay Paper and Chemicals, Dalmia Industries, Dalmia (Bros.) and GTC Industries, and was an executive director at Sree Meenakshi Mills. He joined GHCL as Senior Executive Director in 2002 and became MD in 2006, leading its growth in soda ash and, until its demerger, home textiles. He was ranked 29th in the BT–PwC Best CEOs survey in 2017. He is 68 and was paid about ₹14.9cr in FY26, including stock options.

people.name: Raman Chopra
people.since: Joined 2003; CFO since November 2007; director since April 2008
people.bio: A commerce graduate and a rank-holding chartered accountant (FCA). Before GHCL he was Vice President at Dalmia Bros., evaluating group companies and handling new projects. He joined GHCL in 2003 and spent four years as Senior Vice President in the home textiles division before becoming CFO in 2007. He now runs finance, accounts, tax, legal, IT, commercial, the greenfield project, sustainability and risk. He is also a director of GHCL Textiles.

people.name: Neelabh Dalmia
people.since: Executive director; re-appointed for five years from February 2025
people.relation: Promoter; son of non-executive Chairman Anurag Dalmia
people.stake: 0.14% (1,25,401 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 19.9%
people.bio: Holds a BS in Business Administration and an MBA from the Kelley School of Business, Indiana University. He has about 21 years of experience and earlier served as a non-executive director of GHCL. He leads growth projects, including greenfield plants, acquisitions and captive green power. He is an angel investor through the Indian Angel Network and co-chaired a PHD Chamber international affairs committee in 2021. He is 42.

people.name: N N Radia
people.bio: A mechanical engineer (BE) with 43 years of experience. He started as a shift in-charge at Tata Chemicals. He runs GHCL's soda ash operations and was paid about ₹2.2cr in FY26. He is 70.

companies.changes: No director or KMP changes filed with NSE since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: The Agrawal family of Vadodara's Shiva group bought control from INEOS Styrolution in 2022. Rakesh Agrawal, who ran the company as ABS Plastics from 1973 to 2012, is executive Chairman; his sons Rahul (MD) and Vishal (Joint MD, unpaid) run it with a hired technical whole-time director. The family holds 46.2% through Shiva Performance Materials, down from about 62% after a stake sale.

people.name: Rakesh S. Agrawal
people.since: Director since November 2022; ran ABS Plastics (the same company) as MD 1973–2012
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Rahul Agrawal and Joint MD Vishal Agrawal
people.stake: No direct holding shown; family holds 46.24% through Shiva Performance Materials (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a master's in engineering (chemistry) from Stevens Institute of Technology, USA. A first-generation entrepreneur, he set up ABS Plastics, which built India's first ABS and SAN resin plant, and was its MD from 1973 to 2012 before it passed to INEOS Styrolution. He chairs the Shiva group, with interests in acid chlorides, alkyl chlorides, polymers, engineering services and trading. He has been President of the Federation of Gujarat Industries and a FICCI executive committee member for several years.

people.name: Rahul R. Agrawal
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Rakesh Agrawal; brother of Joint MD Vishal Agrawal
people.stake: No direct holding shown; family holds 46.24% through Shiva Performance Materials (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in chemical engineering from the University of Michigan and an MBA from Harvard Business School. He has nearly 26 years in chemical manufacturing. He is a director and promoter of Shiva Pharmachem, a Vadodara maker of intermediates for pharma, agrochemicals and performance chemicals, and promoter of Shiva Performance Materials, which makes specialty acrylic resins for inks, coatings and toners.

people.name: Vishal R. Agrawal
people.relation: Promoter; son of Chairman Rakesh Agrawal; brother of MD Rahul Agrawal
people.stake: Nil (FY26 AGM notice); family holds 46.24% through Shiva Performance Materials
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in chemical engineering and a master's in information management from Stevens Institute of Technology. He founded Shiva Pharmachem, focused on chlorination chemistry, and is its MD; in 2015 he led its purchase of a specialty chemicals company in Europe. He has about 26 years in chemical manufacturing. He is 51 and draws no pay from Styrenix.

people.name: Ravishankar Kompalli (K. Ravishankar)
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Andhra University (1977) with a diploma in safety management from the Central Labour Institute, Mumbai. He has over 48 years in styrenic polymers (ABS, SAN, polystyrene), starting at Polychem's polystyrene plant, then UB Group, Bayer, Sumitomo Chemical (Indonesia), INEOS Styrolution and Shiva Performance Materials. He co-invented a patented high-rubber graft ABS powder process used at the Nandesari plant. Before rejoining he consulted for Supreme Petrochem on its mass ABS project.

people.name: Bhupesh P. Porwal
people.bio: Has more than 25 years in finance and operations roles across petrochemicals, glass, packaging, refrigeration and engineering. He was COO & CFO of Ankur Scientific Energy Technologies, Group CFO of AIA Engineering, and earlier Whole-time Director & CFO of INEOS Styrolution India (this company's former name). He also worked at Piramal Glass and Blue Star.

companies.changes: No executive changes filed since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: A Gujarat government company: Gujarat State Investments and GSFC together own 41.3%. The Chairman (Manoj Kumar Das, IAS) and the MD are serving IAS officers posted by the state and rotate every year or two; the MD changed twice in nine months. Continuity comes from career executive directors.

people.name: Sanjeev Kumar, IAS
people.bio: A 1998-batch IAS officer of the Gujarat cadre who also serves as Principal Secretary to the Chief Minister of Gujarat. He holds a B.Tech (Hons.) from IIT Kharagpur and a master's in public administration from the Humphrey School, University of Minnesota. In about 28 years of service he has worked in finance, energy and petrochemicals, forests and environment, climate change, urban development and commercial taxes, and with listed state companies. He holds the MD post until further government orders, up to five years.

people.name: D. V. (Dilipkumar Vinodchandra) Parikh
people.bio: A career GNFC executive who runs finance, including risk management and the excise cell, plus business and strategy development, the staff welfare trust and the project group. He fronts the company on earnings calls. His education and earlier career are not disclosed in the annual report or on the company website.

people.name: Pankaj Kanaiyalal Purohit
people.bio: A career GNFC executive promoted to Executive Director in April 2025. He oversees fire and safety, R&D, laboratories, the neem complex (including neem FMCG), design and construction, IT and telecom, and operation and maintenance of the TDI-II plant at Dahej. His education and earlier career are not disclosed.

people.name: Nitin Nanjibhai Patel
people.since: Retired February 2026; on extension from March 2026
people.bio: Runs operation and maintenance of all plants at the Bharuch complex, including electrical and instrumentation, technical services and inspection. He retired on 28 February 2026 and was kept on an extension from 3 March 2026. His education and earlier career are not disclosed.

companies.changes: MD Rajkumar Beniwal, IAS (in charge from 29 Dec 2025, after T. Natarajan, IAS) left on 9 Sep 2026 when the state moved him; Sanjeev Kumar, IAS took over the same day. Chairman Pankaj Joshi, IAS retired in Oct 2025; Manoj Kumar Das, IAS became Chairman on 1 Nov 2025.

companies.styleNote: Sailesh C. Mehta of the founding Mehta family is Chairman & MD. His wife Parul Mehta is a non-executive director, and his son Yeshil runs the two main subsidiaries (Mahadhan AgriTech and Deepak Mining Solutions) as Joint MD and joined the parent board in July 2026. A large team of hired presidents runs the functions. Promoters own about 45.6%, mostly through family companies.

people.name: Sailesh C. Mehta
people.relation: Promoter; husband of non-executive director Parul Mehta; father of Yeshil Mehta
people.stake: 0.00% directly (1,731 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 45.6%, mainly through Nova Synthetic (34.5%) and Robust Marketing Services (8.8%)
people.bio: Holds a management degree from Texas, USA. He became MD in 2002, Vice Chairman in 2005 and Chairman in 2012, and led the company's shift from an ammonia maker to a multi-product group in fertilisers, mining chemicals (ammonium nitrate) and industrial chemicals, including the greenfield ammonia plant. He has been a long-time office bearer of the Fertiliser Association of India and chaired its western region. He won the chemicals and metals category of the BT–PwC Best CEOs ranking in 2024. Investors should note the promoter-linked financing flagged in the note (a promoter company holds subsidiary debentures).

people.name: Yeshil S. Mehta
people.role: Joint MD of subsidiaries Mahadhan AgriTech and Deepak Mining Solutions; non-executive director of the parent
people.relation: Promoter; son of CMD Sailesh Mehta and Parul Mehta
people.bio: Holds a Bachelor of Management Studies from Mumbai and an MBA from Harvard Business School, and worked as a consultant at Bain & Company. Before his MBA he led the group's purchase of a stake in a banana business from Swiss consortium CFI and ran it, and after it he led the financial restructuring and exit from that business. He led the group strategy review done with McKinsey and BCG. He is 37 and a director of promoter company SCM Commercial.

people.name: Subhash Anand
people.bio: Has more than 30 years in finance, 20 of them in leadership roles. Before joining he was Group CFO/adviser at Hero Cycles, ED & CFO of Solara Active Pharma Sciences, President & CFO of PI Industries and VP Finance at Whirlpool of India; he also worked at Sterlite Industries and Hindustan Copper. He first joined as President – Strategy before becoming CFO.

people.name: Pandurang Landge
people.since: New title from September 2026 (earlier President – Manufacturing)
people.bio: Has 44 years of experience in operations, project execution and product development in India and abroad. He started at Rashtriya Chemicals & Fertilizers on world-scale ammonia plants, then spent 20 years in Saudi Arabia heading a start-up that grew into a multi-product venture and listed in 2008.

people.name: Amir Alvi
people.bio: Has more than 36 years in fertiliser and chemical companies, covering manufacturing, plant management, marketing, supply chain, project execution from concept to commissioning, P&L management, capex and debottlenecking, and process safety. His earlier employers are not named in the filing.

people.name: Rajib Bhattacharjee
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from NIT Trichy and an MBA in marketing. He has over 30 years in specialty chemicals and capital goods. He was Vice President – Global Specialties at Galaxy Surfactants and earlier held leadership roles at Lubrizol Advanced Materials India, ICI India and Thermax.

companies.changes: Company Secretary Rabindra Purohit resigned on 28 Sep 2026. Amir Alvi joined as President – Manufacturing Operations on 1 Sep 2026; Rajib Bhattacharjee as President – Transformation on 11 Jun 2026. Yeshil Mehta joined the board on 1 Jul 2026. Other named presidents: Debasish Banerjee (Strategic Projects), Raghunath Kelkar (Industrial Chemicals), Prikshit Agarwal (Strategy), Mahesh M (CEO – Creaticity).

companies.styleNote: Deepak C. Mehta, second generation of the founding family, is Chairman & MD. In May 2026 both his sons, Maulik and Meghav, were made Deputy MDs, setting up the succession. His brother Ajay Mehta (MD until 2017) left the board in August 2026. Long-serving hired directors run finance and manufacturing. Promoters own 49.3%.

people.name: Deepak C. Mehta
people.since: Joined the family business about 50 years ago
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder the late Chimanlal K. Mehta; father of Deputy MDs Maulik and Meghav Mehta; brother of Ajay Mehta
people.bio: A science graduate of the University of Mumbai, he joined his father Chimanlal K. Mehta about 50 years ago and built the Deepak group into a maker of more than 34 chemical intermediates sold in over 50 countries. He has been President of the Indian Chemical Council, chaired FICCI's national chemicals committee and sat on the government's chemicals task force. ICT Mumbai gave him an honorary doctorate. He is also CMD of subsidiary Deepak Phenolics, which paid him ₹18cr commission for FY26.

people.name: Maulik D. Mehta
people.since: ED & CEO since the Covid-19 period (re-appointed 2021); Deputy MD from May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; elder son of CMD Deepak Mehta; brother of Meghav Mehta
people.bio: Holds a BBA from the University of Liverpool, a master's in industrial and organisational psychology from Columbia University, and completed Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management programme. He has 18 years with the group across business development, product development, HR and brand. He took over as CEO during the Covid-19 peak and has pushed the 'Responsible Chemistry' ESG agenda. He is 43; his fixed pay for FY27 is ₹5cr plus up to 35% variable.

people.name: Meghav D. Mehta
people.since: Board since May 2022; Deputy MD from May 2026
people.relation: Promoter; younger son of CMD Deepak Mehta; brother of Maulik Mehta
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from Rochester Institute of Technology, New York, specialising in materials science and alternative energy. He was Executive Director of subsidiary Deepak Phenolics (2019–24), where he set up structure, controls and IT and ran downstream phenol and acetone projects, then ED & CEO of Deepak Chem Tech (2024–26), leading new projects in nitric acid, chlorination, fluorination, hydrogenation, MIBK and polycarbonate. He is 39.

people.name: Sanjay Upadhyay
people.since: Whole-time director since April 2017; Group CFO since August 2022
people.bio: A qualified cost accountant and fellow of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with an Advanced Management Programme from Wharton. He has over 40 years in finance, treasury, tax, commercial, secretarial work and restructuring. As Group CFO he oversees capital allocation across group companies, risk, governance, investor relations and IT, and builds the CFO bench for each subsidiary. He is 64 and was re-appointed for five years from August 2026.

people.name: Girish Satarkar
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. (Tech) and M.Sc. (Tech) in textile chemistry from ICT (formerly UDCT), Mumbai, and a master's in marketing management from Welingkar Institute. He has over 37 years in the chemical industry, 18 in leadership roles, with experience in international and domestic marketing. He leads manufacturing strategy, capacity use and safety compliance. He is 62 and was re-appointed for three years from August 2026.

people.name: Anant Pande
people.bio: Holds a B.E. (Hons.) in chemical engineering and M.Sc. (Hons.) in chemistry from BITS Pilani, and an executive diploma in management from Kirloskar Institute. He has about 40 years in life-science chemicals and pharma. He was CEO of Dhampur Sugar Mills, Whole-time Director & Chief of Operations at Jubilant Life Sciences, President – Technology & Manufacturing at Atul, and held roles at Continental Carbon India and the Aditya Birla Group. He is 63.

people.name: Somsekhar Nanda
people.since: CFO since August 2022; with the company over 10 years
people.bio: A chartered accountant who attended IIM Calcutta's senior management programme. He has over 27 years in finance, treasury, M&A, tax and audit, having worked at Lord Engineers India, Transpek Sitox Industries and Gujarat Fluorochemicals. He was Deputy CFO before taking over from Sanjay Upadhyay in 2022.

companies.changes: Maulik and Meghav Mehta became Deputy MDs on 9 May 2026. Ajay C. Mehta did not seek re-election and left the board on 5 Aug 2026; Anant Pande took his seat as ED & Chief Manufacturing Officer. SBU Head – Life Sciences Puneet Sharma resigned on 21 Aug 2026, three months after joining.

companies.styleNote: The Dhanuka family runs it: Nikunj Dhanuka is Chairman & MD (with the company since 1998) and Mayank Dhanuka is Executive Director & CEO. The company states that no two directors are 'relatives' under company law. A hired engineer, Sagar Jadhav, runs the plants as Executive Director. The promoter group owns 68.7%, almost all through family investment companies.

people.name: Nikunj Dhanuka
people.relation: Promoter
people.stake: 0.06% (19,000 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 68.74%
people.bio: A commerce and management graduate who has been with IG Petrochemicals since 1998. He has more than two decades in the chemical industry, with experience in finance and banking, and led the company's growth and the restructuring of its businesses. He oversees overall operations and strategy.

people.name: Mayank Dhanuka
people.relation: Promoter
people.stake: 1.61% (4,95,327 shares, FY26 annual report; raised from 3,90,423 during the year)
people.bio: A commerce graduate who studied financial management at Harvard University and completed Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management programme. He has over 26 years in the chemical industry across business operations, business development, plant management, procurement and imports, and drives strategy and operations.

people.name: Sagar Jadhav
people.since: Director since April 2024; re-appointed for three years from July 2026
people.bio: A chemical engineer (B.E.) from Pune University with more than 33 years in chemical plant operations across products, functions and sites. He oversees the company's plants at Taloja and heads its business-responsibility (ESG) committee.

people.name: Pramod Bhandari
people.bio: A B.Com (Hons.) graduate who is both a chartered accountant and a company secretary. From 2010 to 2018 he was at Nayara Energy (formerly Essar Oil), heading M&A and serving as CFO of its power business. He handles finance on the company's earnings calls.

companies.changes: CHRO Rajkumar VP resigned in May 2026 after about six weeks; Pramod Sanap (ex-Laxmi Organic, HUL, AkzoNobel, Diageo) joined as CHRO on 19 May 2026. Sagar Jadhav re-appointed as Executive Director from 1 Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: Owned jointly by The Supreme Industries (Taparia family, 30.8%) and the Raheja group (30.8% via R. Raheja Investments); promoters own 64.2% in all. All the promoter directors (Chairperson M. P. Taparia, S. J. Taparia, B. L. Taparia, Rajan Raheja and his son Akshay Raheja) are non-executive. Long-serving hired executives run the business: N. Gopal (with the company since 1990) and CFO Rakesh Nayyar.

people.name: N. Gopal
people.since: Joined 1990; Manager re-appointed April 2026 to March 2029
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. and B.Tech (chemical engineering) from Madras University and a DIC in advanced chemical engineering from Imperial College, London. He has about 57 years in petrochemicals, including ICI's petrochemicals division in the UK, IPCL and Reliance Industries. He joined Supreme Petrochem in 1990 as Senior VP (Projects & Operations), built its polystyrene plant from scratch at 66,000 tonnes a year (now 3,00,000 tonnes) and led the PS, EPS, XPS and SPC expansions at Amdoshi and Manali. He was paid about ₹4.2cr in FY26.

people.name: Rakesh Nayyar
people.bio: Runs finance and corporate affairs and is the company's voice on earnings calls, where he described the Q1 FY27 margin as 'an aberration'. His education and earlier career are not disclosed in the annual report.

people.name: K. V. Mujumdar
people.since: With the company since 1992; three-year term from September 2025
people.bio: An engineer with a diploma in business management and about 46 years of experience. He spent about 14 years at Hindustan Organic Chemicals before joining Supreme Petrochem in 1992, and was Vice President (Operations) before joining the board. He oversees plant operations and project management. He was paid about ₹1.7cr in FY26.

companies.changes: N. Gopal re-appointed as Manager from 20 Apr 2026 to 31 Mar 2029. No other executive changes filed since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Tata group: Tata Sons holds 31.9% and other Tata companies 6.0%. Chairman S. Padmanabhan (since May 2025, succeeding N. Chandrasekaran) is non-executive. A career Tata team runs it under MD & CEO R. Mukundan; overseas units (US, UK, Kenya) have their own heads.

people.name: R. Mukundan
people.since: Joined Tata Chemicals 2001; now MD & CEO
people.bio: An engineer from IIT Roorkee with an MBA from FMS, Delhi University, and a Harvard Business School alumnus. He joined the Tata Administrative Service in 1990 and Tata Chemicals in 2001, running strategy, corporate planning, quality and manufacturing before becoming COO of the chemicals business and then MD & CEO. He is President of CII for 2026–27 and sits on the boards of Rallis India, Tata International and the overseas subsidiaries. He was paid about ₹8.7cr in FY26.

people.name: Nandakumar S. Tirumalai
people.bio: A commerce graduate of Bangalore University (1991) and a chartered accountant (1994). He worked at ABB, spent 12 years at ITC, was CFO of Reliance Securities (2007–09) and worked at Raymond. He joined the Tata group in 2012 as head of treasury and investor relations at Tata Power and also worked at Titan before becoming CFO here. He has about 28 years of experience in treasury, planning and M&A.

people.name: Narasimha V. Kamath
people.bio: An electrical and electronics engineer from NIT Surathkal with over 34 years in manufacturing. He headed the Mithapur site for six years after roles in its power, chlor-alkali and salt operations, and drove the major capacity expansions there. He now leads global manufacturing, safety and sustainability.

people.name: Alok Chandra
people.bio: A chartered chemical engineer with postgraduate qualifications in HR management (Symbiosis), industrial safety, and ecology and environment. He has over 33 years in chemicals, including ten years at DCM Shriram, about two and a half years at United Phosphorus and six and a half years at SRF, before joining the Tata group in 2010.

people.name: Rajesh V. Kamat
people.bio: A chemical engineer from UDCT (now ICT), Mumbai, with an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad and nearly 30 years in consulting and industry. He started at Tata Strategic Management Group, advising Tata companies on strategy and M&A, and at Tata Chemicals was Vice President and Head of Sales before taking over strategy and projects.

people.name: Rino Raj
people.since: Tata Administrative Service 1996; India manufacturing from July 2026
people.bio: An alumnus of IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad who joined the Tata Administrative Service in 1996. He helped set up Tata AutoComp Systems, worked on strategy at the Tata group centre and was COO of the energy and battery business for over seven years. He was site head at Mithapur and in July 2026 took charge of all the company's Indian plants.

people.name: John Mulhall
people.role: Managing Director, Tata Chemicals North America
people.bio: A University of Strathclyde graduate and member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Scotland. He joined as European Finance Director of Brunner Mond (UK) in 2007, then was CFO of the North America and Singapore operations and group CFO of Tata Chemicals from October 2015 to May 2021, before moving to run the US soda ash business, the group's largest overseas unit.

companies.changes: Chief Marketing Officer Subodh Srivastav retired on 30 Jun 2026. Rino Raj given charge of all Indian plants on 7 Jul 2026. In the UK, Adrian O'Shea (ex-PwC) became country manager on 1 Apr 2026. KPMG resigned as auditor of the UK subsidiaries in Sep 2026 over fees.

companies.styleNote: A founder-family company. Founder Ch. Krishna Murthy is Chairman & MD and his son Ch. Siddartha is Joint MD; his wife Ch. Manjula sits on the board as a non-executive promoter director. The three together own 69.2%. Day-to-day finance is run by a hired CFO.

people.name: Ch. Krishna Murthy
people.relation: Founder; father of Ch. Siddartha; husband of director Ch. Manjula
people.bio: A first-generation entrepreneur who founded the company and has run it for over three decades. He holds a postgraduate degree in management. He took Vishnu from a single-product business to a diversified speciality chemicals maker (chromium, barium and strontium chemicals). CARE Ratings credits him with over 30 years in making, marketing and exporting chromium chemicals.

people.name: Ch. Siddartha
people.since: Joint MD; re-appointed May 2026 to May 2031
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Ch. Krishna Murthy and of director Ch. Manjula
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in biotechnology from Northumbria University (UK) and an MBA from Saginaw Valley State University (USA). He has been with the company for over a decade and leads strategy, international marketing and sourcing. He led the expansion and product diversification, and is also Managing Director of subsidiary Vishnu Barium. Some of the company's loans are backed by his personal guarantee.

people.name: Mahesh Bhatter
people.bio: A chartered accountant and company secretary, with a B.Com (Hons) from the University of Calcutta. He is also a certified treasury manager (ICFAI) and a certified corporate finance professional (Dun & Bradstreet). He joined Vishnu in September 2018 and was made CFO in February 2023. His background is in accounts, corporate finance, forex, treasury, project finance and working capital.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the FY26 annual report. Ch. Siddartha was re-appointed Joint MD for five years from May 2026 by postal ballot.

companies.styleNote: Run by the founding Boob and Sikchi families. Co-founder Siddhartha Sikchi became MD in April 2026; founder Ashok Boob moved to Executive Vice Chairman, and his brother Krishnakumar Boob is a whole-time director. The chairman, Pradeep Rathi, is a non-executive outsider. Promoters own 51.3% after selling about 24% in August 2025.

people.name: Siddhartha Sikchi
people.since: MD since Apr 2026 (co-founder, with the company since 2006)
people.relation: Co-founder; nephew of Ashok Boob (per Forbes India)
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech from UDCT/ICT Mumbai and an M.Sc in organic chemistry from the University of Manitoba, Canada. He joined in December 2006 on returning from Canada and has overseen research and development, the base of the company's in-house catalytic processes. As whole-time director he ran R&D, business development, raw materials and IT before becoming MD in April 2026. He won ICT's Distinguished Alumnus Award (2014) and the ET 40 Under Forty award (2023). He now leads the earnings calls.

people.name: Ashok Boob
people.relation: Founder; brother of Krishnakumar Boob; father of promoter Parth Maheshwari
people.stake: 3.45% (FY26 annual report); Boob family holdings (wife, HUF, son) add about 16%
people.bio: A chemical engineer from UDCT/ICT Mumbai, aged 73. For about 30 years he was a promoter director at Mangalam Drugs and Organics, which he left in 2006 after differences with its owners. He then started Clean Science from a small lab in Vapi at the age of 54 and ran it as MD until March 2026, looking after operations. He won the Lala Shriram National Award (2023) for leadership in the chemical industry.

people.name: Krishnakumar Boob
people.relation: Brother of Ashok Boob
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in pharmacy from the University of Bombay (UDCT) and has more than 27 years in the chemical industry. Like his brother, he previously worked at Mangalam Drugs and Organics. At Clean Science he handles project procurement, general administration, regulatory approvals, compliance and CSR projects. He was re-appointed on retiring by rotation at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Krishnakumar S. Saboo
people.since: Board from Aug 2026 (with the company 11+ years)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. Tech from ICT (University of Bombay) and a chemistry degree from South Gujarat University. He has over 37 years in production planning, process improvement, piloting, project management and plant operations. He has been with Clean Science for more than 11 years, set up its new projects and runs engineering, procurement, production, maintenance and safety. The board co-opted him as a whole-time director from 1 August 2026 for five years.

people.name: Sanjay Parnerkar
people.bio: Joined as CFO in February 2023. Before that he was CFO and Senior Vice President (Finance) at Graphite India from 2015 to 2022. He started his career at Stovec Industries in accounts and administration. His experience covers budgeting, fund raising and dealing with banks.

people.name: Pratik Bora
people.bio: Listed by the company as senior management and one of five executives authorised for stock-exchange disclosures. He earlier served as Vice President (Finance) at Clean Science. He joins the MD and CFO on the earnings calls.

companies.changes: Siddhartha Sikchi became MD and Ashok Boob became Executive Vice Chairman on 1 Apr 2026. K. S. Saboo joined the board as whole-time director on 1 Aug 2026. Senior manager Kothanda Rama Pichaandi resigned in March 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Yogesh Kothari has run the company since 1979 and his son Suneet Kothari is an executive director. From 1 Oct 2026 Yogesh becomes Executive Chairman, and Suneet and long-time professional Kirat Patel become Joint MDs. The Kothari family owns 72.0%.

people.name: Yogesh M. Kothari
people.role: Chairman & Managing Director (Executive Chairman from 1 Oct 2026)
people.relation: Founder; father of Suneet Kothari
people.stake: 57.64% (Aug 2026 postal ballot notice); family and their entities together 72.04%
people.bio: A chemical engineer from UDCT/ICT Mumbai, with a master's in management science and a master's in chemical engineering from the University of Massachusetts, Lowell. He founded Alkyl Amines in 1979 as a first-generation entrepreneur and has over 42 years in the chemical industry. He is a former President of the Indian Chemical Council, which gave him a Lifetime Achievement Award in 2020. He also sits on the boards of the IMC Chamber of Commerce and ICT's incubator. His term runs to March 2030.

people.name: Suneet Y. Kothari
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Yogesh Kothari
people.bio: A chemical engineer and chemistry/biochemistry graduate from Cornell University, with an MBA from INSEAD. He was a management consultant at Diamond Technology Partners before joining the company in 2001. He has led business development, new products, marketing, the commercial side and operations. His term runs to December 2029.

people.name: Kirat M. Patel
people.since: With the company since inception; Executive Director since 1996
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in mechanical engineering from IIT Bombay and an MMS (Finance) from Jamnalal Bajaj Institute, Mumbai. He was a management consultant at A.F. Ferguson & Co. before joining Alkyl Amines at its start. He has over 40 years in operations, commercial work, finance and accounts, and was the company's CFO in the past. He is the board's nodal contact for the auditors. His term runs to December 2029.

people.name: Rakesh Goyal
people.since: Joined Apr 2018 as COO; whole-time director since Jun 2022
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech (Chemical) from IIT Kanpur and a diploma in business management from ICFAI. He has about 32 years in manufacturing, technology transfer, process development and quality. He worked at NOCIL, Hindustan Unilever (manufacturing manager), Dow Chemical (about 10 years), Jesons Industries and National Peroxide (VP Operations) before joining as COO. The company discloses that National Peroxide filed criminal and civil cases against him and other officers alleging financial irregularities; both are pending in court. He is proposed as Executive Director (Operations) from April 2027 to March 2032.

people.name: Kanchan Shinde
people.bio: A chartered accountant with an MBA in finance and over 23 years of post-qualification experience, according to her public profile. She previously worked at Johnson Matthey before joining Alkyl Amines in 2021. She won the Financial Express CFO Award in 2023 in the mid-sized manufacturing category.

companies.changes: Board approved on 4 Aug 2026: Yogesh Kothari to become Executive Chairman and Kirat Patel and Suneet Kothari Joint MDs from 1 Oct 2026 (postal ballot closed 19 Sep 2026); Rakesh Goyal to become Executive Director (Operations) from Apr 2027.

companies.styleNote: A Shroff-family company. Ashwin Shroff (81), with the company since 1965, is Executive Chairman; his sons Ravi (MD) and Hrishit (Executive Director) run the business, supported by a hired President & COO and CFO. Promoters own 51.9%, mostly through the promoter-group company Anshul Specialty Molecules (42.9%), on whose board all three sit. The three were paid about ₹13.7cr in FY26.

people.name: Ashwin C. Shroff
people.relation: Father of Ravi and Hrishit Shroff
people.stake: 0.82% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together 51.9%, mainly via Anshul Specialty Molecules
people.bio: A science graduate (B.Sc.), aged 81, who has worked at Excel since 1 September 1965. As Executive Chairman he sets the group's tone and direction. He also sits on the boards of promoter-group companies Transpek Industry, Anshul Specialty Molecules and Kamaljyot Investments. He received the Indian Chemical Council's Lifetime Achievement Award in 2012. In November 2025 the company sold its stake in Mobitrash Recycle Ventures to him.

people.name: Ravi A. Shroff
people.since: Board since Sep 2014; MD since Sep 2019
people.relation: Son of the Executive Chairman Ashwin Shroff; brother of Hrishit Shroff
people.bio: Holds a BE in chemical engineering from the University of Mumbai and a postgraduate degree in chemistry from Boston University. Before joining Excel he spent seven years as an Executive Director at the promoter-group company Anshul Specialty Molecules. He joined Excel's board in September 2014 and became MD in September 2019. He runs the chemicals division, including the newer pharmaceutical and veterinary API business. He is also a director of Transpek Industry, Anshul Specialty Molecules and Kamaljyot Investments. He was the highest-paid director in FY26 at ₹5.27cr.

people.name: Hrishit A. Shroff
people.since: Joined Feb 2017; Executive Director since Jun 2019
people.relation: Son of the Executive Chairman Ashwin Shroff; brother of Ravi Shroff
people.bio: A commerce graduate and chartered accountant who completed an executive management course at Harvard Business School. He was earlier an Executive Director at Excel Crop Care, with over ten years in agrochemicals and business management. He joined Excel in February 2017 as President of the environment and biotech business and corporate services, and became Executive Director in June 2019. He is also a director of subsidiary Excel Bio Resources, associate Mobitrash Recycle Ventures and Agrocel Industries. He retires by rotation and seeks re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Pradeep Ghattu
people.since: Joined Nov 2004; COO since 2020, President & COO since 2024
people.bio: A long-serving Excel executive, aged 56, with about 33 years of experience. He came from ABB India, where he worked in supply management. At Excel he rose through commercial roles, including heading agro intermediates and serving as Senior Vice President for chemicals, before becoming COO in 2020 and President & COO in 2024. He is named in senior management and sits on the risk management committee.

people.name: Devendra Dosi
people.bio: A chartered accountant, aged 53, with about 29 years of experience. He joined Excel on 1 November 2017 from H R Johnson, a division of Prism Johnson. He was paid ₹1.15cr in FY26.

companies.changes: No change in the top team since the annual report. General Manager (Strategy) Kapil Kashiv resigned in June 2026.

companies.styleNote: Three unrelated co-founders who started the company in 1996 after graduating from MS University, Baroda, still run it: Chintan Shah as Chairman & MD, Ajaykumar Patel and Shekhar Somani as whole-time directors. None of the directors are related to each other. Promoters own 72.0%; the three founders each hold 20–23% directly.

people.name: Chintan N. Shah
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to the other directors
people.bio: A computer engineering graduate (1994) from Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, aged 53. He co-founded Tatva Chintan in 1996 and has over 30 years of experience across business development, R&D, exports, marketing, finance and IT. He is President and a director of Tatva Chintan USA and on the board of Tatva Chintan Europe. His term as MD has been renewed for three years from February 2027 to January 2030, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Ajaykumar M. Patel
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to the other directors
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, aged 54. He co-founded the company in 1996 and has over 30 years of experience, focused on project engineering, development and bringing in new technology. He is a director and treasurer of Tatva Chintan USA and on the board of Tatva Chintan Europe. He is being re-appointed for February 2027 to January 2030.

people.name: Shekhar R. Somani
people.relation: Co-founder; not related to the other directors
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in pharmacy from Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, aged 52. He co-founded the company in 1996 and has over 30 years of experience in domestic business development, production control, quality and supply chain. He is a director and secretary of Tatva Chintan USA and on the board of Tatva Chintan Europe. He is being re-appointed for February 2027 to January 2030.

people.name: Ajesh Pillai
people.bio: A commerce graduate and certified forensic accountant and fraud investigator, with over two decades in finance, accounts and strategic management. He had worked at Tatva Chintan for more than ten years, strengthening its financial systems and internal controls, before being promoted to CFO on 31 October 2025. He replaced Ashok Bothra, who resigned in August 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Ashok Bothra resigned on 30 Aug 2025; Ajesh Pillai became CFO on 31 Oct 2025. No changes since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: A Jhaveri-family company founded in 1985 by Vinod Jhaveri, now Chairman & Executive Director. His sons Parag (MD & CEO) and Yayesh (Whole-time Director) run it, and Parag's son Dishit is Chief Technology Officer. The family owns 67.9%. A hired CFO joined in February 2025.

people.name: Vinod Jhaveri
people.relation: Founder; father of Parag and Yayesh Jhaveri; grandfather of Dishit Jhaveri
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Gujarat University who founded Yasho in 1985. He leads business strategy and plays a key role in overall management. He was re-appointed as Executive Director and Chairman for five years from February 2026.

people.name: Parag Jhaveri
people.since: Board since Apr 1997; MD re-appointed Feb 2026 for 5 years
people.relation: Son of the Chairman Vinod Jhaveri; brother of Yayesh Jhaveri; father of Dishit Jhaveri
people.stake: 10.64% (FY26 annual report); with his wife, son and HUF about 24%
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. in chemistry from Mumbai University and has over 30 years in the chemical industry. As co-founder and MD & CEO he oversees sales, finance, R&D and marketing and sets the company's strategic direction. He was last paid ₹3.89cr a year, and the board has proposed a higher package from April 2026.

people.name: Yayesh Jhaveri
people.since: Board since Oct 2021; re-appointed Feb 2026 for 5 years
people.relation: Son of the Chairman Vinod Jhaveri; brother of Parag Jhaveri
people.stake: 11.26% (FY26 annual report); with his wife and HUF about 21%
people.bio: A commerce graduate from Mumbai University with over 25 years in the chemical industry. As co-founder and whole-time director he oversees purchasing, logistics, supply chain and production planning. He was closely involved in setting up the Unit-II and Unit-III plants. He was last paid ₹3.00cr a year and retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Dishit Jhaveri
people.relation: Son of the MD Parag Jhaveri; grandson of the Chairman
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in chemistry and joined the company on 1 April 2019. The company names him in senior management as Chief Technology Officer. He was paid ₹1.5cr in FY26.

people.name: Chirag Shah
people.bio: A chartered accountant and B.Com graduate from Mumbai University with over 21 years in corporate financial planning, analysis and transformation. He was previously CFO of Galva Decoparts. He joined as CFO on 18 February 2025, replacing Deepak Kaku, who resigned.

companies.changes: Chief HR Officer R. Suresh Kumar left in August 2025. Vinod, Parag and Yayesh Jhaveri were re-appointed for five years from Feb 2026. No changes since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by the founding Reddy family since 1988. Founder A. Prathap Reddy is Executive Chairman; his nephew D. Ram Reddy is MD and his son A. Srinivas Reddy is whole-time director and CFO. N. Rajeshwar Reddy, a co-founder not related to the others, runs the Solapur plants. There is no outside CFO. Promoters own 54.6%.

people.name: A. Prathap Reddy
people.relation: Founder; father of A. Srinivas Reddy; uncle of D. Ram Reddy; father-in-law of G. Hemanth Reddy
people.stake: 15.34% (FY26 annual report); APR Holding and Investments LLP holds another 14.74%; promoter group 54.6%
people.bio: A civil engineer by training who founded Balaji Amines in 1988 with a belief in Indian manufacturing and value-added chemistry, and built it into one of India's leading chemical makers. The company won an award for world-class manufacturing and operational excellence in 2011 under his leadership. He was re-appointed at the August 2025 AGM.

people.name: D. Ram Reddy
people.relation: Nephew of the Chairman A. Prathap Reddy; cousin of A. Srinivas Reddy
people.bio: Has over 38 years of experience and has handled procurement, marketing and logistics at Balaji since 1988. He began his career in 1980 as a manager at Bharat Cement Pipe Industries in Hyderabad. As MD he runs the market-facing side (supply chain, sales and marketing) and built the company's relationships with large domestic and overseas buyers. Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Solapur University gave him a Lifetime Achievement Award in July 2024.

people.name: A. Srinivas Reddy
people.relation: Son of the Chairman A. Prathap Reddy; cousin of the MD D. Ram Reddy
people.bio: Holds a master's degree in computer science and attended the Executive Management Programme at ISB Hyderabad; he is 51. He started as a management consultant at Capgemini and worked with Sprint, Goodyear and Cummins before joining the family business. He has over 25 years of experience, mostly in project management, and leads project development and capital spending while also serving as CFO.

people.name: N. Rajeshwar Reddy
people.relation: Promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: A commerce graduate with over 48 years of cross-industry experience who joined the founding team in 1988. He runs day-to-day operations at the Solapur plants and has led project commissioning, with a focus on building plants cheaply using local engineering.

people.name: G. Hemanth Reddy
people.since: Named on the company's management team
people.relation: Son-in-law of the Chairman A. Prathap Reddy
people.bio: A postgraduate in management (finance and marketing) with over 25 years in business. He manages operations, finance and administration at the Unit-II plant. His earlier work included global projects in water supply, solar energy and rural electrification.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report; the four executive directors were re-appointed at the August 2025 AGM.

companies.styleNote: The Gogri–Shah founding family controls it (41.8%), but from 1 Oct 2026 the three promoter executives step back: Chairman & MD Rajendra Gogri becomes non-executive Chairman, and Vice Chairmen Rashesh Gogri (MD) and Renil Gogri (Executive Director) become non-executive. CEO Suyog Kotecha, a former McKinsey partner hired in 2024, becomes MD & CEO. Founder Chandrakant Gogri is Chairman Emeritus. Rajendra is Renil's father; Rashesh is the brother of non-executive director Hetal Gogri Gala.

people.name: Suyog Kotecha
people.role: CEO & Executive Director (MD & CEO from 1 Oct 2026)
people.stake: 0.01% (FY26 annual report), plus performance stock options
people.bio: A chemical engineer from UDCT/ICT Mumbai with a master's in chemical engineering from the University of Twente (Netherlands) and an MBA from ISB; he is 46. He was a partner at McKinsey & Company, where he led the chemicals practice, and then ran strategy and new businesses in Reliance Industries' petrochemicals division. He joined Aarti as CEO in June 2024, succeeding Rajendra Gogri in that role, and joined the board. He was paid ₹4.78cr in FY26, plus 65,300 performance options, and becomes Managing Director from October 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Ajay Kumar Gupta
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Harcourt Butler Technical University, Kanpur, aged 62. He has more than 35 years in chemicals, petrochemicals and speciality chemicals, across manufacturing and projects, with senior roles at IPCL, Reliance Industries, Grasim Industries and Jubilant Life Sciences. At Aarti, as Chief Manufacturing Officer, he brings expertise in operations, technical services and sustainability. He was paid ₹3.91cr in FY26.

people.name: Manoj M. Chheda
people.relation: Not in the promoter group; not related to other directors
people.bio: A long-serving executive director who has been on the board since November 1993. According to his published profile he has over 35 years in the chemical industry, mainly in process development and project implementation, and has advised on processes, product improvement and technology. He stays an executive director after the October 2026 transition.

people.name: Chetan Gandhi
people.role: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Risk Officer
people.bio: A commerce graduate from the University of Mumbai with a postgraduate diploma in finance from NMIMS. He joined Aarti in 2001 and rose through its finance function before becoming CFO in May 2014. He is also the company's Chief Risk Officer.

people.name: Mirik Gogri
people.relation: Promoter; relative of Chairman Rajendra Gogri (listed in the annual report as a relative of a director)
people.bio: Holds a dual degree in metallurgical engineering from IIT Bombay. The company names him in senior management as Head of Corporate Strategy, and he helped build Aarti's large R&D centre. He also leads Spectrum Impact, the promoters' family office, which invests in climate-technology ventures.

companies.changes: From 1 Oct 2026: Rajendra, Rashesh and Renil Gogri move from executive to non-executive roles, and Suyog Kotecha becomes MD & CEO (subject to shareholder approval at the 2026 AGM).

companies.styleNote: Founder-promoter Anand Desai is MD and his wife Mona Desai is Vice-Chairperson and whole-time director. They are backed by a hired CEO (an ex-Edelweiss investment banker), CFO and COO. The non-executive Chairperson, Dr. Kiran Patel, controls Kiran Pallavi Investments, a promoter-group investor with 31.8%. Promoters held 59.1% in June 2026, before the September 2026 share sale (QIP).

people.name: Anand Desai
people.since: With the company since 1992; director since 2003
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Vice-Chairperson Mona Desai
people.stake: 9.73% (Jun 2026, before the QIP); with his wife about 13%
people.bio: A science graduate (B.Sc.) from Vinoba Bhave University, aged 52. He has been with Anupam Rasayan since 1992 and a director since the company was incorporated in 2003. With over three decades in the chemical industry, he has shaped its growth and oversees overall management and day-to-day operations. He chairs the risk management, sustainability and executive committees. He was re-appointed MD for April 2026 to March 2031.

people.name: Mona Desai
people.relation: Promoter; wife of the MD Anand Desai
people.bio: A promoter with more than two decades in the chemical industry, on the board since 2003. She brings leadership, strategic planning and administrative experience. She was re-appointed whole-time director for April 2026 to March 2031.

people.name: Gopal Agrawal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 22 years of experience at the time of joining, mostly in investment banking. Before Anupam he was Managing Director and head of investment banking at Edelweiss, where he worked on more than 200 deals, including private equity and M&A. He joined as CEO in September 2023.

people.name: Anuj Thakar
people.bio: Holds a PhD and a master's in organic chemistry from Veer Narmad South Gujarat University. He joined Anupam in 2005 and rose to head R&D (process development) before becoming a whole-time director in November 2023. He covers operations, research and development.

people.name: Amit Khurana
people.bio: A chartered accountant who joined Anupam in 2015 as head of indirect taxes and costing. He became CFO in March 2022. His background is in indirect tax, budgeting, cost accounting and risk analysis.

people.name: Ravi Desai
people.bio: A long-time Anupam executive with over 20 years in speciality chemicals. He was Sales Head and a key managerial person before being promoted to COO on 14 August 2026. The COO role gives him a wider operational remit across the business.

companies.changes: Ravi Desai became COO on 14 Aug 2026. Deputy CFO Vishal Thakkar resigned in May 2026; President (Projects) Himanshu Bhatt left in June 2025.

companies.styleNote: The Goenka family controls it (69.3%, mostly through Yellow Stone Trust, of which Ravi Goenka is a trustee). Ravi Goenka is Executive Chairman. The hired MD & CEO, ex-BASF executive Rajan Venkatesh, resigned in September 2026, and Ravi's son Harshvardhan Goenka takes over as MD & CEO from 14 Nov 2026. The rest of the team is professional, but the CFO, CTO and procurement chief have all left in 2026.

people.name: Ravi Goenka
people.relation: Father of Harshvardhan Goenka
people.stake: 0.65% directly (Jun 2026); family together 69.3%, mostly via Yellow Stone Trust (63.7%)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from Bengaluru University. He has been with Laxmi since its inception and has over 34 years in chemicals and paper, plus long experience in power and education. He is a director of International Knowledge Park, which runs Ecole Mondiale World School and Russell Square International College. He was a trustee of the Mumbai Port Trust and JNPT and President of the Indian Chemical Council's executive committee from 2020 to 2022.

people.name: Harshvardhan Goenka
people.relation: Son of the Executive Chairman Ravi Goenka; nephew of non-executive director Rajeev Goenka
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in economics and business management from Babson College, Boston, and is doing executive education at Harvard Business School; he is 37. He joined Laxmi in 2011 and led its shift from bulk to speciality chemicals, and on the board he has focused on capital allocation, acquisitions and diversification. He was interim CFO from April to June 2026. He is a member of YPO and the Indian Chemical Council. The board has named him MD & CEO for five years from 14 November 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Amit Jain
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over three decades in finance. He began in consulting and then worked in pharmaceuticals, packaging and chemicals, covering business partnering, investor relations, M&A, accounting and budgeting. He joined as CFO on 16 June 2026, after the previous CFO resigned in April.

people.name: Jitendra Agarwal
people.bio: A chartered accountant with over 30 years across finance, global procurement, supply chain, sales and operations. He spent two decades at the packaging company Huhtamaki in leadership roles before joining Laxmi in June 2018. He runs the Essentials business and has led capacity expansion and new products there.

people.name: Virag Shah
people.bio: Holds master's degrees in applied chemistry and business administration from Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda, with more than two decades in the field. He joined Laxmi in July 2020 and runs the Specialities business, including new product launches and contract manufacturing (CDMO).

people.name: Susheel Mittal
people.bio: Holds an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad and a B.Sc. (Hons) in agriculture from G.B. Pant University of Agriculture & Technology. He has over 26 years of experience, with senior roles at BASF, Marico and Corteva AgriScience in India, Germany and Hong Kong.

people.name: Prateek Singh
people.bio: Holds an MBA in HR from IMT Ghaziabad and a mechanical engineering degree from Madan Mohan Malaviya University of Technology, with over 19 years in HR. He was earlier CHRO at Integrace (a True North company) and held several HR roles at Marico, GSK Consumer Healthcare and TCS E-Serve.

companies.changes: MD & CEO Rajan Venkatesh resigned on 8 Sep 2026 (leaves 13 Nov 2026); Harshvardhan Goenka succeeds him from 14 Nov 2026. CFO Mahadeo Karnik resigned in Apr 2026 (Amit Jain CFO from 16 Jun 2026). CTO Salil Mukundan and Chief Procurement Officer Keshav Ruthiya resigned in Aug 2026 (leaving 31 Oct 2026) and will not be replaced like-for-like.

companies.styleNote: A Mafatlal-group company: the promoter Vishad Mafatlal is Executive Chairman, but a hired MD, Nitin Kulkarni, and professional business CEOs run the company. Promoters own 27.1%, mostly through Mafatlal Impex Pvt Ltd (25.4%); Vishad Mafatlal holds about 1.4% in his own name and through a family trust.

people.name: Vishad P. Mafatlal
people.relation: Promoter (Mafatlal family); not related to other directors
people.stake: 0.64% directly plus 0.75% as trustee of a family trust (Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together 27.1%
people.bio: Vishad Mafatlal holds a BS in Economics from the Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania. He has more than 29 years of experience in textiles and chemicals as a Mafatlal-group industrialist. He chairs the Shri Sadguru Seva Sangh Trust and the Board of Governors of IIIT Lucknow, and received the Mahatma Award 2025 for leadership in business sustainability.

people.name: Nitin G. Kulkarni
people.bio: Nitin Kulkarni holds a master's in organic chemistry from the University of Mumbai and has over three decades in specialty chemicals, especially fluorochemicals and contract manufacturing. He worked at Navin Fluorine earlier for seven years heading business development and helped build its specialty chemicals business. For more than a decade before returning he was Executive Director of OC Specialty, which he helped build into a global specialty chemical and contract-manufacturing player. He became MD in June 2024.

people.name: Anish P. Ganatra
people.bio: Anish Ganatra is a Chartered Accountant with close to three decades in finance, strategy, risk, planning and business transformation in India and abroad. Before joining Navin Fluorine in February 2023 he worked at Reliance Industries, BP, Castrol India, ICICI Prudential Life Insurance and PricewaterhouseCoopers.

people.name: Partha Roychowdhury
people.since: Worked at Navin 1995–2016 (last as CFO); now CEO of HPP
people.bio: Partha Roychowdhury is a Chartered Accountant with over three decades in the chemical industry. He worked at Navin Fluorine from 1995 to 2016, ending as its CFO, and later returned to lead the High Performance Products business, which combines the refrigerant gas, inorganic fluoride and newer high-performance product lines.

people.name: Dr. Vijay Kaiwar
people.bio: Dr. Vijay Kaiwar holds a PhD in organic chemistry from IICT Hyderabad and did post-doctoral research at King's College London. He has nearly 30 years in contract manufacturing and APIs across R&D, technology transfer, plants, projects and business development, with senior roles at Anthem Biosciences, Sun Pharma, Aurobindo Pharma and Jubilant Organosys. He replaced Rajendra Sahu, who left in September 2025.

people.name: Niraj B. Mankad
people.bio: Niraj Mankad holds a B.Com from Mumbai University, a law degree from Kishinchand Chellaram Law College and is a qualified Company Secretary. He has over three decades in legal and corporate affairs and has been with the Mafatlal Group since 1993. He is a key managerial person.

companies.changes: CDMO CEO Rajendra Sahu left in Sep 2025 (Vijay Kaiwar took over); HR head Pankaj Lochan left in Feb 2026 and Vinod Shetty (ex-Teva) joined as CHRO on 21 May 2026. The CEO post for the specialty chemicals business is vacant.

companies.styleNote: An INOX group company run by the Jain family: Vivek Jain is Chairman & MD, supported by a professional Deputy MD & CEO, Dr. Bir Kapoor. His father and group founder Devendra Kumar Jain died in Dec 2025. Promoters own 61.4%, mainly through Inox Leasing and Finance (52.6%), which a pending scheme would merge into GFL.

people.name: Vivek Kumar Jain
people.since: MD since the company's inception; Chairman since Feb 2026
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Devendra Kumar Jain
people.stake: 0.04% directly (Jun 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together 61.4%, mostly via Inox Leasing and Finance
people.bio: Vivek Jain is a graduate of St. Stephen's College, Delhi and an alumnus of IIM Ahmedabad. He has more than 34 years of business experience setting up and running several INOX group businesses and has been MD of Gujarat Fluorochemicals since it was formed. He became Chairman on 12 Feb 2026 after his father's death, while keeping the MD role.

people.name: Dr. Bir Kapoor
people.since: CEO since Sep 2021; Deputy MD since Nov 2023 (re-appointed for three years from Nov 2026)
people.bio: Dr. Bir Kapoor, aged 61, is a chemical engineer from IIT Kanpur with a PhD in chemical engineering from the City University of New York, and attended Harvard's Advanced Management Program. He spent the first ten years of his career in the US, then worked at Hindustan Unilever and for about 18 years at the Aditya Birla Group, where he last ran a business across three South-East Asian countries and China. He joined GFL as CEO in September 2021 and is co-inventor on 12 patent applications.

people.name: Niraj Kishore Agnihotri
people.since: Board since Nov 2025 (re-appointed for one year from Nov 2026)
people.bio: Niraj Agnihotri, aged 59, is a chemical engineer from HBTI Kanpur with over 35 years of experience in manufacturing, plant commissioning and operation, new product validation, project management and planning.

people.name: Jignesh Kantilal Parmar
people.bio: Jignesh Parmar, aged 50, is a chemical engineering graduate with 29 years in chemical manufacturing, process optimisation, plant operations, quality and safety. He has worked at GFL for about three years and heads the Ranjitnagar plant. He joined the board on 12 Aug 2026 after Shesh Narayan Pandey resigned.

people.name: Manoj Agrawal
people.bio: Manoj Agrawal is a Chartered Accountant who cleared all levels at the first attempt by age 21, and a B.Com from Nagpur University. He has nearly 30 years of experience in chemicals and manufacturing, with senior finance roles at Hardcastle & Waud, Blue Star and Gujarat Fluorochemicals.

companies.changes: Founder-chairman Devendra Kumar Jain died on 29 Dec 2025; Vivek Jain became Chairman & MD on 12 Feb 2026. Whole-time director Shesh Narayan Pandey resigned for personal reasons from 12 Aug 2026 and Jignesh Parmar replaced him. Whole-time directors Sanath Kumar Muppirala and Sunil Kumar Singh Chauhan left during FY26.

companies.styleNote: A joint venture of the Tamil Nadu government's TIDCO and Anupam Rasayan, which together own 48.7% (Jun 2026). No family runs it: the board chair is a TIDCO nominee (Dr. D. Karthikeyan from Sep 2026) and the MD, Afzal Malkani, is Anupam Rasayan's former CFO.

people.name: Afzal Harunbhai Malkani
people.since: Jan 2026 (five-year term); earlier a non-executive director
people.bio: Afzal Malkani is an associate member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India with about 25 years in manufacturing, covering corporate finance, investments, M&A, strategy, fund-raising, treasury and legal work. He was CFO of Anupam Rasayan India, the co-promoter, and sits on the board of ARIL Fluorospeciality. He moved from non-executive director to MD on 9 Jan 2026 and is leading the ₹495cr downstream expansion and the fund-raising.

people.name: Hemango Gupta
people.since: COO from Feb 2025; CEO since Jul 2025
people.bio: Hemango Gupta is a graduate of IIT Varanasi with a PGDBM in marketing from the International Management Institute, New Delhi. He has more than two decades in chemicals as head of strategy, business development and marketing. His last job was Senior Vice President (Sales and Marketing) at SRF Ltd. He joined Tanfac as COO in February 2025 and became CEO in July 2025.

people.name: Dr. L. Ravichandran
people.since: May 2026 (two-year term); with Tanfac for over 40 years
people.bio: Dr. L. Ravichandran holds a PhD in chemistry and has spent more than four decades at Tanfac across operations, production, maintenance, quality, safety, environment, R&D and new products. The company credits him with developing and commercialising several new products. He joined the board as whole-time director in May 2026.

people.name: N. R. Ravichandran
people.bio: N. R. Ravichandran is President & CFO and speaks for the company on its results calls. His education and earlier employers are not disclosed on the company website or in the filings reviewed.

companies.changes: MD K. Sendhil Naathan died in Apr 2025; Afzal Malkani became MD in Jan 2026. Dr. L. Ravichandran joined as whole-time director in May 2026. The chair passed from Sandhya Venugopal Sharma (IAS) to Dr. D. Karthikeyan, both TIDCO nominees, in Sep 2026. The FY26 annual report could not be read, so individual shareholdings are not given.

companies.styleNote: A founder-family company: Shazad Rustomji is Chairman, MD & CEO; his wife Manisha and son Rohan are executive directors. Promoters own 47.8%, almost all in Shazad's name, down from 67.9% in Mar 2025 after a stake sale and the rights issue. The CFO is a former independent director of the company.

people.name: Shazad Sheriar Rustomji
people.since: Director since Sep 2002 (founder); CEO since Nov 2023
people.relation: Founder; husband of Manisha Rustomji; father of Rohan Rustomji
people.stake: 47.77% (5.55 crore shares; FY26 annual report and Jun 2026 pattern); family together 47.8%
people.bio: Shazad Rustomji finished junior college at Mithibai College, Mumbai in 1988 and began in business during college with a seafood export venture, Stallion Exports. He has over 30 years in refrigerants and specialty chemicals and built the company step by step from the early 2000s. He runs day-to-day operations and is steering the company from refrigerant trading towards its own R-32 plant.

people.name: Manisha Shazad Rustomji
people.relation: Promoter; wife of Shazad Rustomji; mother of Rohan Rustomji
people.bio: Manisha Rustomji, aged 53, holds a diploma in fashion design (1995–96) and a certificate in alternative medicine from the Indian Board of Alternative Medicine. She is the company's public relations manager with about 10 years in PR and leads its CSR work. She retires by rotation at the 2026 AGM and is proposed for re-appointment.

people.name: Rohan Shazad Rustomji
people.relation: Promoter; son of Shazad and Manisha Rustomji
people.bio: Rohan Rustomji, in his late twenties, completed a Level 5 BTEC at RIMS International School of Business and Technology and, at the time of the January 2025 IPO, was studying for an online BBA from the University of Derby, UK. He looks after imports and banking for the company.

people.name: Geetu Yadav
people.stake: 50.3 lakh shares, about 4.3% (FY26 annual report); not a promoter
people.bio: Geetu Yadav holds a master's in computer science and an MCA from Maharishi Dayanand University, Rohtak (2009 and 2010), and an LLB from Himachal Pradesh University (2017). She works across production, supply chain, imports, sales and finance and leads the evaluation and launch of new products. At the 2025 IPO she was paid ₹16.5 lakh a month, more than the founder's wife and son (₹2.5–5 lakh).

people.name: Virenderkumar Mehta
people.since: Apr 2025 (until then an independent director of the company)
people.bio: Virenderkumar Mehta holds a BSc and an MA from Rajasthan University. He served in the Ministry of Finance as Assistant Commissioner of Customs, Excise and GST and has over 25 years in indirect tax; he later advised businesses on indirect tax. He was an independent director of Stallion from July 2023 and resigned from the board on 8 Apr 2025 to become CFO the same day, which is unusual.

companies.changes: Independent director Gautam Lath resigned in Apr 2026 citing other commitments; Swati Ghosh joined as independent director in May 2026. No executive changes since the FY26 annual report.

companies.styleNote: A Shah-family company founded in 1974 by Dr. Vinod Shah. After the 2025 demerger his son Nirmal V. Shah became Chairman & MD of this company, while his brother Sameer V. Shah runs the other half (Chembond Material Technologies) and sits here as a non-executive director. Promoters own about 68%.

people.name: Nirmal V. Shah
people.since: Chairman & MD since 1 June 2025; director since Dec 2023
people.relation: Promoter; son of founder Dr. Vinod Shah; brother of non-executive director Sameer V. Shah
people.bio: Nirmal Shah, 55, holds a Diploma in Business Management and has about 32 years of experience in the Chembond group. Before the demerger he was Vice-Chairman and Managing Director of the old Chembond Chemicals (now Chembond Material Technologies). He took over as Chairman & MD of the demerged company from June 2025, and is its only executive director. In the demerger the two brothers swapped holdings, lifting his stake here from 13.35% to 25.99% while Sameer's fell to 1.45%. The family also influences Finor Piplaj Chemicals, a group supplier, so related-party purchases are worth watching. His FY26 pay was ₹1.03cr.

people.name: Prachi Mahadik
people.bio: Prachi Mahadik was appointed CFO from 1 April 2025, when the demerged company was set up as a separate listed entity. She is one of three key managerial personnel alongside the Chairman & MD and the Company Secretary. The annual report does not give her education or earlier career.

people.name: Kiran Mukadam
people.bio: Kiran Mukadam was appointed Company Secretary and Compliance Officer from 6 May 2025 and is a key managerial personnel. He handles shareholder and exchange matters. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No executive changes found since the FY26 annual report (16 May 2026). Sameer V. Shah moved to a non-executive role here after the demerger.

companies.styleNote: The founding promoters (U. Shekhar, G. Ramakrishnan, the Shanbhag and Patil families) own about 71% but are not in day-to-day management; U. Shekhar and G. Ramakrishnan sit as non-executive directors. The company is run by long-serving professional managers, and the chairman, Kanwar Bir Singh Anand, is independent. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: K. Natarajan
people.stake: 9,600 shares jointly with his wife (about 0.03%) (FY26 AGM notice)
people.bio: K. Natarajan, 61, has a commerce degree from the University of Mumbai, is a cost accountant (ICWAI) and has done the Advanced Management Programme at Harvard Business School. He joined Galaxy in April 1993 and has headed finance, IT, business creation, business commercial, global sourcing and supply chain. He became Executive Director and COO in October 2016 and Managing Director from February 2024. He also sits on the boards of the Egyptian and US subsidiaries, including TRI-K Industries. His FY26 pay was ₹3.23cr, and he was granted 23,630 performance options in 2025 vesting in August 2028.

people.name: Vaijanath Kulkarni
people.bio: Vaijanath Kulkarni is a chemical engineer and has done the Advanced Management Programme at Harvard Business School. He has been with Galaxy since 1995 and is now Executive Director and COO. He also chairs the Risk Management Committee as Chief Risk Officer. His FY26 pay was ₹2.85cr, and he received 23,630 performance options in 2025 vesting in August 2028.

people.name: Abhijit Damle
people.bio: Abhijit Damle became CFO in July 2022, succeeding K. Ganesh Kamat on his retirement. Before that he was Galaxy's Head of RMU & CG (resource mobilisation, finance and corporate governance). Earlier he was finance head at LANXESS India. He is a University of Mumbai graduate.

people.name: Niranjan Ketkar
people.bio: Niranjan Ketkar is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and is listed among senior management. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: Rajib Bhattacharjee (VP – Value Acceleration, senior management) resigned on 15 May 2026. Viju Jose joined as VP – Business Creation (July 2025) and Narendra Kumar Saini as Chief Digital Officer (March 2026).

companies.styleNote: Run by its two unrelated co-founders: Edward Menezes (Executive Chairman) and Sunil Chari (MD). Each founder's son now heads a business unit as senior management. Promoters own about 68%.

people.name: Edward Menezes
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since inception
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; father of Mikhail Menezes
people.stake: 29.30% including the Menezes Family Trust (FY26 annual report); Menezes family about 31.4%
people.bio: Edward Menezes has a B.Sc. in chemistry from K. J. Somaiya College (University of Bombay), a B.Sc. (Tech) in textile chemistry from UDCT, and a master's in marketing management from Welingkar Institute. Before co-founding Rossari he worked at Clariant India (formerly Sandoz) in technical services, product development and business development. He has over 40 years in specialty chemicals and remains closely involved in day-to-day operations. His awards include the Hurun India Industry Achievement Award (2022) and the UDCT Distinguished Alumnus award (2013).

people.name: Sunil Chari
people.since: Co-founder; on the board since inception
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; father of Yash Chari; not related to Edward Menezes
people.stake: 22.39% including the Chari Family Trust (FY26 annual report); Chari family about 31%
people.bio: Sunil Chari holds a B.A. from Kakatiya University and a diploma in technical and applied chemistry from VJTI, Mumbai. He has over 35 years of experience, earlier in textile processing and dyestuffs, and co-founded Rossari. As MD he runs daily operations and strategy, and built the sales and distribution network. In FY26 he moved about 9% of his direct holding into the Chari Family Trust and to family members, including his son Yash. VJTI and ICT have honoured him as a distinguished alumnus.

people.name: Ketan Sablok
people.bio: Ketan Sablok is a Fellow Chartered Accountant and a Cost Accountant, with a B.Com (Hons) from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata. He has over 25 years in finance and was earlier CFO of Navin Fluorine International; before that he worked at Shaw Wallace. He joined Rossari as Group CFO in November 2021 and leads finance, treasury, planning, tax and IT, reporting to the MD.

people.name: Mikhail Menezes
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman Edward Menezes
people.bio: Mikhail Menezes has a master's in chemical engineering from Imperial College London and joined Rossari after graduating. He heads the animal health and nutrition (AHN) and textile businesses and sits on the Risk Management Committee. His FY26 pay was ₹98.8 lakh, approved as a related-party 'office of profit'.

people.name: Yash Chari
people.relation: Son of MD Sunil Chari
people.stake: 4.45% (FY26 annual report), up from 0.30% after a family transfer
people.bio: Yash Chari has a bachelor's in chemical engineering from the University of South Florida and joined Rossari after his studies. He heads the acquired Unitop and Tristar businesses. His FY26 pay was ₹65.6 lakh, approved as a related-party 'office of profit'.

people.name: Puneet Arora
people.role: Business Head – Global Textile & Strategies (senior management)
people.bio: Puneet Arora holds a B.Com from Ambedkar College, University of Bombay, and has been with Rossari since its incorporation. He earlier led M&A and global textile exports, and now heads global textile and strategy.

people.name: Prasad Gadkari
people.bio: Prasad Gadkari holds a diploma in business management from Nagpur University and has been with Rossari since its incorporation. He runs manufacturing operations across the plants.

companies.changes: No KMP changes in FY26 or since. Chief HR Officer Sunil V. resigned in May 2025. Company Secretary is Parul Gupta.

companies.styleNote: Run by its two promoters, Chairman & MD Mahesh Babani and Executive Director D. B. Rao, who are not related to each other; the Babani and Doppalapudi families and their investment companies own 60.6% after selling 9.3% in December 2025. Privi Fine Sciences, owned by the promoters, is being merged in for shares.

people.name: Mahesh P. Babani
people.since: Board since 11 May 2017 (after Privi merged into the listed company); founder of Privi
people.relation: Promoter
