people.stake: 6.62% directly plus 4.59% through his HUF (FY26 annual report); promoter group together 60.60%
people.bio: Mahesh Babani, 68, is a commerce graduate with over 40 years of operational and managerial experience. He built Privi from a start-up into one of the world's larger pine-based aroma chemical makers. He sets long-term strategy, business development and financial management, and has travelled the globe for three decades building ties with fragrance houses and suppliers. He also sits on the boards of subsidiaries Prigiv Specialties and Privi Biotechnologies, and of the promoter-owned Privi Fine Sciences. His FY26 pay was ₹6cr, with a 10% rise approved for FY27.

people.name: D. B. Rao (Bhaktavatsala Rao Doppalapudi)
people.since: Board since 11 May 2017; re-appointed for 13 Aug 2026 – 12 Aug 2029
people.relation: Co-promoter; not related to Mahesh Babani
people.stake: 2.17% (FY26 annual report), down from 3.96% after the December 2025 block sale; his family holds about 5.4% more
people.bio: D. B. Rao, 80, is a postgraduate in engineering with over 50 years of experience. He runs operations, R&D, personnel and raw-material sourcing, and built the company's plants quickly and at low cost. He takes a close interest in R&D, especially green technologies. He is also a director of Privi Biotechnologies and of Vivira Investments & Trading, the largest promoter holding company (29.7%). His FY26 pay was ₹24 lakh; the new term allows up to ₹2.1cr a year.

people.name: R. S. Rajan
people.bio: R. S. Rajan is President and has been classified as senior management since August 2020. He is a long-serving member of the core team. The annual report gives no further background.

people.name: Narayan S. Iyer
people.bio: Narayan Iyer has been CFO since August 2020 and also handles investor relations and the earnings calls. He was earlier Senior Vice President – Finance at Privi. The annual report gives no education details.

people.name: Ashwini Saumil Shah
people.bio: Ashwini Shah has been Company Secretary and Compliance Officer since November 2022. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No changes in KMP or senior management in FY26 or since. D. B. Rao re-appointed for three years from 13 Aug 2026 (AGM approval).

companies.styleNote: A family company (set up in 1973) run by father and son: Padam Kumar Agarwala is Chairman & MD and his son Varun Agarwal is Joint MD. The two of them own about 68%, and promoters 77.15% in all.

people.name: Padam Kumar Agarwala
people.since: Director since 13 March 1995; business head for 12+ years before that
people.relation: Promoter; father of Joint MD Varun Agarwal
people.bio: Padam Kumar Agarwala has a commerce degree from St. Xavier's College, Kolkata. He worked in the company as a business head for more than 12 years before joining the board in 1995, and has over 40 years in industrial gases. He oversees the eastern region, sets strategy and governance, and is also a director of family companies including Ellenbarrie Cryogenics, Ellenbarrie Agro Products and several tea businesses. He and Varun have personally guaranteed some of the company's loans.

people.name: Varun Agarwal
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Padam Kumar Agarwala
people.bio: Varun Agarwal holds a B.Sc. in economics from the London School of Economics and an M.Phil. from the University of Cambridge. He began his career at Lehman Brothers before joining the family company in 2008, and has over 15 years of experience. He runs the southern region and focuses on financial performance and growth strategy. He delivered the AGM statement alongside his father in September 2026.

people.name: K. Srinivas Prasad
people.since: Joined Dec 2013 as Controller – Finance; CFO since 1 Nov 2014
people.bio: K. Srinivas Prasad has a commerce degree from BJB College, Bhubaneswar (Utkal University). He is a chartered accountant and company secretary (ICAI and ICSI associate) and has qualified as a cost accountant. Before Ellenbarrie he worked at Air Liquide North India. He joined in December 2013 and became CFO in November 2014.

people.name: Sanjay Basak
people.bio: Sanjay Basak holds an M.Tech in cryogenic engineering from IIT Kharagpur and did an executive programme in operations management at IIM Calcutta. He earlier worked at BOC India and Bhushan Steel. He joined in 2016 and heads projects and engineering.

people.name: Aditya Keshri
people.bio: Aditya Keshri is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He earlier worked at Alcove Developers, Grameen Shakti Microfinance and Jiwanram Sheoduttrai Industries, and joined in March 2024.

companies.changes: No KMP changes in FY26. Sujoy Sen was appointed Chief Information Officer (senior management) from 1 Aug 2026. Subir Sen is GM – HR (senior management).

companies.styleNote: The Vaze family runs Keva: third-generation Kedar Vaze is Whole-time Director & Group CEO. His father Ramesh Vaze, the non-executive Chairman and a master perfumer, died on 15 Sep 2026; his mother Prabha Vaze is a non-executive director. Promoters own 54.87%, with about 50 lakh promoter shares pledged. No new chairman had been named as of 29 Sep 2026.

people.name: Kedar Vaze
people.role: Whole-time Director & Group Chief Executive Officer
people.since: With Keva since Oct 1996; Group CEO since 2014; re-appointed 1 Sep 2025 – 31 Aug 2028
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late Chairman Ramesh Vaze and of director Prabha Vaze
people.stake: 9.44% (1,30,60,131 shares, FY26 annual report); promoter group together 54.87%
people.bio: Kedar Vaze holds an M.Sc. in chemistry from IIT Bombay and completed Stanford's Global Managers Program. He joined the family business in October 1996 and worked as Chief Technology Officer and then Group COO before becoming Group CEO in 2014. He is a trained perfumer with several fragrance and flavour patents. His FY26 pay was ₹4.4cr; shareholders were asked to waive recovery of excess pay he received for FY25.

people.name: Jagdish Agarwal
people.bio: Jagdish Agarwal has over 28 years in finance across manufacturing, telecom and banking. He was Executive Director and CFO of Huhtamaki India for about four years, and before that spent over 15 years at Owens Corning India in finance roles including CFO. Earlier he worked at Reliance Communications and ICICI Bank. He joined Keva as Group CFO in December 2025 after a four-month gap filled by an interim CFO.

people.name: B. Ramkrishnan
people.bio: B. Ramkrishnan heads the fragrance business in Asia and the USA and is listed first among senior management. The annual report does not give his background.

people.name: Amit Gulati
people.role: Chief Operating Officer – Asia (Fragrance & Flavours) (senior management)
people.bio: Amit Gulati is COO for fragrance and flavours in Asia and is part of the senior management team. The annual report does not give his background.

people.name: Deepti Chandratre
people.since: Joined 11 April 2025; Company Secretary since 1 May 2025
people.bio: Deepti Chandratre joined as Global Legal Counsel in April 2025 and became Company Secretary and Compliance Officer from May 2025. She also served as interim CFO from 7 Oct to 1 Dec 2025, between the exit of Rohit Saraogi and the arrival of Jagdish Agarwal.

companies.changes: Chairman Ramesh Vaze died on 15 Sep 2026; no successor announced yet. CFO Rohit Saraogi left on 30 Jul 2025 and Group CHRO Nishant Kolgaonkar in Apr 2025. Ranjeet Agrawal joined as EVP – Sales (India subcontinent) on 20 Aug 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Tibrewala family company: founder Surendrakumar Tibrewala is Chairman & MD, his son Sanjay is Executive Director & CFO and his daughter Aarti Jhunjhunwala is an Executive Director. The three family members are the only executives listed as senior management. Promoters own about 62%.

people.name: Surendrakumar Tibrewala
people.relation: Founder-promoter; father of Sanjay Tibrewala and Aarti Jhunjhunwala
people.stake: 52.28% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 62%
people.bio: Surendrakumar Tibrewala, son of the late Deviprasad Tibrewala, holds a commerce degree from R. A. Poddar College (University of Mumbai) and a law degree from Government Law College. He started in specialty chemicals at 20 and has over four decades of experience making chemicals and enzymes for textiles, construction, water treatment, leather, paper and paints. As Chairman & MD he sets the long-term strategy. He chairs the board's Administrative Committee, which handles day-to-day business matters and is made up only of the three family executives.

people.name: Sanjay Tibrewala
people.since: Promoter since inception; re-appointed for 1 Oct 2025 – 30 Sep 2030
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD; brother of Aarti Jhunjhunwala
people.bio: Sanjay Tibrewala graduated from Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics (University of Mumbai) in 2001 and then studied textile processing and chemistry at SASMIRA, Mumbai. He has been with the company since inception and has over two decades in textile chemicals. As Executive Director and CFO he leads new markets and the product range. The company moved into oilfield chemicals by buying US-based CrudeChem in December 2025. His pay matches his father's (both 23.9 times the median employee).

people.name: Aarti Jhunjhunwala
people.relation: Daughter of the Chairman & MD; sister of Sanjay Tibrewala
people.bio: Aarti Jhunjhunwala, 42, holds a master's in accounts and taxation from Narsee Monjee College. She has over 16 years in the business, covering business development, sales, branding and global alliances, and led the push into international textile markets. She won the 'Women at Work Leadership Award' at the Asia Pacific HRM Congress. Her FY26 pay was ₹1.07cr, up 24%.

people.name: Sunny Parmar
people.bio: Sunny Parmar is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and the only non-family member of senior management. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No changes in KMP or senior management in FY26 or since the annual report. Independent director Navin Mittal completed his term in Sep 2025.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of Germany's BASF SE, which owns 73.33%. It is run by BASF group executives on rotation: a German MD, a long-serving BASF finance head as CFO and a manufacturing head, all whole-time directors. The chairman, Pradip P. Shah, is non-executive. No directors are related to each other.

people.name: Alexander Gerding
people.bio: Alexander Gerding, born in Bremen in 1979, joined BASF in 2000 through a dual-study programme and earned an MBA from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro in 2005. He has held roles in Argentina, the US and Germany, mostly in crop protection; before India he was Vice President, Business Management for Agricultural Solutions, EMEA East (from 2019). He chairs the Risk Management Committee. His background is in the agri business that is now being demerged into BASF Agricultural Solutions India. His FY26 pay was ₹9.97cr, including BASF SE share-based incentives.

people.name: Narendranath J. Baliga
people.since: CFO since 1 Jan 2015; whole-time director 1 Jan 2025 – 30 Jun 2027
people.bio: Narendranath Baliga is a chartered accountant and a business management graduate from Mysore University. He joined BASF in 1994 and has worked in India, Singapore, China and Germany in finance, controlling, supply chain and process and enterprise architecture. He has been CFO of BASF India since 2015 and also heads Global Business Services. He joined the board as a whole-time director in January 2025. His FY26 pay was ₹3.46cr.

people.name: Anil Kumar Choudhary
people.bio: Anil Kumar Choudhary has a bachelor's in mechanical engineering and a postgraduate qualification in marketing management. He joined BASF in 2004 and was Managing Director of BASF Catalysts India and then Business Director for Performance Materials. He now oversees all manufacturing sites (as Occupier under the Factories Act) and the materials, industrial solutions and surface technologies segments. His FY26 pay was ₹3.04cr.

people.name: Manohar Kamath
people.role: Director – Legal, General Counsel (India) & Company Secretary
people.bio: Manohar Kamath is BASF India's general counsel and Company Secretary and sits on the management committee. He is secretary to the board committees. The annual report gives no further background.

companies.changes: No executive changes in FY26 or since. Non-executive BASF nominee Marcelo R. Lu resigned on 30 Nov 2025 and was replaced by Andrew Postlethwaite. Sunita Sule is the fifth member of the management committee.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Prayasvin Patel is Chairman & Managing Director. His son-in-law Aayush Shah becomes an executive director from 1 October 2026, and his brother-in-law Pradip Patel sits on the board as a non-executive director. Hired professionals run finance and the two divisions. Promoters own about 59%.

people.name: Prayasvin B. Patel
people.since: Board since 1983; MD from 1993, CMD from 2006; re-appointed for 3 years from 1 July 2026
people.relation: Promoter; father-in-law of Aayush Shah; brother-in-law of director Pradip Patel
people.stake: 1.75% (39,25,864 shares, FY26 annual report); promoters together about 59%
people.bio: Prayasvin Patel has a mechanical engineering degree from Sardar Patel University and an MBA from Loyola University Chicago. He began as sales director of Prayas Casting, joined Elecon as joint managing director, became managing director in 1993 and chairman & managing director in 2006. He built the gear division into what the company calls Asia's largest industrial gear maker and led its first overseas acquisition, Benzlers-Radicon, bought from David Brown Gear Systems. He is also an executive director of the listed Eimco Elecon (India) and a director of several Elecon group companies. His FY26 pay included a ₹15cr commission.

people.name: Aayush A. Shah
people.since: Board since April 2023 (non-executive); executive director from 1 October 2026
people.relation: Son-in-law of the Chairman & MD, Prayasvin Patel
people.bio: Aayush Shah has a mechanical engineering degree from the Georgia Institute of Technology in the US. He is chief executive and executive director of Power Build Private Limited, an Elecon group company. He joined Elecon's board as a non-executive director in April 2023. The board made him an executive director from 1 October 2026 so he can take on more day-to-day operating work, which the company describes as part of its leadership continuity plan. He was born in 1994.

people.name: Chintan J. Shah
people.bio: Chintan Shah became CFO on 15 April 2026, replacing Narasimhan Raghunathan, who left on 31 January 2026. He has about 19 years in finance and accounts, with experience in Big Four consulting, IT services, engineering, medical devices and chemicals. His work has covered financial strategy, risk management, project monitoring, listing compliance and investor relations.

people.name: Dipak S. Dalwadi
people.bio: Dipak Dalwadi took charge of the gear division, Elecon's main business, on 1 August 2025, replacing Man Mohan Nanda at the end of his tenure. He is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report. The company has not published his education or earlier career.

people.name: Kaushik M. Patel
people.bio: Kaushik Patel has run the material handling equipment division since 27 May 2025, replacing Pranav Kumar Bhasin. In FY26 the division's revenue grew about 44% to ₹667cr as it shifted towards product supply and after-sales service. The company has not published his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: CFO Narasimhan Raghunathan resigned on 31 January 2026; Chintan Shah took over on 15 April 2026. Both division heads changed in 2025. Aayush Shah moves from non-executive to executive director on 1 October 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder Nikhil Kumar is Managing Director. The other co-founder, Mohib Khericha, is non-executive Chairman. A hired CEO, Deepak Kumar Sinha, joined in April 2026 to run operations. Promoters owned about 27% in March 2026 and were issued ₹75cr of new shares in September 2026.

people.name: Nikhil Kumar
people.since: Promoter since 1999; MD since 2012; re-appointed from 17 January 2026
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.stake: 8.30% (31 March 2026, FY26 annual report); promoters together about 27%
people.bio: Nikhil Kumar is an engineering graduate of Karnataka Regional Engineering College, Surathkal, and did the General Management Programme at Harvard Business School. Before TD Power he worked at Kirloskar Electric. He co-founded the company in April 1999 and has been managing director since 2012, covering strategy, technology tie-ups and sales. He has more than 30 years in electric rotating machines. He is also managing director of the German subsidiary TD Power Systems Europe and draws part of his pay from it. He sold some shares in FY26, cutting his stake from 11.2% to 8.3%.

people.name: Deepak Kumar Sinha
people.bio: Deepak Kumar Sinha has an electrical engineering degree from Bhagalpur Engineering College and a postgraduate diploma in business administration from IIM Kozhikode. He has more than 30 years in the power sector. He was previously chief executive and whole-time director of L&T-MHI Power Turbine Generators, which makes large turbines and generators for thermal power plants. Before that he held senior management, technology and operations roles at GE Power and other companies. He joined TD Power as CEO on 3 April 2026.

people.name: M. N. Varalakshmi
people.bio: M. N. Varalakshmi has been CFO since 2018, when she replaced K. G. Prabhakar on his retirement. She was earlier Manager, Finance & Accounts at the company, so she rose from within. She studied at the University of Pune.

people.name: Ramakrishna Varna
people.bio: Ramakrishna Varna was made Chief Technical Officer on 15 October 2025 and is listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report. The company has not published his education or earlier career.

people.name: Vinay Hegde
people.since: Listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report
people.bio: Vinay Hegde leads global sales and marketing and is named as senior management in the FY26 annual report. The company has not published his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: Deepak Kumar Sinha joined as CEO on 3 April 2026. Head of Operations Sanju Davis, appointed in October 2025, left on 12 March 2026. A September 2026 EGM approved a ₹75cr preferential issue to promoters and a QIP.

companies.styleNote: The Sawhney family runs it. Dhruv Sawhney is Chairman & Managing Director and his son Nikhil is Vice Chairman & Managing Director. His other son Tarun, who runs sister company Triveni Engineering, is a non-executive director. Day-to-day operations are run by a hired CEO and COO. Promoters own 55.8%.

people.name: Dhruv M. Sawhney
people.since: Board since 2011 (demerger); current term 10 May 2024 to 9 May 2029
people.relation: Promoter; father of Nikhil Sawhney (VCMD) and Tarun Sawhney (non-executive director)
people.stake: 8.22% in his own name; 28.4% including shares he owns beneficially (FY26 annual report); promoters together 55.8%
people.bio: Dhruv Sawhney has a master's in mechanical sciences from Emmanuel College, Cambridge, and an MBA with distinction from Wharton. He chairs the Triveni group, which includes Triveni Turbine and the sugar and engineering company Triveni Engineering & Industries. He was president of the Confederation of Indian Industry in 1991-92 and co-chaired the Indo-French CEOs' Forum for ten years. He was the founding chairman of IIM Kashipur for nine years. France gave him the Legion d'Honneur and the UK made him an honorary LVO. He is 82 and drew ₹7.4cr from the company in FY26.

people.name: Nikhil Sawhney
people.relation: Son of the Chairman, Dhruv Sawhney; brother of Tarun Sawhney
people.bio: Nikhil Sawhney has a BA and MA from Emmanuel College, Cambridge, and an MBA from Wharton. He is also a director of Triveni Engineering & Industries. Under him the company made Forbes Asia's 'Best Under A Billion' list in 2024 and 2025. He co-founded the CII-Triveni Water Institute and is a former chairman of CII's Northern Region. He was the best-paid executive in FY26, at ₹11.5cr including ₹6cr of commission.

people.name: S. N. Prasad
people.bio: S. Narayana Prasad graduated in mechanical engineering from Nagarjuna University in 1991 and has a postgraduate diploma in computer applications. He has more than 30 years of experience across marketing, global sales, project execution, engineering, supply chain and service. Before becoming CEO on 1 April 2024 he was President and Global Business Head of the product business, which he grew across more than 100 countries.

people.name: Sachin Parab
people.bio: Sachin Parab graduated in mechanical engineering from Walchand College of Engineering in 1991 and has a postgraduate diploma from the Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (1994). Before becoming COO on 1 April 2024 he was President and Business Head of the aftermarket business, which the company is pushing hard. He has attended management programmes at IIM Ahmedabad and Harvard Business School.

people.name: Lalit Kumar Agarwal
people.bio: Lalit Agarwal is a commerce graduate of H.L. College of Commerce, has an MBA and is a cost accountant. He was finance general manager at Cadila Pharmaceuticals (1998–2008), senior finance manager at Asian Paints (2008–2016) and finance general manager at Schneider Electric (2016–2019). He briefly worked at Riau Andalan Pulp & Paper before joining Triveni as Vice President Finance in October 2019. The company credits him with the due diligence for its first overseas acquisition and with its credit rating upgrade to AA+.

people.name: P. U. Gopi
people.role: Executive Vice President & Chief Technology Officer
people.since: Listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report
people.bio: P. U. Gopi graduated in mechanical engineering from NIT Surathkal in 1988 and has an MBA in finance from Bangalore University (1994). He has more than 35 years in industrial turbomachinery and previously worked at Alstom Power and CICB-Elliott compressors. As CTO he runs project engineering, product development and validation, including the turbines that use CO₂ as the working fluid.

companies.changes: Nikhil Sawhney was re-appointed for five years from 10 May 2026. Head of Investor Relations Surabhi Chandna resigned in November 2025.

companies.styleNote: A subsidiary of GE Vernova: GE Steam Power International BV owns 68.58%. GE Vernova executives run it. The non-executive chairman, Craig Richards, is a GE Vernova regional manager. In July 2024 the parent dropped its plan to exit and stop being promoter. No family involvement.

people.name: Puneet Bhatla
people.bio: Puneet Bhatla has a mechanical engineering degree and more than 36 years in the power sector. He worked at NTPC, BHEL and Siemens India in engineering, product management, project execution, business development, JV negotiations and technology licensing for steam, nuclear and gas turbines. At GE Steam Power he led India services operations. He now also leads GE's Steam Power India growth areas: core and upgrade services, air-quality control equipment and the Durgapur factory. He has been a co-opted member of Aligarh Muslim University's mechanical engineering board of studies since 2020.

people.name: Shrikar Thakur
people.bio: Shrikar Thakur has a mechanical engineering degree from BIT Mesra and an MBA in international business from IIFT New Delhi, and is a graduate of GE's Accelerated Leadership Program. He has more than 17 years in power, infrastructure, manufacturing and EPC, with roles in India, France and the US. Before GE he worked at the Alstom Bharat Forge joint venture and the Kalyani Group. At GE he set up and led the project management office for Steam Power India and is now India New Build Leader, in charge of large power and EPC projects. He was named senior management in May 2025 and joined the board on 1 July 2026, aged 39.

people.name: Rahul Rojal
people.bio: Rahul Rojal is a chartered accountant with more than 16 years in financial reporting, controllership, audit and governance. He started at PwC, where he spent six years in audit, then spent seven years in finance at another listed company. At GE Power India he rose to Senior Financial Reporting Manager and worked on demergers, slump sales, carve-outs and valuations. He became CFO on 19 June 2026.

companies.changes: Whole-time director and CFO Aashish Ghai resigned with effect from 13 May 2026. Company secretary Kamna Tiwari resigned on 2 April 2026; Vipul Sharma replaced her from 19 June 2026. The NSE/BSE ticker changed from GEPIL to GVPIL in August 2025.

companies.styleNote: The Desai family runs it. Brothers Kushal Desai (Chairman, MD & CEO) and Chaitanya Desai (MD) each own 22.7%. Kushal's son Rishabh became a whole-time director in September 2025. Kushal's daughter and son-in-law also work in the company. Hired CEOs run the cables and conductor businesses. Promoters owned about 58% before the August 2026 QIP and about 55% after it.

people.name: Kushal N. Desai
people.since: Chairman & Managing Director; family has run Apar for three generations
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chaitanya Desai; father of Rishabh Desai and of Gaurangi Mehra (Director, Marketing & Communications)
people.stake: 22.70% (FY26 annual report); promoters together about 58% in March 2026, about 55% after the August 2026 QIP

people.name: Jitendra Kumar Agarwal

She retires by rotation and sought re-appointment at the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Dr Muthukumar Narayanaswamy
people.bio: Holds an MSc in applied sciences (rubber technology) from Anna University, an MBA in international marketing and a PhD, and has about 37–40 years in manufacturing and operations. From 2008 to June 2024 he was with Automotive Axles / Meritor Heavy Vehicle Systems India, rising to President, COO and Executive Director. Earlier he was President & COO (India) at Cummins Meritor, VP Operations at TTK LIG, and worked at TVS Srichakra and Sundaram Rubber. At Kaynes he is leading the ramp-up of the Sanand chip-packaging and Chennai circuit-board plants and a push to cut working-capital days.

people.name: Jairam Paravastu Sampath
people.since: With Kaynes since 2011; board since March 2018; Whole-time Director since April 2022, re-appointed from April 2027
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from IIT Madras with a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Ahmedabad, and over 30 years of experience in manufacturing, operations, finance and sales. He joined Kaynes in 2011 and leads its finance and strategy functions. Shareholders re-appointed him as Whole-time Director for five years from April 2027 at a fixed ₹1.5 crore a year with no variable pay. In the FY26 annual report he set a target of cutting the cash conversion cycle from 125 days to 100 days by FY28.

companies.changes: Dr N. Muthukumar became MD on 24 September 2025 and Ramesh Kunhikannan moved to Executive Vice-Chairman. CEO Rajesh Sharma resigned with effect from 8 November 2025 and no new CEO is listed as KMP. Company Secretary Anuj Mehtha resigned in March 2026 (replaced by Sudha Sri Addepalli); IT head Govind Menokee left in August 2025. Independent directors Anup Kumar Bhat (November 2025) and Heinz Moitzi (May 2026) resigned. The September 2026 AGM appointed Walker Chandiok as the new statutory auditor.
sources: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/KAYNESTECH_20082026180508_NoticeIntimation202526.pdf (FY26 annual report with AGM notice: board, KMP, senior management, relationships, promoter holdings)

companies.styleNote: Founder Sharad B Pitti is Founder & Chairman (an executive, whole-time director) and his son Akshay S Pitti is Managing Director & CEO. The day-to-day businesses are run by hired COOs and a chartered-accountant CFO. The promoter family and its holding company own about 54%.

people.name: Sharad B Pitti
people.since: Founder (operations began 1987); Chairman & MD until May 2024, then Founder & Chairman
people.relation: Founder; father of Akshay S Pitti
people.stake: 11.79% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 54.2%, including 28.45% through Pitti Electrical Equipment Pvt Ltd
people.bio: Sharad Pitti founded the company and built it into one of India's main makers of electrical-steel laminations, with more than four decades in the industry. He was Chairman & Managing Director until May 2024, when he handed the MD role to his son and was re-designated Founder & Chairman while staying a whole-time director. He also chairs the family's holding companies, Pitti Electrical Equipment, Pitti Holdings and Pitti Components. He and his wife Madhuri own the registered office and some factory land, which they lease to the company. The annual report and the company website give no details of his education.

people.name: Akshay S Pitti
people.since: 2004 (joined as whole-time director); MD & CEO since 2024
people.relation: Son of the Founder & Chairman Sharad B Pitti
people.bio: Akshay Pitti joined the company's leadership in October 2004 as a whole-time director and trained across its functions before taking charge. The company credits him with moving it from loose laminations to high-value stator and rotor assemblies and in-house machining, closing old units, building the large Aurangabad plant and making the Bagadia Chaitra and Dakshin Foundry acquisitions. He is Managing Director & CEO and chairs both subsidiaries. The company website and filings do not give his education.

people.name: M Pavan Kumar
people.bio: Pavan Kumar is a Fellow Chartered Accountant with about 19 years of work in banking, finance, accounts and tax. He has worked across power, steel, leather and textile companies. He joined Pitti in 2017 as General Manager – Finance and became Chief Financial Officer in November 2022. He runs finance strategy and treasury.

people.name: Sandip Agarwala
people.bio: Sandip Agarwala holds a post-graduate diploma in business management. He joined Pitti in May 2013 and has worked in marketing, business development and operations. As COO of the motor and generator components business, the company's core laminations and assemblies line, he runs production and delivery for that division.

people.name: Rishab Gupta
people.bio: Rishab Gupta has an MBA and more than ten years in manufacturing. His work covers supply chain, capital buying, factory automation, technology upgrades and ERP. He was Chief Procurement & Technology Officer before being named COO of machined components and enterprise sourcing in April 2025, after the previous COO of that business, Varun Agarwal, resigned.

people.name: Chaitra Sundaresh
people.bio: Chaitra Sundaresh is a commerce graduate with more than 20 years in electrical laminations. He co-owned and ran Bagadia Chaitra Industries, a lamination and die-cast rotor maker in Tumakuru, Karnataka, which Pitti bought in May 2024 (now Pitti Industries). He stays Managing Director of that unit and joined Pitti's senior team as Deputy COO.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. Independent director N Vinod Kumar resigned on 26 Aug 2026 for health reasons. Varun Agarwal, COO of machined components, left in April 2025.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Kirit Gala is Chairman & Managing Director and his son Smeet Gala, also a named promoter, is Vice President – Marketing & Sales. Two long-serving professionals from the old Gala group are whole-time directors. Aarti Industries' Rajendra Gogri sits on the board as a non-executive director. The Gala family owns about 55%.

people.name: Kirit Vishanji Gala
people.since: 2009 (MD since incorporation); CMD term to Nov 2028
people.relation: Promoter; father of Smeet Kirit Gala
people.stake: 21.84% (FY26 annual report); promoter family together about 55%
people.bio: Kirit Gala holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering (1984) and a master's in management studies (1986), both from the University of Bombay, and did a short course at IMD, Switzerland in 2022. He has been Managing Director since the company was set up in 2009 and took over the business of the older Gala Precision Technology. He runs strategy and marketing. He received the Pride of Welingkar award in 2023 and speaks on professional entrepreneurship and change management.

people.name: Balkishan Jalan
people.bio: Balkishan Jalan is a commerce graduate of the University of Bombay (1989) and a chartered accountant (1994). He joined the older Gala Equipments (later Gala Precision Technology) in 1998, where he was chief operating officer, and has been with this company since it was set up. He oversees operations, finance and general management. He won an SAP ACE Excellence award in 2010.

people.name: Satish Kotwani
people.bio: Satish Kotwani holds a diploma in mechanical engineering (1991) and diplomas in materials management (1992) and marketing management (1996), and has attended executive programmes at IIM Bangalore and ISB. He worked at Born Marketers from 1993 and joined Gala Equipments in 1995 as a business-development manager. He has about 30 years in marketing and runs global business development and sales.

people.name: S Giridhar (Giridhar Srinivasan)
people.since: Nov 2023 (with the company 2014–2021 and again from 2022)
people.bio: Giridhar Srinivasan is a commerce graduate of the University of Bombay (1987) and a chartered accountant (1993), with about 27 years in finance. He was Vice President – Finance and Accounts at Gala from 2014 to 2021, rejoined in that role in April 2022 and was promoted to CFO in November 2023. He runs accounts, finance and tax.

people.name: Smeet Kirit Gala
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD Kirit Gala; a named promoter
people.bio: Smeet Gala holds a B.Tech in production engineering from VJTI, University of Mumbai (2016). He joined the company in April 2021 as Associate Vice President – Marketing and Sales and is now listed as Vice President – Marketing & Sales in senior management. He is one of the two named promoters and is also a director of Workamp Spaces and Slate Workspaces.

people.name: Avadhut Panshikar
people.since: COO since April 2023 (joined the Gala group 2006)
people.bio: Avadhut Panshikar holds a diploma (1993) and a bachelor's degree (1996, Shivaji University) in mechanical engineering. He worked at SKF India, Mahindra & Mahindra and Bharat Bijlee before joining Gala Precision Technology in 2006. He rejoined Gala in 2014 after a short break, became Vice President – Operations in 2018 and Chief Operating Officer (disc springs and related products) in April 2023.

companies.changes: No changes in executives since the annual report (May 2026). A second COO, Rajendra Deshpande, is listed in senior management; the company gives no profile for him.

companies.styleNote: Third-generation promoter Pratik Patel is Chairman & Managing Director; his uncle Suresh Patel is an executive director and his cousin Rahul Patel sits on the board as a non-executive director. The German partner Axel Schutte (Schuette group) is a non-executive director with about 3.9%. The Patel–Amin family owns about 43%.

people.name: Pratik Patel
people.since: Director since about 1995; MD, now Chairman & MD
people.relation: Promoter (third generation of the founding family); nephew of Suresh Patel; cousin of director Rahul Patel; father of promoter Harsh Patel
people.stake: 12.05% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 43.2% (June 2026)
people.bio: Pratik Patel holds a bachelor's degree in production engineering from Sardar Patel University, Gujarat and an MBA in finance from Devi Ahilya University, Indore. The business was started in 1948 by Jashbhai Patel and run by the second generation before him. He has been a director since the mid-1990s, working mainly in marketing, product development and design, and the 2017 listing document credits him with the company's acquisitions and new products. He and the then chairman L. D. Amin personally guaranteed the company's bank loans at the time of the 2017 listing.

people.name: Suresh Patel
people.since: Feb 2023; re-appointed for two years from 14 Feb 2026
people.relation: Promoter group; uncle of Pratik Patel
people.bio: Suresh Patel is a member of the promoter group and has more than four decades of experience in running businesses, especially overall management, quality production and acquisitions, according to the company's February 2026 filing. He was first appointed executive director in February 2023 and was re-appointed in February 2026 for two more years. The company's filings do not give his education.

people.name: Dharmendra Jain
people.since: CFO; with the company since about 2006
people.bio: Dharmendra Jain is a Fellow Chartered Accountant and holds a B.Sc. from Mohanlal Sukhadia University, Udaipur. He has worked at Jash since about 2006 and, at the 2017 listing, already had more than 25 years in finance and accounts. He signs the company's accounts as CFO.

people.name: Bhuvanesh Pandey
people.since: Listed as senior management in FY25 and FY26
people.bio: Bhuvanesh Pandey is named as Chief Operating Officer in the company's senior management list. The annual report does not give a profile of him, and no filing with his background was found.

companies.changes: Suresh Patel was re-appointed executive director for two years from 14 Feb 2026. Independent director Vishwapati Trivedi left in Aug 2025 and Rakesh Bhawsar joined. No change in CFO or COO.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Tarak Patel is Managing Director, and since May 2026 the group is run by a Group CEO, Gregory Gelhaus, who is his brother-in-law and the son-in-law of promoter Ashok Patel. Ashok Patel, MD from 1988 to 2015, is now a non-executive director. The board is chaired by an independent director, Prakash Apte. The Patel family owns about 25%.

people.name: Tarak Patel
people.since: MD since June 2015; executive director since 2007; joined 2005
people.relation: Promoter; son of Ashok Patel; brother-in-law of Group CEO Gregory Gelhaus
people.stake: 1.16% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 25.2%
people.bio: Tarak Patel has a BA in economics from the University of Rochester, USA and an MBA jointly awarded by Columbia Business School, London Business School and HKU Business School. Before joining GMM Pfaudler in 2005 as Vice President – Sales and Marketing he worked at Universal Consulting, a Mumbai strategy consulting firm. He became an executive director in 2007 and Managing Director in June 2015, and shareholders re-appointed him for five years from May 2025. He took on the CEO's duties when Aseem Joshi left in September 2025. He is on the boards of Ready-Mix Concrete Ltd and ReefWatch Marine Conservation and chairs Charutar Arogya Mandal.

people.name: Gregory Gelhaus
people.since: Group CEO since 21 May 2026; joined May 2025 as Group Chief Transformation Officer
people.relation: Son-in-law of promoter Ashok Patel; brother-in-law of MD Tarak Patel
people.bio: Gregory Gelhaus holds a BBA in accounting from the University of Michigan's Ross School of Business and an MBA in finance and marketing from Wharton, and is a New York CPA. He was chief operating officer for Asia Pacific and Central Europe at Global Blue, where he sat on the executive committee, and earlier worked at PwC, Alvarez & Marsal and Kirkham Group. He joined GMM Pfaudler in May 2025 to run its Global Transformation Program and was made Group CEO in May 2026 under a new single-CEO structure. Because he is a promoter relative, his pay needs shareholder approval as a related-party office of profit.

people.name: Ankit Nayyar
people.role: Deputy CFO; Group CFO from 4 Nov 2026
people.bio: Ankit Nayyar is a chartered accountant with a B.Com from Shri Ram College of Commerce and a master's in accounting and finance from Manchester Business School. He was CFO of PI Health Sciences, where he ran global finance and M&A, and helped integrate Monsanto into Bayer in India. Earlier he worked at Pfizer, Morgan Stanley Capital and Tata AIG Life. He joined as Deputy CFO in May 2026 and takes over as Group CFO after the Q2 FY27 results on 4 November 2026.

people.name: Massimo Serapioni
people.bio: Massimo Serapioni holds a BBA and a master's in information, media and technology management from the University of St. Gallen, and a master's in international business strategy from the Stockholm School of Economics. Before GMM Pfaudler he was General Manager of the plastics recycling business at Coperion, where he led the purchase and integration of a German company. He has headed the corrosion-resistant technologies (glass-lined equipment) division since September 2025.

companies.changes: Group CFO Alexander Poempner resigned on 15 Sep 2026; he steps down after the Q2 results on 4 Nov 2026 and Ankit Nayyar takes over. Thomas Kehl, CEO of the international business, retired on 31 Aug 2026. Gregory Gelhaus became Group CEO in May 2026, after CEO Aseem Joshi left in Sep 2025. Manish Shah and Ulf Wittmann stopped being senior management in May 2026 in a reorganisation.

companies.styleNote: Run by its three Indian co-promoters, all ex-engineering-company men: Arvind Kamath is Chairman, Dipak Bharuka is CEO and Goutam Rampelli is a whole-time director. They are business partners, not a family. Promoters own about 68%: Kamath's company Mascot Capital & Marketing about 32.5%, the Korean founder JNK Global (formerly JNK Heaters) about 18%, Bharuka 8.9% and Rampelli 8.3%. JNK Global's CEO Kim Bang-hee sits on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Arvind Kamath
people.relation: Promoter; director of promoter company Mascot Capital & Marketing
people.stake: Holds his stake mainly through Mascot Capital & Marketing, about 32.5% (latest shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Arvind Kamath holds a bachelor's degree in chemical engineering from NIT Surathkal. Before JNK he worked with Sulzer Pumps India and was associated with Chetra Seals, Mascot Flowtech and Mascot Global. He has been with JNK India since 16 August 2010 and the company credits him with driving its diversification beyond fired heaters. He is also a director of Mascot Capital & Marketing and other Mascot group companies.

people.name: Dipak Bharuka
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.bio: Dipak Bharuka has an M.E. in machine design from IIT Roorkee and an executive MBA in project management from SP Jain Institute of Management & Research. He spent 12 years at Larsen & Toubro, leaving as Assistant General Manager. At JNK he is the CEO and a whole-time director.

people.name: Goutam Rampelli
people.relation: Co-promoter (not related to the other promoters)
people.bio: Goutam Rampelli spent over 36 years with L&T Hydrocarbon Engineering & Construction, working in marketing, business development, project execution and strategic planning. He joined JNK in 2015 and is a co-promoter and board member. The company credits him with strong negotiation skills and a wide industry network.

people.name: Anand Agarwal
people.bio: Anand Agarwal is a chartered accountant with about 20 years of experience across EPC, infrastructure, industrial parks and oil and gas. He was named interim CFO and key managerial personnel from 12 March 2026, after the previous CFO Pravin Sathe resigned in December 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Pravin Sathe resigned effective 16 Dec 2025; Anand Agarwal is interim CFO from 12 Mar 2026 (no permanent CFO named yet).

companies.styleNote: Promoter Prakash Agarwal has been Managing Director since 2002 and is the only promoter on the board; three hired executive directors run finance, operations and projects. Promoter group holds 70.8%. His daughter Aanya Agarwal works in the company. The group also controls Hindusthan Udyog and Bengal Steel Industries.

people.name: Prakash Agarwal
people.relation: Promoter; father of Aanya Agarwal (employee)
people.bio: Prakash Agarwal, 55, is a mechanical engineer (BE) with about 31 years of experience. He came from the promoter group's Hindusthan Udyog, joined WPIL's board as a non-executive director in 2000 and became Managing Director on 1 July 2002; shareholders re-appointed him from 1 November 2025. The company lists his strengths as marketing, new products, turnarounds, international marketing and setting up new operations; WPIL's overseas pump subsidiaries in South Africa, Australia, the UK and Italy (Gruppo Aturia) were all added during his tenure. He is also a non-executive promoter director of Hindusthan Udyog. He drew ₹2.94cr in FY26.

people.name: K. K. Ganeriwala
people.bio: K. K. Ganeriwala, 63, holds a B.Com (Hons) and LLB and is a qualified cost accountant (FCMA) and company secretary (FCS), with about 41 years in finance: planning, fund raising, investor relations, tax, M&A and restructuring. He was a non-executive director for five years before becoming Executive Director in 2007, covering finance, accounts, tax and legal. He sits on the boards of the overseas subsidiaries (Aturia, Mather & Platt SA, APE Pumps, Sterling Pumps) and of promoter-group companies including Hindusthan Parsons. Re-appointed from 1 November 2025.

people.name: Brahma Prakash Khare
people.bio: Brahma Prakash Khare holds an M.E. in mechanical engineering and has about 46 years in the pump industry across design, quality assurance and manufacturing. He headed WPIL's Ghaziabad business unit for more than 15 years before joining the board as Executive Director (Operations).

people.name: Debraj Roy
people.bio: Debraj Roy holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering, an M.E. in production and a PGCBM, with 30-plus years managing large engineering projects, including quality and contract management. He became Executive Director (Projects) in April 2024.

people.name: U. Chakravarty
people.bio: U. Chakravarty is a fellow company secretary (FCS-5127) and is the company's General Manager (Finance) and Company Secretary, listed among key managerial personnel. WPIL does not name a separate CFO.

companies.changes: No KMP changes after the FY26 annual report found. Prakash Agarwal and K. K. Ganeriwala re-appointed from 1 Nov 2025; B. P. Khare from 1 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Pramod Chaudhari stays on as executive Founder Chairman & Mentor, but day-to-day the company is run by a hired Managing Director, Ashish Gaikwad (ex-Honeywell), with Sachin Raole as Joint MD & CFO. Their son Parth Chaudhari is a non-executive director; Pramod's wife Parimal Chaudhari left the board in August 2025. Promoters own 32.8%.

people.name: Pramod Chaudhari
people.role: Founder Chairman & Mentor – Praj Group (Whole-time Director)
people.since: 1983 (founder); current executive term from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2030
people.relation: Founder; husband of Parimal Chaudhari and father of Parth Chaudhari (non-executive director)
people.stake: 24.97% (FY26 annual report); with wife Parimal (7.83%) the promoters hold 32.81%
people.bio: Pramod Chaudhari is an IIT Bombay graduate (1971, later named a Distinguished Alumnus) and attended Harvard Business School's Advanced Management Program in 1995. A first-generation entrepreneur, he founded Praj in 1983 and built it into India's largest biofuel technology company, with more than 1,000 installations in over 100 countries. He moved from non-executive chairman back to an executive role from July 2025; shareholders approved this by special resolution because he is over 75. He chairs the governing board of COEP Technological University, Pune, and founded the Indian Federation of Green Energy. His awards include the George Washington Carver Award (2020) and the William C. Holmberg lifetime award (2022).

people.name: Ashish Gaikwad
people.since: 3 February 2025 as MD-designate; MD from 1 July 2025 (term to 31 January 2030)
people.bio: Ashish Gaikwad holds a B.E. (Hons) in electrical and electronics engineering from BITS Pilani. He spent about three decades at Honeywell, starting as an automation and process control engineer and working in India, South-East Asia, Asia Pacific and the USA; for over seven years he was Managing Director of the listed Honeywell Automation India. Under him Honeywell Automation was named Business Standard's Star MNC of the Year 2019, and Fortune India listed him among top wealth creators in 2021. He replaced long-time CEO & MD Shishir Joshipura at Praj in July 2025.

people.name: Sachin Raole
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: JMD & CFO from 30 April 2026 (earlier CFO & Director – Resources)
people.bio: Sachin Raole is a chartered accountant and cost accountant with about 31 years in finance and accounts: M&A, divestments, restructuring, treasury and tax. Before Praj he worked with RPG group companies, including KEC International, RPG Cables and RPG Life Sciences. At Praj he was CFO & Director – Resources, also overseeing HR, materials, IT, legal and secretarial, and was elevated to Joint Managing Director & CFO for five years from 30 April 2026. He is on the boards of the main subsidiaries, including Praj GenX, Praj HiPurity and Praj Americas.

people.name: Anant Bavare
people.bio: Anant Bavare is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the four key managerial personnel named in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: CEO & MD Shishir Joshipura retired on 30 June 2025; Ashish Gaikwad took over as MD on 1 July 2025. Sachin Raole became Joint MD & CFO from 30 April 2026. Senior executive Ajay Pratap Singh (VP & Business Head) left in September 2025.

companies.styleNote: A Seth family business: Chairman Lalit Seth is a whole-time director and his two sons hold the other top jobs, Rishi Seth as Managing Director and Gautam Seth as Joint MD and CFO. There are no hired executives on the board. Promoters own 72.7% (22.75% directly by family members and 49.91% through family companies such as HPL India, HPL Electronics and HPL Holdings).

people.name: Lalit Seth
people.relation: Promoter; father of Rishi Seth and Gautam Seth
people.bio: Lalit Seth has more than 56 years in the electrical industry and heads the HPL group as its Chairman. The company credits him with its transformation into a maker of meters, switchgear, lighting, wires and cables, and with building its reputation for quality and technology. He is one of three family executives on the board and did not take a pay rise in FY26.

people.name: Rishi Seth
people.since: Managing Director; retired by rotation and stood for re-appointment at the 24 September 2026 AGM
people.relation: Son of Lalit Seth; brother of Gautam Seth
people.bio: Rishi Seth holds an MBA in finance and has over 31 years in the electrical industry. As Managing Director he sets strategy and leads diversification, including EPC and green-energy projects, and he oversees the institutional and government business, which includes the smart-meter orders from power utilities. The company credits him with making HPL one of the leading smart-meter makers.

people.name: Gautam Seth
people.role: Joint Managing Director & Chief Financial Officer
people.since: Joint MD; also CFO since March 2022
people.relation: Son of Lalit Seth; brother of Rishi Seth
people.bio: Gautam Seth is a commerce graduate and a qualified chartered accountant with over 29 years in the electrical industry. As Joint Managing Director he oversees the group's overall running and administration and leads sales and marketing. He also became CFO and key managerial personnel in March 2022, so the finance function reports to a family member.

people.name: Vivek Kumar
people.bio: Vivek Kumar is the Company Secretary and the only key managerial personnel from outside the Seth family named in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: No board or KMP changes in FY26 or since the annual report. Independent director Rashmi Vij was re-appointed from 11 May 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Khurana family company: brothers Pushkar Khurana (Executive Chairman, runs the overseas business from Dubai) and Puneet Khurana (Managing Director) are the sons of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana. A hired CEO, N. P. Gupta (ex-Jamna Auto), joined in July 2026. Promoters own about 67.4%, including Suman Khurana 24.4% and the family firm Khurana Gases 15.9%.

people.name: Pushkar Khurana
people.since: Board since September 1994; Executive Chairman since 14 November 2019
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana; brother of MD Puneet Khurana
people.stake: 9.13% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 67.4%
people.bio: Pushkar Khurana, 54, is a commerce graduate from Mumbai University with an MBA from the USA, and recently completed Harvard Business School's Owner/President Management programme. He has been with the EKC group for about three decades and oversees its international business as Managing Director of the Dubai subsidiary EKC International FZE. He also sits on the boards of the subsidiaries in Egypt, Europe and the US (CP Industries) and of family companies such as Khurana Gases. He retired by rotation and stood for re-appointment at the 2026 AGM.

people.name: Puneet Khurana
people.relation: Promoter; son of the late founder Prem Kumar Khurana; brother of Chairman Pushkar Khurana
people.bio: Puneet Khurana, 53, is a commerce graduate and completed a business management course at Mumbai University; he has about 30 years in the business. He opened export markets for the company's CNG cylinders in Iran, Malaysia, Thailand and Bangladesh and built relationships with vehicle makers such as Bajaj Auto, Tata Motors, Mahindra and Eicher, and with city gas companies such as MGL, IGL, Adani and Torrent. The company cites his expertise in innovation and R&D in cylinders, and he is a director of Calcutta Compressions & Liquefaction Engineering, Next Gen Cylinder and CP Industries Holdings.

people.name: Narender Prasad Gupta
people.bio: N. P. Gupta is a mechanical engineer (Institution of Engineers, India) with an MBA from IMT Ghaziabad and a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. He has more than 25 years of leadership experience in automotive and manufacturing, including senior roles at Jamna Auto Industries and Hero Motors. His areas are strategy, operations, lean manufacturing, supply chain and business transformation. CEO Insights named him among the top 10 Indian manufacturing CEOs in 2024.

people.name: Sanjiv Kapur
people.since: CFO; whole-time director since 26 May 2025 (term ends 31 October 2026)
people.bio: Sanjiv Kapur, 65, is a chartered accountant with over 42 years in finance roles across manufacturing industries including textiles, steel, auto ancillaries and industrial products. As CFO he also handles legal and other corporate matters. He was made a whole-time director in May 2025 and retires on 31 October 2026, after which the board wants him to stay on as a non-executive director from 1 November 2026.

people.name: Vishal Totla
people.bio: Vishal Totla is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the company's key managerial personnel.

companies.changes: N. P. Gupta joined as CEO on 1 July 2026. CFO Sanjiv Kapur retires on 31 October 2026 and is proposed as a non-executive director from 1 November 2026; no successor CFO had been announced as of late September 2026.

companies.styleNote: A Patel family company run by two brothers' branches: Himanshu Patel is Managing Director and his son Harsh Patel is whole-time director; his brother Nilesh Patel sits on the board as a non-executive director and Nilesh's son Aalap Patel is an executive director. Promoters own 65.6%, almost all held by these four. The chairman, Yatish Parekh, is an independent director.

people.name: Himanshu Patel
people.relation: Promoter; father of Harsh Patel; brother of Nilesh Patel; uncle of Aalap Patel
people.bio: Himanshu Patel is an electrical engineer (B.E., University of Bombay, 1976) with about 49 years in the chemicals and engineering business. The company credits him with shaping its strategy and operating framework and guiding its long-term growth. He joined the board with the other family directors on 31 December 2016 and, as MD, certifies the accounts together with the CFO.

people.name: Harsh Patel
people.since: Director since 31 December 2016; whole-time director since 1 October 2022
people.relation: Son of MD Himanshu Patel; nephew of Nilesh Patel; first cousin of Aalap Patel
people.bio: Harsh Patel, born 1977, is a chemical engineer from the University of Mumbai with an MBA from Seattle University. He has more than 25 years in the chemicals and engineering business and drives product innovation, operations and expansion. He is also a director of family companies including Kinam Engineering Industries, Kinam Process Equipments, HLE Engineers and Yashashvi Rasayan, some of which do business with HLE Glascoat.

people.name: Aalap Patel
people.relation: Son of Nilesh Patel; nephew of Himanshu Patel; first cousin of Harsh Patel
people.bio: Aalap Patel holds a B.E. in mechanical engineering from the University of Pune and an MBA in global management from Thunderbird School of Global Management. He has over 14 years of industry experience and works on strategic planning and operations. He chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Amit Kalra
people.bio: Amit Kalra has about 22 years of experience in P&L management and corporate transformation. He was already part of HLE Glascoat's senior management, working on its strategic transformation, before being named CFO from 25 September 2026. His first task is to steer the ongoing restructuring and deal with the sharp margin fall seen in Q1 FY27.

people.name: Achal Thakkar
people.bio: Achal Thakkar is the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the company's key managerial personnel.

companies.changes: CFO Naveen Kandpal resigned effective 3 July 2026; Amit Kalra (from within senior management) became CFO on 25 September 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the Kandula family: Nageswara Rao Kandula is Managing Director, his wife Krishna Veni Kandula and his brother Ramakrishna Kandula are executive directors. A second promoter family, the Katragadda brothers, has one executive and one non-executive director. Japan's AGI group, a strategic investor, has its CEO Yasuyuki Ikeda on the board as an executive nominee director. Promoters own 60.5%; the chairman is independent.

people.name: Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; husband of Krishna Veni Kandula; brother of Ramakrishna Kandula
people.bio: Nageswara Rao Kandula holds a diploma in business management and an MBA, both in finance, from the Indian School of Business Management and Administration. He has been with the company since it was set up and has more than a decade of experience in glass lining, engineering and allied industries. The annual report lists his strengths as strategy, finance and capital allocation, and precision manufacturing. He led the company through its January 2025 stock market listing and its later rename from Standard Glass Lining Technology to Standard Engineering Technology. He is also a director of the family's Standard Group of Companies and Standard C2C Engineering.

people.name: Ramakrishna Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.stake: 22.09% directly (March 2026 shareholding pattern); also a partner in promoter firms S2 Engineering Services (9.44%) and Standard Holdings (2.31%)
people.bio: Ramakrishna Kandula, 48, passed Parts I and II of the Technicians Engineering Examination of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers. He has more than 14 years in making stainless steel and nickel-alloy equipment; his listed strengths are manufacturing and shop-floor operations. He is Managing Director of the main subsidiary, S2 Engineering Industry, and a partner in S2 Engineering Services. He stood for re-appointment by rotation at the 18 September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Krishna Veni Kandula
people.relation: Promoter; wife of MD Nageswara Rao Kandula
people.stake: 18.64% (March 2026 shareholding pattern); also a partner in promoter firms S2 Engineering Services and Standard Holdings
people.bio: Krishna Veni Kandula, 45, holds an MBA and a graduate diploma in management, both in finance, from the Indian School of Business Management and Administration. She has been with the company since incorporation and has about 14 years in glass lining and engineering, covering general management and administration. She is a director of many family companies, including S2 Engineering Industry, Standard Flora, CPK Engineers Equipment and Standard Scigenics. She stood for re-appointment by rotation at the 18 September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Venkata Mohana Rao Katragadda
people.relation: Promoter group; brother of non-executive director Venkata Siva Prasad Katragadda (not related to the Kandulas)
people.bio: Venkata Mohana Rao Katragadda holds a diploma in mechanical engineering from Tamil Nadu's State Board of Technical Education and passed the chartered engineer examination of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers (India). Before joining he was Deputy Chief Engineer at The Jeypore Sugar Company, and he has over three decades in construction and engineering. His listed strengths are mechanical engineering, project execution and industrial operations, and he chairs the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Yasuyuki Ikeda
people.bio: Yasuyuki Ikeda is Chief Executive Officer of Japan's AGI Group (Asahi Glassplant), a glass-lined equipment and chemical-processing company that invested in Standard, and he sits on the board as the AGI investors' nominee. He holds a diploma from The American School in England (TASIS) and has over 25 years in engineering and chemical processing. He is also a director of AGI's Indian ventures, including AGI Glassplant India, ATR-Asahi Process Systems and GL Hakko Technology.

people.name: Anjaneyulu Pathuri
people.since: 18 July 2022 (joined 4 March 2022 as Associate VP, Finance)
people.bio: Anjaneyulu Pathuri is a chartered accountant (associate member of ICAI). He worked in audit and assurance at S.R. Batliboi & Associates, G.M. Kapadia & Co. and M. Anandam & Co., and was an Assistant General Manager in finance at Aurobindo Pharma. He joined Standard in March 2022 and has been CFO of both the company and its main subsidiary since July 2022.

people.name: Kallam Hima Priya
people.since: Associated with the company since 1 October 2021
people.bio: Kallam Hima Priya is an associate member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and holds an LL.B. from Osmania University. She has been with the company since October 2021 and is also company secretary of the main subsidiary.

companies.changes: No KMP changes found after the FY26 annual report. Independent director Uma Maheswara Rao Kancherla joined on 14 May 2026; Venkata Siva Prasad Katragadda became a non-executive director on 4 August 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Mark Saldanha is Chairman, Managing Director and CEO; his wife Sandra Saldanha is a whole-time director. Promoters own 43.9%, almost all of it held by Mark Saldanha. PE investor OrbiMed holds 8.6% and has a board seat.

people.name: Mark Saldanha
people.relation: Founder and promoter; husband of Sandra Saldanha
people.bio: Mark Saldanha is a science graduate and the founder promoter of Marksans. Before Marksans he was a whole-time director of Glenmark Pharmaceuticals, the company founded by his father Gracias Saldanha; Marksans began in 2001 as a Glenmark subsidiary and was spun off as a separate company in 2003. He has worked across R&D, marketing, production and finance, and built the business through acquisitions: Bell, Sons & Co. and Relonchem in the UK, Time-Cap Labs in the US and Nova in Australia. In FY26 he also drew about ₹1.3cr from the US subsidiary Time-Cap, on top of his pay from the listed company.

people.name: Sandra Saldanha
people.since: Whole-time director; re-appointed at the August 2026 AGM
people.relation: Wife of Mark Saldanha
people.bio: Sandra Saldanha holds a master's degree in arts (Sociology). Her areas at Marksans are human resources, business development, projects and supply chain. She is a director of the main overseas subsidiaries, including Marksans Pharma (UK), Relonchem, Bell, Sons & Co. and Time-Cap Laboratories in the US. Shareholders re-appointed her as a whole-time director at the 27 August 2026 AGM.

people.name: Varddhman V. Jain
people.bio: Varddhman Jain has an M.Pharm and about 27 years in the pharmaceutical industry. He has worked across manufacturing, quality, research and development, compliance and regulatory affairs for both active ingredients and finished medicines. He has handled inspections by the US FDA, the UK MHRA, Japan's PMDA and the WHO. He chairs the company's CSR committee.

people.name: Jitendra Sharma
people.bio: Jitendra Sharma has been Marksans's chief financial officer since September 2002, almost from the start of the company. He is also a director of several overseas subsidiaries, including Marksans Pharma UK (since 2008), Bell, Sons & Co. (since 2017), Relonchem, Nova Pharmaceuticals Australasia and Marksans Pharma Inc. There was no change in the company's key managerial personnel during FY26.

companies.changes: No change in key managerial personnel in FY26. Other senior leaders named in the FY26 annual report: David Mohammed (MD, Australia), Sathish Kumar (MD, UK) and Anjani Kumar (COO, US).

companies.styleNote: The Patel family controls Zydus through the Zydus Family Trust (about 75%). Chairman Pankaj Patel is non-executive; his son Dr Sharvil Patel is Managing Director and runs the company, with a deep bench of hired professionals below him.

people.name: Dr. Sharvil P. Patel
people.relation: Son of the Chairman, Pankaj R. Patel
people.stake: 14,775 shares in his own name (FY26 annual report); family, mainly through the Zydus Family Trust, about 75%
people.bio: Dr Sharvil Patel has a bachelor's degree in chemical and pharmaceutical sciences and a doctorate focused on breast cancer research. He has nearly 30 years of leadership experience in the group and has driven its shift to specialty medicines, new molecules and overseas expansion. He is President of the Indian Pharmaceutical Alliance, the lobby group of large Indian drug makers, and Honorary Consul of Belgium. He is also an independent director of Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation. BioSpectrum named him Businessperson of the Year 2025.

people.name: Ganesh N. Nayak
people.bio: Ganesh Nayak holds a B.Sc. and an MBA from Newport University, and attended the General Management Programme at Harvard Business School. He has been with the Zydus group since 1977, over 48 years in pharma. He has led the group's joint ventures and global alliances and worked on its sales, marketing and M&A. He stopped being a key managerial person in July 2025 but was re-appointed a director in employment for five years to July 2030. He is an independent director of Zydus Wellness.

people.name: Tushar D. Shroff
people.bio: Tushar Shroff is a Chartered Accountant and Cost Accountant with over 29 years of experience, 20 of them in pharma. He worked at ABB, Piramal Healthcare and Intas Pharmaceuticals, and at Zydus itself from December 2010 to January 2019. Just before rejoining he was CFO of Sterlite Technologies. He rejoined as President-Finance in April 2025 and became CFO on 1 September 2025, when Nitin Parekh retired.

people.name: Swati Dalal
people.bio: Swati Dalal has a pharmacy degree from PKM Kundnani College of Pharmacy and a management degree from JBIMS, Mumbai. She has over 30 years in pharma, starting at Wockhardt Nutrition and moving through Boots, Knoll, Solvay and Abbott. At Abbott she ran Abbott Nutrition and Abbott Primary Care, then was Managing Director of Abbott India until June 2025. She now runs Zydus Healthcare, the subsidiary that holds the Indian branded-medicines business.

companies.changes: CFO Nitin Parekh retired on 31 August 2025 and now heads special projects; Tushar Shroff took over as CFO. Harish Sadana moved from MD of Zydus Healthcare to President-Corporate Matters. Samir Desai (Biologics) died in August 2025. Mayank Satpal left senior management in March 2026 in a reorganisation. At Zydus Wellness, the head of sales and the CMO resigned in July and September 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder C. C. Paarthipan is non-executive Chairman. His sons Ashok and Vivek Partheeban became non-executive Vice-Chairmen in November 2025; Vivek had been COO until then. Day-to-day running is by a hired MD, Dr Sridhar Ganesan. The promoter group owns about 70.6%.

people.name: Dr. Sridhar Ganesan
people.since: On the board since 2014; re-appointed MD to August 2028
people.bio: Dr Sridhar Ganesan, 71, holds an MS in Pharmaceuticals and a doctorate in homeopathic medicine, and has more than 42 years in the pharma industry. He has worked in profit-centre management, global marketing, new plant projects, production, product development, quality assurance and factory management. Before Caplin he held several international roles, with a focus on South Asia, the Middle East and Africa. India's pharma export council (Pharmexcil) has named him an 'Honorary Expert'. He joined the board in February 2014 and was re-appointed MD for two years from 25 August 2026.

people.name: D. Muralidharan
people.since: CFO since February 2016; whole-time director since August 2026
people.bio: D. Muralidharan, 70, is a commerce graduate, a qualified company secretary (ACS) and a cost and management accountant (CMA). He has over four decades in finance; his job before Caplin was at Merck Specialities. He has been CFO since 19 February 2016 and sits on the risk management committee. The board made him a whole-time director from 12 August 2026 for two years; shareholders voted on this at the September 2026 AGM.

companies.changes: Vivek Partheeban gave up the COO role on 5 November 2025 when he and his brother Ashok became non-executive Vice-Chairmen. CFO D. Muralidharan joined the board as whole-time director on 12 August 2026. Three senior managers left in April–July 2025: the chief transformation & digital officer, the SVP of formulation R&D and the VP of corporate affairs.

companies.styleNote: Founder Satish Mehta is MD & CEO and becomes Chairman from the 21 September 2026 AGM. His daughter Namita Thapar and son Samit Mehta are whole-time directors, and Namita's husband Vikas Thapar heads corporate development. Co-promoter Sunil Mehta (not related, per the annual report) is also a whole-time director.

people.name: Satish Mehta
people.role: Managing Director & CEO; Chairman from the September 2026 AGM
people.relation: Founder; father of Namita Thapar and Samit Mehta
people.stake: 39.77% (FY26 annual report); with Samit and Namita 49.6%
people.bio: Satish Mehta founded Emcure in 1981 and has run it ever since. He holds a postgraduate degree in chemistry from Pune University and a PGDM from IIM Ahmedabad. Under him Emcure grew into a company selling in more than 80 countries, with its own plants, research and biotech arm (Gennova). He has also served on government and policy advisory committees. The board made him Chairman from 21 September 2026, when Berjis Desai stepped down; he keeps the MD & CEO roles.

people.name: Namita Thapar
people.relation: Daughter of Satish Mehta; wife of Vikas Thapar
people.bio: Namita Thapar is a Chartered Accountant with an MBA from Duke University's Fuqua School of Business. Before Emcure she worked at Guidant Corporation in the US. At Emcure she was CFO, then head of the India business, and now leads the consumer business. She is widely known as an investor on the TV show Shark Tank India and runs a women's-health awareness platform. She was on the Economic Times '40 Under Forty' list.

people.name: Samit Mehta
people.relation: Son of Satish Mehta
people.bio: Samit Mehta holds an MBA from The Wharton School and graduate and postgraduate commerce degrees from Pune University. Before Emcure he was a strategy consultant at Ernst & Young. He oversees operations and drove Emcure's expansion into regulated markets such as the US, Europe and Canada, as well as new R&D platforms. He was named COO after March 2026. He is also a key managerial person at the vaccine and biologics subsidiary Gennova and draws pay from it.

people.name: Sunil Mehta
people.relation: Co-promoter; not related to Satish Mehta per the annual report; brother of Sanjay Mehta (President, Emerging Markets)
people.stake: 1.50% in his own name (FY26 annual report); a further 7.65% held with his wife as trustees of Unity Trust
people.bio: Sunil Mehta has been with Emcure since 1983. He holds a commerce degree from Pune University and a postgraduate business qualification from IMDR, Pune. He built Emcure's plants and runs manufacturing operations, automation, environment and safety. He also leads the company's CSR and sustainability work. His brother Sanjay Mehta, with Emcure since 1989, runs the emerging-markets business.

people.name: Dr. Mukund Gurjar
people.bio: Dr Mukund Gurjar, 73, holds two PhDs in chemistry and has over 250 publications and 180 patents. Before joining Emcure in July 2001 he was Deputy Director and Head of the Chemistry Division at CSIR-National Chemical Laboratory, Pune. He built Emcure's complex-chemistry portfolio, including chiral drugs and cancer, heart and HIV medicines. His term runs one year at a time; the 2026 AGM was asked to re-appoint him from 28 August 2026.

people.name: Tajuddin Shaikh
people.since: With Emcure for nearly two decades
people.bio: Tajuddin Shaikh is a Chartered Accountant and Cost Accountant, with executive education from IIM Ahmedabad. He has been at Emcure for nearly two decades and led several strategic projects before becoming CFO.

people.name: Vikas Thapar
people.relation: Husband of Namita Thapar; son-in-law of Satish Mehta
people.bio: Vikas Thapar has more than 20 years in business development, strategy and finance. He has led Emcure's international expansion, acquisitions and fundraising, especially in Europe and Canada. Before Emcure he worked at eBay/PayPal and Agilent Technologies in the US. He holds a bachelor's degree in management science from the University of California, San Diego and an MBA from USC Marshall.

companies.changes: Chairman Berjis Desai did not seek re-appointment and left at the 21 September 2026 AGM, where Satish Mehta became Chairman. R.S. Vasan (ex-Sun Pharma) joined as President – India Business in July 2025 after Anil Kothiyal resigned in June 2025. The company secretary changed: Chetan Sharma left in November 2025 and Amruta Yangalwar joined in February 2026.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder Pratibha Pilgaonkar is MD and her son-in-law Parag Sancheti is CEO. Her husband Sudhir (co-founder), daughter Surabhi and son Sumant are senior vice-presidents. PE firm General Atlantic is the largest shareholder and a co-promoter with 35.9%; the Pilgaonkar–Sancheti family holds 23.7%. The Chairperson is an independent director.

people.name: Pratibha Pilgaonkar
people.relation: Co-founder; wife of Sudhir Pilgaonkar; mother of Surabhi Sancheti and Sumant Pilgaonkar; mother-in-law of CEO Parag Sancheti
people.bio: Pratibha Pilgaonkar studied chemistry at the University of Bombay (1973) and pharmaceutical chemistry at its Department of Chemical Technology (1977). She also holds a diploma in operations research for management. Before Rubicon she worked at Burroughs Wellcome, Hindustan CIBA-GEIGY, Wyeth and Sun Pharma's Advanced Research Centre. She co-founded Rubicon, has been on the board since June 2000 and has been MD since May 2019, with responsibility for growing its research and development. Shareholders approved her continuing as MD past age 70, to May 2029.

people.name: Parag Sancheti
people.relation: Son-in-law of MD Pratibha Pilgaonkar; husband of Surabhi Sancheti
people.bio: Parag Sancheti has a commerce degree from Symbiosis (University of Pune, 2004) and a master's in economics from the Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics (2006), and is a CFA charterholder. Before Rubicon he worked at Tata Strategic Management Group (Tata Industries) and Aavishkaar Venture Management. He joined Rubicon in April 2013, joined the board in January 2017 and became CEO in May 2019. He leads the organisation and sets its growth strategy.

people.name: Surabhi Sancheti
people.role: Executive Vice President – Business Development & Project Management
people.relation: Daughter of MD Pratibha Pilgaonkar; wife of CEO Parag Sancheti
people.bio: Surabhi Sancheti has a BA from the University of Mumbai (2003), an MA from the Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics (2005) and an MBA from Case Western Reserve University's Weatherhead School of Management. She joined Rubicon in June 2009 and has run business development and project management since September 2019.

people.name: Sudhir Pilgaonkar
people.relation: Co-founder; husband of MD Pratibha Pilgaonkar
people.bio: Sudhir Pilgaonkar holds a science degree from the University of Bombay (1973) and has a pharmacy background. Before founding Rubicon he worked at Hoechst India and Galentic Pharma (India). He has been with Rubicon since May 1999 and a senior vice-president since March 2019, guiding manufacturing operations and the corporate affairs team.

people.name: Rohit Saraogi
people.bio: Rohit Saraogi is a Chartered Accountant and Company Secretary with over 24 years in finance. He has worked at Vini Cosmetics, S H Kelkar & Co, Bajaj Consumer Care, Diageo, Marico, Reckitt Benckiser and Coca-Cola. His experience covers business finance, cross-border M&A, capital allocation, treasury, investor relations and digital finance projects. He became CFO on 14 August 2026.

people.name: Nitin Jajodia
people.bio: Nitin Jajodia was Rubicon's CFO through its 2025 IPO and the FY26 accounts. On 14 August 2026 he moved into a business role as Chief Commercial Officer and handed the CFO job to Rohit Saraogi.

companies.changes: CFO Nitin Jajodia became Chief Commercial Officer on 14 August 2026, and Rohit Saraogi took over as CFO. Anand Agarwal, a General Atlantic nominee, left the board in February 2026. Avani Shah joined as GM – Legal in January 2026. General Atlantic cut its stake from 57.7% to 35.9% in FY26 through the IPO.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2004 by Nirav Mehta, who is MD & CEO; his brother Ankur is Joint MD and their father Dr Kirtikumar Mehta is non-executive Chairman. The three named promoters own 64% (promoter group about 69%).

people.name: Nirav Mehta
people.relation: Founder; son of Chairman Dr Kirtikumar Mehta; brother of Ankur Mehta
people.bio: Nirav Mehta holds a bachelor's degree in pharmacy and an MBA in marketing. Before founding Corona he worked at the multinationals Bayer and Novartis. He founded the company in 2004 and leads strategy, marketing, portfolio growth and operations. Corona has become one of India's fastest-growing drug makers, strong in women's health, metabolic disorders and pain. Hurun India gave him its Industry Achievement Award for pharmaceuticals in 2025. His current term as MD & CEO runs from August 2024 to August 2029.

people.name: Ankur Mehta
people.relation: Co-founder; son of Chairman Dr Kirtikumar Mehta; brother of Nirav Mehta
people.bio: Ankur Mehta holds a bachelor's degree in science and a master's degree in management. He co-founded Corona in 2004 and has over 20 years of experience.
