He leads governance, finance, supply chain and strategic initiatives. He brought in the private equity investors ChrysCapital and Creador, and knows the medicine-ingredient (API) market well.

people.name: Viral Sitwala
people.bio: Viral Sitwala has over 25 years in pharmaceutical manufacturing and worked at FDC Limited before Corona. He has been with Corona since it started and runs manufacturing and quality at all its plants. He set up the Himachal Pradesh and Ahmedabad plants and commissioned the EU-approved manufacturing block. He is also the director responsible for sustainability.

people.name: Bhavin Bhagat
people.bio: Bhavin Bhagat is a Chartered Accountant (Fellow of ICAI) with bachelor's and master's degrees in commerce from Gujarat University. He has done executive programmes at IIM Calcutta and IIM Ahmedabad. He joined Corona in 2012 and has over 19 years in finance. He covers accounts, treasury, tax, risk, legal and secretarial work, and investor relations.

people.name: Vijay Charlu
people.bio: Vijay Charlu leads the India business, which is almost all of Corona's revenue, covering sales, marketing, portfolio and strategy. He previously worked at Abbott and Indoco Remedies. He holds a science degree from Andhra University and a doctorate in management from Hessen International University, Germany.

companies.changes: Chairman Dr Kirtikumar Mehta (non-executive since October 2022) was re-appointed for five years; the 2026 AGM was asked to approve this because he is over 75.

companies.styleNote: Premchand Godha, who took control of Ipca in 1975, is Executive Chairman. His sons Pranay (MD & CEO) and Prashant (Executive Director) run the business alongside a long-serving professional MD and CFO, A. K. Jain. The promoter group owns about 44.7%, mostly through Kaygee Investments and other family companies.

people.name: Premchand Godha
people.relation: Promoter; father of Pranay Godha and Prashant Godha
people.stake: 2.29% in his own name (FY26 annual report); promoter group about 44.7%
people.bio: Premchand Godha is a Chartered Accountant and commerce graduate. He practised for five years before joining Ipca's board in October 1975, when he and his partners bought the company. He was Managing Director from March 1983 and led Ipca's growth into a large API and formulations maker, and is now Executive Chairman. He drew ₹7.56cr in FY26, the highest pay on the board.

people.name: Pranay Godha
people.relation: Son of Chairman Premchand Godha; brother of Prashant Godha
people.bio: Pranay Godha, 54, holds a B.Sc. from the University of Bombay and an MBA from the New York Institute of Technology. He joined Ipca in April 2003 as business development manager and ran the generics business, first as vice-president (2004) and then president (2006). He became an executive director in November 2008 and MD & CEO in April 2023; his term runs to November 2028. He has over 20 years in pharma marketing and general management.

people.name: Ajit Kumar Jain
people.since: With Ipca since 1980; on the board since 1994
people.bio: A. K. Jain, 71, is a Chartered Accountant and science graduate who has worked at Ipca since 1980. He joined the board as an executive director in August 1994, became Joint MD in 2010 and Managing Director (in charge of finance) in April 2023. He is also CFO. He has over four decades of experience across finance, accounts, commercial, IT, legal, R&D and administration. He is the only non-promoter executive director, and his term runs to August 2029.

people.name: Prashant Godha
people.relation: Son of Chairman Premchand Godha; brother of Pranay Godha
people.bio: Prashant Godha, 51, is a commerce graduate with a postgraduate diploma in business management. He has more than 20 years of experience in pharma marketing and general management. He joined the board in July 2011 and became an executive director in August 2011; the board has re-appointed him for five years from August 2026. He is also a director of the group companies Lyka Labs, Resonance Specialties and Kaygee Laboratories.

companies.changes: Prashant Godha was re-appointed executive director for five years from 16 August 2026 (put to the 2026 AGM). Saidutta Nanda (ex-Macleods) joined as President – HR in March 2025. No KMP resignations were found for 2026.

companies.styleNote: Run by the second generation of the Agrawal family. Brothers Yogesh (MD) and Rajesh (Joint MD) are sons of non-executive Chairman Mannalal Agrawal, and their uncle Madhusudan Agrawal is executive Vice-Chairman. Promoters own 66.25%.

people.name: Yogesh M. Agrawal
people.relation: Son of Chairman Mannalal Agrawal; brother of Rajesh Agrawal; nephew of Vice-Chairman Madhusudan Agrawal
people.bio: Yogesh Agrawal is a management graduate from Johnson & Wales University in the US and joined Ajanta in 1996. He has been MD since 2000 and led the company's turnaround into a leading Indian branded-generics exporter. He led its move into emerging markets and the US. He also rebuilt its research programme and its regulatory-grade plants.

people.name: Rajesh M. Agrawal
people.relation: Son of Chairman Mannalal Agrawal; brother of Yogesh Agrawal; nephew of Vice-Chairman Madhusudan Agrawal
people.bio: Rajesh Agrawal holds a degree in business studies from the University of Buckingham (UK) and an MBA from Bentley College (US). He joined Ajanta in 1999 and runs the India business. He made Ajanta a leading player in cardiology, dermatology, ophthalmology and pain, then expanded into gynaecology and nephrology, often with first-to-market launches. He repeated the model in the Philippines, one of the company's fastest-growing markets.

people.name: Madhusudan B. Agrawal
people.since: Re-appointed for five years from April 2025
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman Mannalal Agrawal; uncle of Yogesh and Rajesh Agrawal
people.bio: Madhusudan Agrawal has about 50 years of experience in the industry. His areas are corporate affairs, business development, international business, general management and public relations. He also leads the group's charitable work, including the Mamta & Madhusudan Agrawal Memorial Foundation. The board re-appointed him as executive Vice-Chairman for five years from 1 April 2025.

people.name: Arvind K. Agrawal
people.bio: Arvind Agrawal is a Fellow Chartered Accountant (ICAI) and Ajanta's CFO and a key managerial person. He sits on the board's risk management committee and co-signs the CEO/CFO certificate on the accounts with the MD.

companies.changes: No change in senior management or KMP during FY26. Chairman Mannalal Agrawal (79) retires by rotation and was put up for re-appointment by special resolution at the 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: Part of Harsh Goenka's RPG group, which owns about 73%. Goenka is non-executive Chairman and his daughter Vasundhara Patni is a non-executive director. The business is run by a hired MD, Ashok Nair, who took over from Yugal Sikri in May 2025.

people.name: Ashok Nair
people.since: May 2025 (MD-designate from January 2025); term to April 2028
people.bio: Ashok Nair has about 39 years in healthcare and a record of building new businesses and turning around existing ones. His last corporate job was Managing Director of Abbott Primary Care. Before that he worked at Abbott, Torrent Pharma, Sun Pharma and Cipla in sales, marketing, commercial and product management. In June 2023 he co-founded WatchYourHealth, a B2B health-tech start-up. He has also worked on policy with industry bodies and advised private equity firms on healthcare. He became MD on 1 May 2025 for three years.

people.name: Amol Lone
people.bio: Amol Lone is a Chartered Accountant with more than 20 years in corporate finance. He has held senior finance roles at Gunnebo India, Henkel, Teva Pharmaceuticals and Fermenta Biotech. His experience covers tax, treasury, debt restructuring and regulatory compliance. He became CFO on 15 December 2025, after Vishal Shah resigned in October 2025.

people.name: Deepak Shukla
people.since: Joined July 2025; subsidiary CEO from August 2026
people.bio: Deepak Shukla holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from N.M. University and an executive MBA in international business from IIFT, New Delhi. He has about 25 years of experience at UPL, Teva, AkzoNobel India, Ranbaxy and Dr. Reddy's; his last job was COO of UPL's Pharma Ventures (specialty chemicals). He joined as Chief Executive – API Business in July 2025. From 15 August 2026 he moved to run RPG Active Pharma, the API subsidiary in which the PE fund InvAscent now owns 40%.

companies.changes: Yugal Sikri finished his term as MD on 30 April 2025 and stayed on as a non-executive director; Ashok Nair took over. CFO Vishal Shah resigned in October 2025; Amol Lone joined in December 2025. Deepak Shukla left his parent-company API role to become CEO of the subsidiary RPG Active Pharma from 15 August 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr Krishna Prasad Chigurupati is Chairman & MD. His wife Uma Devi and their children Priyanka and Harsha are all executive directors. Promoters own about 38%, and promoter-group members took convertible warrants in a February 2026 preferential issue. The hired Joint MD & CEO, K.V.S. Ram Rao, resigned in August 2025.

people.name: Dr. Krishna Prasad Chigurupati
people.relation: Founder; husband of Uma Devi Chigurupati; father of Priyanka and Harsha Chigurupati
people.stake: 30.99% (FY26 annual report); family and promoter group together about 38%
people.bio: Krishna Prasad Chigurupati began in pharma in 1984, making paracetamol for export customers, and built Granules into one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturing companies. He pioneered formulation intermediates, a cheaper half-finished product sold to other medicine makers. He has filed 33 process-chemistry patents, five of them granted, and set up plants in China and the US. GITAM University gave him an honorary Doctor of Science, and the Institute of Directors named him a Distinguished Fellow in 2025. He also co-founded the KRSMA winery near Hampi.

people.name: Uma Devi Chigurupati
people.relation: Wife of CMD Krishna Prasad Chigurupati; mother of Priyanka and Harsha
people.bio: Uma Devi Chigurupati has a postgraduate degree in soil microbiology from Nagarjuna University and over 30 years in pharma. At Granules she leads CSR and human resources. She has chaired FICCI FLO Hyderabad and is a director of KRSMA Estates, the family's winery. She and her husband hold two Guinness world records for marathon running.

people.name: Priyanka Chigurupati
people.relation: Daughter of CMD Krishna Prasad and Uma Devi Chigurupati
people.bio: Priyanka Chigurupati has a B.Sc. in business management from Case Western Reserve University and attended the Executive Leadership Program at Harvard Business School. She has been with Granules for over 15 years and now leads global sales, strategy and quality compliance. She was an executive director of the US arm, Granules Pharmaceuticals Inc., from 2017 to 2024 and is still on its board. Business Today gave her its Most Powerful Women in Business award in 2025.

people.name: Harsha Chigurupati
people.relation: Son of CMD Krishna Prasad and Uma Devi Chigurupati
people.bio: Harsha Chigurupati has worked at Granules since 2006, across several departments. As executive director he is responsible for technology, transformation and organisational development, with a focus on AI and advanced manufacturing.

people.name: Mukesh Surana
people.bio: Mukesh Surana is a Chartered Accountant with all-India ranks in the CA Final and Intermediate exams, and has over 25 years of experience. Before Granules he worked at Garware Technical Fibres, Kalpataru Projects International and Asian Paints. He became CFO on 30 December 2022 and runs finance, treasury, tax, risk, investor relations, legal and governance. He won the CII CFO Excellence Award in 2024.

people.name: Dr. P.V. Srinivas
people.bio: Dr P.V. Srinivas has a PhD in organic chemistry from Osmania University and did post-doctoral work at the University of Mississippi. He has over 35 years in API research, synthetic chemistry and fermentation, and has filed more than 100 patents. He previously worked at IICT, Biocon, Cipla and PI Industries, and is an adjunct professor of chemistry at IIT Hyderabad.

companies.changes: Joint MD & CEO Dr K.V.S. Ram Rao resigned with effect from 1 August 2025, and the role was not refilled; the founder family now holds all four executive board seats. In February 2026 the company allotted 2.5cr convertible warrants to promoter-group and outside investors, plus shares to outside investors.

companies.styleNote: Control passed in 2022 to the Infinity Holdings funds, which hold about 42.8%. The founding Kochhar family keeps about 19.9% through Aresko Progressive. Raghavan is non-executive Chairman and Prithipal Singh Kochhar a non-executive director. The company is run by a hired MD, Manish Gupta, with a new COO and CFO.

people.name: Manish Gupta
people.bio: Manish Gupta became MD in July 2022, taking over from Rajpal Singh Kochhar when Infinity Holdings bought control. For eight years before that he was CEO & MD of SeQuent Scientific. There he turned a small India-focused firm into a global animal-health company with operations in India, Turkey, Brazil and Europe. Earlier he was CEO of the pharma business at Strides, and at Wockhardt he ended as MD of Pinewood Healthcare in Ireland and CEO of Radiant Research, a US contract research firm. He is also a director of Solara Active Pharma Sciences.

people.name: Amrut Medhekar
people.bio: Amrut Medhekar holds an MBA in marketing and a general management certificate from IIM Ahmedabad. He has over 30 years in pharma sales and marketing at Wockhardt, Zydus, Ranbaxy, Torrent and JK Drugs. His last job was CEO – Business Operations at Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals. Jagsonpal created the COO role for him in FY26 to speed up growth.

people.name: Nirav Vora
people.bio: Nirav Vora is a commerce graduate and Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with over 18 years in finance, tax and related law across several industries. He became CFO on 7 October 2025, after the previous CFO, Sachin Jain, left during his probation in July 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Sachin Jain left in July 2025 during probation; Nirav Vora joined in October 2025. Amrut Medhekar joined in the newly created COO role in FY26. A ₹40cr buyback was completed in May 2026.

companies.styleNote: The Amin family runs Alembic. Chirayu Amin is Executive Chairman, and his sons Pranav and Shaunak are joint Managing Directors: Pranav runs international business and Shaunak the India branded business. The promoter group owns 69.7%.

people.name: Chirayu Amin
people.since: Executive Chairman from April 2026 (Chairman & CEO before that)
people.relation: Promoter; father of Pranav and Shaunak Amin
people.stake: 2.13% in his own name (FY26 annual report); promoter group 69.74%
people.bio: Chirayu Amin holds a postgraduate degree in business administration. He has led Alembic's direction and its move into science-led and international growth. He gave up the CEO title and became Executive Chairman from 1 April 2026, for five years. He is a trustee of hospitals and educational institutions run by charitable bodies.

people.name: Pranav Amin
people.since: On the board since 2011; MD since 2016
people.relation: Son of Chairman Chirayu Amin; brother of Shaunak Amin
people.bio: Pranav Amin studied economics and industrial management at Carnegie Mellon University and holds an MBA in international management from Thunderbird School of Global Management. He has over 26 years of experience, joined the board in March 2011 and became MD in 2016. He leads the international business and was re-appointed MD for five years from 1 April 2026.

people.name: Shaunak Amin
people.relation: Son of Chairman Chirayu Amin; brother of Pranav Amin
people.bio: Shaunak Amin has an economics degree from the University of Massachusetts and worked at Merrill Lynch and HSBC before joining the family business. He runs Alembic's India branded business, drawing on a sales and marketing background.

people.name: G. Krishnan
people.bio: G. Krishnan is a Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary and Cost Accountant, with top all-India ranks in those exams. He has over 22 years in pharma, life sciences, telecom and the social sector. From May 2020 he was at Syngene International as Vice President and CFO of Syngene Scientific Solutions. Before that he held senior roles at Vodafone and Tata Trusts. He became CFO on 7 July 2025.

companies.changes: Long-time finance director R.K. Baheti handed over as CFO in July 2025 and became a non-executive director from April 2026; G. Krishnan took over as CFO. Chirayu Amin gave up the CEO title in April 2026. Shreekumar Nair (President, supply chain & operations) retired in July 2025. The board added Sujit Bhayani as a director in June 2026.

companies.styleNote: Nirma Ltd bought control from Glenmark Pharmaceuticals and owns 74.9%. Hiren Patel, Managing Director of Nirma, is the non-executive chairman. A hired team runs the business: Dr Yasir Rawjee (MD & CEO), Vinod Naik (Executive Director, operations) and Tushar Mistry (CFO). No family member works in management.

people.name: Dr Yasir Rawjee
people.bio: Studied at St. Xavier's College and the University Department of Chemical Technology (both University of Bombay), and holds a PhD from Texas A&M University. He has over 30 years in the industry. Before this he headed global API operations at Mylan Laboratories, was Senior Vice President at Matrix Laboratories, and worked at GlaxoSmithKline in the US. He has led the API business as MD & CEO since August 2019, through its 2021 listing as Glenmark Life Sciences and its sale to Nirma.

people.name: Vinod Naik
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees from Karnatak University and an MBA in finance from the National Institute of Management. He previously ran manufacturing operations at Sun Pharmaceutical, Cipla and Micro Labs. He joined in March 2020 and oversees the plants, production and supply chain. He sits on the board as a whole-time director.

people.name: Tushar Mistry
people.role: Chief Financial Officer & Senior Vice President
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant and cost accountant (ICWA) with over 24 years in API and formulation businesses, covering planning, M&A and fund-raising. He was CFO of Sequent Scientific before joining in June 2022, and earlier worked at Wockhardt. He leads accounts, finance, investor relations and secretarial work.

people.name: Dr Palle V R Acharyulu
people.bio: Holds a master's and a PhD in chemistry from the University of Hyderabad and did a senior management programme at IIM Calcutta. He was a Director at Dr Reddy's and held senior roles at Biocon and Sun Pharmaceutical. He has led R&D, project management and patents since July 2020.

people.name: Navin Kumar Agrawal
people.bio: Has about 30 years in pharma quality and compliance and holds an M.Sc. in inorganic chemistry from Barkatullah University. He was Associate Vice President at Sun Pharmaceutical and earlier worked at Aurobindo Pharma and Orchid Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals. He leads global quality and compliance for the API plants.

people.name: Mathew George
people.bio: Holds a chemistry degree from Loyola College, Chennai, and a postgraduate degree in inorganic chemistry from IIT Bombay. He began his career at Shasun Chemicals in 1995 and later worked at Cadila, Marksans, Ranbaxy and Mylan. He has handled drug master file filings and regulatory dossiers since October 2019.

companies.changes: No executive changes in FY26 or since. The FY26 annual report names the same MD & CEO, Executive Director and CFO; Rudalf Corriea is Company Secretary.

companies.styleNote: Founder Sudhir Vaid is Chairman & MD and his son Ankur Vaid is Joint MD & CEO. The Vaid family (Sudhir, his wife Manju, Ankur, Ankur's wife Megha, daughter Sonal Kumra) and the family firm Sudman Consultants own 44.1%. The RARE trusts (the late Rakesh Jhunjhunwala's family) have a nominee, Rajiv Agarwal, on the board as a non-executive director.

people.name: Sudhir Vaid
people.relation: Founder; father of Joint MD Ankur Vaid
people.stake: 28.84% (FY26 annual report); family and family firm together 44.1%
people.bio: Graduated in microbiology from Punjab University in 1974 and has about 50 years in biopharmaceuticals. He was Director of Biotechnology at Ranbaxy Laboratories before founding Concord in 2000, which he built into a large maker of fermentation-based APIs such as immunosuppressants. He is a member of the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre and chairs the advisory council of Gujarat Biotechnology University.

people.name: Ankur Vaid
people.relation: Son of the Chairman Sudhir Vaid; husband of Megha Vaid; brother of Sonal Kumra
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University and an MBA from Rochester Institute of Technology. He has about 19 years in pharma and has been on the board since December 2009. He oversees business development, R&D, manufacturing and strategy, and leads the push into formulations and new fermentation products. His pay in FY26 was about ₹3.9cr.

people.name: Raviraj Karia
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant with over 23 years in pharma, healthcare, clinical research, logistics and private equity. His past employers include Intas Pharmaceuticals, Claris Lifesciences, Lambda Therapeutics, Shalby Hospitals, Sakar Healthcare, Gati and GVFL. He took over as CFO in December 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Lalit Sethi retired early for personal reasons (effective 5 Jan 2026); Raviraj Karia became CFO from 18 Dec 2025. Company Secretary Hina Patel resigned in Jan 2026; Paritosh Trivedi replaced her from 11 Feb 2026. Ekta Sanghi Gupta joined as an independent director in June 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr Satish Wagh is Executive Chairman. His daughters run the company day to day: Dr Saloni Wagh is MD and Shivani Wagh is Joint MD; their mother Smita Wagh is a whole-time director. The family owns 68.3%, almost all in Satish Wagh's name. There has been no separate CEO since Rajeev Kumar Jain retired in June 2024.

people.name: Dr Satish Wagh
people.relation: Founder; father of Saloni and Shivani Wagh
people.bio: Holds a science degree from the University of Mumbai and an honorary doctorate in entrepreneurship from National American University. He has over 35 years in pharma. He started Supriya as a partnership firm in 1987 and built it into a maker of about 40 niche APIs such as anaesthetics, vitamins and antihistamines, listing it in 2021. He handed the MD role to his daughter Saloni in August 2024 and stayed on as Executive Chairman. He also chairs the common effluent treatment plant at MIDC Lote, where the main plant sits.

people.name: Dr Saloni Wagh
people.relation: Daughter of Satish and Smita Wagh; sister of Shivani Wagh
people.bio: Holds a science degree from Sathaye College and a master's from the Institute of Science (both University of Mumbai), and a PhD in chemistry from Pacific University, Udaipur. She joined the company in 2014, became a whole-time director in July 2019 and Managing Director in August 2024. She looks after exports, marketing and business development and the overall running of the company.

people.name: Shivani Wagh
people.relation: Daughter of Satish and Smita Wagh; sister of Saloni Wagh
people.bio: Holds a master's in management studies from M.L. Dahanukar College (University of Mumbai) and a master's in international business management from Manchester Business School. She joined in 2014, became a whole-time director in July 2019 and Joint MD in August 2024. She handles exports, mainly to Europe, plus marketing and business development.

people.name: Smita Wagh
people.relation: Mother of Saloni and Shivani Wagh
people.bio: Holds bachelor's degrees in arts and education from the University of Mumbai. She has been a director since the company was incorporated in 2008 and serves as a whole-time director.

people.name: Balasaheb Sawant
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. from Shivaji University, Kolhapur. He has over 29 years in API production planning, materials management and process operations, and sits on the board as a whole-time director responsible for plant operations.

people.name: Krishna Raghunathan
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant with a B.Sc. in zoology from Madras University and over 23 years in finance. He spent about five years as Vice President of Finance, Treasury and Investor Relations at a listed drug maker, and has worked at Granules India, Dr Reddy's Laboratories and Aptar Group. He became CFO in January 2023.

people.name: Dr Shekhar Bhirud
people.role: President, Business Development, Strategy and R&D
people.bio: Named by the company as senior management, heading business development, strategy and R&D. The annual report gives no further career details.

companies.changes: No change in executives in FY26. Two independent directors (Dileep Kumar Jain and Dinesh Modi) left on 24 Mar 2026 at the end of their five-year terms. CEO Rajeev Kumar Jain retired in June 2024 and was not replaced.

companies.styleNote: Co-founder Vishnukant Bhutada is Managing Director. His sons run the big subsidiaries: Keshav Bhutada is ED & CEO of the API arm Shilpa Pharma Lifesciences, and Madhav Bhutada is MD of the biologics arm. The chairman, Omprakash Inani, is a non-executive promoter from the Inani family. The Bhutada and Inani families together own about 40.1%. The annual report says none of the directors are related to each other.

people.name: Vishnukant Bhutada
people.relation: Co-founder; father of Keshav and Madhav Bhutada
people.stake: 6.51% (FY26 annual report); Bhutada and Inani families together about 40.1%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in pharmacy and has over 37 years in the drug industry. He is one of the founders of Shilpa Medicare, set up in 1987, and the company credits him as the main force behind its growth into a large exporter of cancer APIs. Under him the group expanded from APIs into formulations, biologics, CDMO work and new drug-delivery forms such as oral films and patches.

people.name: Sharath Reddy Kalakota
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree in pharmacy from BITS Pilani and a bachelor's degree from Gulbarga University, Raichur. He joined Shilpa in 1991 and has long experience in API manufacturing, operations and building new and expanded plants. He was re-appointed as whole-time director for five years from October 2025.

people.name: Keshav Bhutada
people.role: Executive Director & CEO, Shilpa Pharma Lifesciences (API and CDMO subsidiary)
people.relation: Son of MD Vishnukant Bhutada; brother of Madhav Bhutada
people.bio: Heads the group's API and CDMO business, housed in the material subsidiary Shilpa Pharma Lifesciences, as Executive Director and CEO. In FY26 that business grew API revenue 17% and saw its first US new-drug CDMO programme reach commercial launch. The company has not published his education or earlier career.

people.name: Madhav Bhutada
people.relation: Son of MD Vishnukant Bhutada; brother of Keshav Bhutada
people.bio: Runs the biologics business, including biosimilars, antibody-drug conjugates, the recombinant albumin programme and the Dharwad CDMO site. Shareholders are being asked in 2026 to approve a commission of up to 1% of Shilpa Biologicals' profit for him as a non-executive director there. The company has not published his education or earlier career.

people.name: Alpesh Dalal
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant with about 23 years in corporate finance, M&A, strategy, fund-raising, controllership and investor relations. He was Director, Corporate Finance at Raymond and earlier worked at Cipla and Lupin. He was named 'Turnaround CFO of the Year' (medium enterprise) at the ETCFO Leadership Summit 2026.

people.name: Dr Vellaian Karuppiah
people.bio: Holds a postgraduate degree and a doctorate in pharmacy. He has more than 30 years across formulation and analytical R&D, regulatory affairs, manufacturing, quality and supply chain, with senior roles at Gland Pharma, Strides, Dr Reddy's and Actavis, and was most recently COO at Acme Group and Immacule Lifesciences. He joined in April 2026 to tighten operations and quality at the formulation plants, one of which is under a US import alert.

companies.changes: Dr Jayant Karajgi, COO Formulations, retired on 22 Apr 2026; Dr Vellaian Karuppiah replaced him from 23 Apr 2026. At Shilpa Biologicals, CEO Dr Sridevi Kambhapaty resigned on 15 Jul 2026 and Dr Uday Harle took over on 31 Jul 2026.

companies.styleNote: Two related promoter families run it. Rahul Nachane is MD and his brother-in-law Rajesh Lawande is whole-time director and CFO; Rahul's wife Ajita Nachane (Rajesh's sister) is a non-executive director. Ahaan Nachane, a relative of Rahul and Ajita, is Vice President. Promoters own 72.5%. The chairman, Dhananjay Mungale, is independent.

people.name: Rahul Nachane
people.relation: Husband of director Ajita Nachane; brother-in-law of Rajesh Lawande
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant with a master's in management studies (B.Com, ACA, MMS, DBF). He has 37 years in pharma, has handled marketing, production and general management at NGL since 1989 and has been a full-time director since 1992. He built NGL into a leading maker of veterinary APIs that supplies five of the world's ten largest animal-health companies. He also sits on the boards of the promoter companies Nupur Remedies and Vetfar Pharmaceuticals. His FY26 pay was about ₹2.8cr, most of it profit commission.

people.name: Rajesh Lawande
people.relation: Brother of Ajita Nachane; brother-in-law of MD Rahul Nachane
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. in chemistry from IIT Bombay and a PGDM from IIM Lucknow. He joined NGL in 2002 and has led R&D, market expansion, sales and manufacturing; he is now also CFO. He is the largest single shareholder. Shareholders are being asked to re-appoint him for five years from June 2026 with pay of up to ₹4cr a year.

people.name: Ahaan Nachane
people.relation: Relative of Rahul and Ajita Nachane (per the annual report's related-party list)
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from Cornell University and an MBA from INSEAD. He joined NGL in June 2021 and is listed as senior management; his FY26 pay was about ₹47 lakh.

companies.changes: No change in executives. Company Secretary Pallavi Pednekar resigned in Jan 2026; Shivam Gharat took over from 3 Feb 2026. Independent director Jayaram Sitaram left in Aug 2025 at the end of his term and Sudhir Deo (former MD of NOCIL) joined in May 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founded in 2004 (as Ami Organics) by Nareshkumar Patel and Chetankumar Vaghasia, who are not related to each other. Patel is Executive Chairman & MD and Vaghasia is whole-time director. Promoters own 32.7%; each founder sold about 13.5 lakh shares in FY26. Two long-serving professionals, Virendranath Mishra and Ram Mohan Lokhande, are also whole-time directors.

people.name: Nareshkumar Patel
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter
people.bio: Holds a bachelor of engineering degree from Gujarat University and is a chemical engineer. He ran a chemicals firm in Surat, CNR Intermediates, before co-founding Ami Organics in 2004. He built it into a leading maker of advanced pharma intermediates and led its move into battery electrolytes and semiconductor chemicals, renaming it Acutaas. Hurun listed him among India's top 200 self-made entrepreneurs in 2025. His FY26 pay was about ₹6.4cr.

people.name: Chetankumar Vaghasia
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to Patel
people.bio: Holds a diploma in man-made textile processing from the Mantra Education Institute, Surat. He co-ran CNR Intermediates with Patel before co-founding Ami Organics in 2004. He heads HR, logistics and dispatch, procurement and IT, and takes part in operations, planning and strategy. His FY26 pay was about ₹6.4cr.

people.name: Virendranath Mishra
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. and an M.Sc. in chemistry from Purvanchal University, Jaunpur. He worked in R&D at K.A. Malle Pharmaceuticals and at Surya Organics before joining Ami Organics as production manager in 2005. He became Director – Operations in 2018 and is now a whole-time director.

people.name: Ram Mohan Lokhande
people.bio: A chemical engineer with more than 20 years in pharma, chemicals and bulk-drug manufacturing; he previously worked at ZCL Chemicals. He joined in July 2021 as President – Operations and became a whole-time director in February 2022. He runs day-to-day operations at all plants, including production, process improvement, projects and ESG. The board has proposed re-appointing him for five years from February 2027.

people.name: Bhavin Shah
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant with over 18 years in consulting, corporate accounts and finance. He was Deputy General Manager at Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company (SPARC), led the finance team at Unimark Remedies and worked as a consultant at Deloitte Haskins & Sells. He joined as Deputy CFO in March 2022 and became CFO in June 2022.

companies.changes: No director or KMP changes in FY26. In September 2026 shareholders rejected a proposed employee share-option scheme (72.6% in favour against 75% needed).

companies.styleNote: Akshay Arora, with the company since 1983, is Executive Chairman and his son Shiven Arora is Managing Director. The Arora family (Akshay, Shiven and Archana Arora) owns about 73.2% after the July 2026 share placement, down from 86% in 2024. Two long-serving executives, Naresh Shah and Popat Kedar, are whole-time directors; a hired COO and CFO run operations and finance.

people.name: Akshay Arora
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD Shiven Arora
people.stake: 62.80% at 31 Mar 2026 (FY26 annual report), about 57.6% after the July 2026 placement; family together about 73.2%
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in chemistry from the University of Bombay and an M.Sc. in organic chemistry from St. Xavier's College, Mumbai. He has been with the company since April 1983, over 40 years, and built it into one of the few makers of contrast-media intermediates and the artificial sweetener saccharin. He became Executive Chairman in April 2022. He sold about 6.2% of the company through an offer for sale in September 2025 to meet public-shareholding rules. The board has proposed re-appointing him for five years from April 2027.

people.name: Shiven Arora
people.relation: Son of Executive Chairman Akshay Arora
people.stake: 10.96% at 31 Mar 2026 (FY26 annual report), about 10.0% after the July 2026 placement
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's degree in business from Bond University, Gold Coast, Australia. He has more than 10 years with the company and has been on the board since 2015. As MD he leads the business, including the new Mahad and Ambernath expansions and the ₹800cr share placement of July 2026. The board has proposed re-appointing him for five years from April 2027.

people.name: Naresh Shah
people.bio: Holds a diploma in chemical engineering from Khopoli Polytechnic, Raigad. He has more than 30 years at the company in sales, marketing, business development and commercial work, and oversees business development. He joined the board in December 2020 and was re-appointed for five years from December 2025.

people.name: Popat Kedar
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. and an M.Sc. in chemistry from Shivaji University, Kolhapur. He has over 20 years in chemicals and pharma and was re-designated a whole-time director in September 2025.

people.name: Ganesh Karuppannan
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant (ICAI member since 1988) with over 35 years of experience. He joined Blue Jet in 2021 and has been CFO through its 2023 listing.

people.name: Vimalendu Kumar Singh
people.bio: Holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Kanpur and a master's programme from IIFT, New Delhi. He previously worked at Strides Pharma, Emcure Pharmaceuticals, RPG Life Sciences and Ranbaxy Laboratories. He runs operations and is named by the company as senior management.

people.name: Dr Chandrashekhar Parenkey
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. from the University of Mysore, an M.Sc. in chemistry from BITS Pilani and a PhD from the University of Bombay. He was CEO of Amoli Organics and of Kores (India), and President of R&D at Blue Circle Organics, before joining Blue Jet, where he heads R&D.

companies.changes: No director or KMP left in FY26. Payal Gandhi became Chief Business Strategy Officer in June 2025. Akshay Arora sold about 6.2% via an offer for sale in Sept 2025, and the company raised ₹800cr through a share placement on 9 Jul 2026, lifting public holding to 26.85%.

companies.styleNote: Founder Chandulal Kothia is Chairman & MD and his son Parth Kothia is whole-time director and CFO. His other son, Gunjan Kothia, left the board in September 2025 but still heads business development and innovation and leads the earnings calls. Promoters own about 73%.

people.name: Chandulal Kothia
people.relation: Founder; father of Parth and Gunjan Kothia
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. in physical chemistry from R. A. Science College, Gujarat, and a diploma in pharmacy from L. M. College of Pharmacy. He has more than two decades in making pharma intermediates, bulk drugs, fine chemicals, pigments and plastics. He has been a director since the company was set up in April 1995 and sets its strategy and customer relationships. His FY26 pay was ₹1.2cr.

people.name: Parth Kothia
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Chandulal Kothia; brother of Gunjan Kothia
people.bio: A chemical engineering graduate with an M.S. in global finance from Fordham University, USA. He has worked in the company's business development and finance since 2021 and was re-appointed as whole-time director and CFO for five years from January 2026.

people.name: Gunjan Kothia
people.relation: Son of Chairman & MD Chandulal Kothia; brother of Parth Kothia
people.bio: Holds a master's in polymers, colorants and fine chemicals from the University of Leeds and an undergraduate degree from Gujarat Technological University. He was a whole-time director until 15 September 2025, when he left the board to focus on business development and innovation. He is listed as senior management and still leads the investor calls.

companies.changes: Gunjan Kothia resigned as whole-time director on 15 Sep 2025 but stays as Head of Business Development & Innovation. Independent director Priyam Shah resigned on 7 Nov 2025, citing preoccupation.

companies.styleNote: Part of the Aarti group, run by its founding families (Patil, Gogri, Savla and Shah). From 1 Oct 2026 Rashesh Gogri (son of group founder and Chairman Emeritus Chandrakant Gogri) becomes Chairman as well as MD, and Adhish Patil (son of retiring Chairman Prakash Patil) becomes MD. Promoters own about 54%. Rashesh Gogri also runs Aarti Industries, so his time is split across the group.

people.name: Rashesh Gogri
people.relation: Son of Aarti group founder and Chairman Emeritus Chandrakant Gogri
people.stake: 4.64% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 54%
people.bio: Holds a production engineering degree from Mumbai University and has over 27 years in production, marketing and project work in chemicals and pharma. He joined the board as whole-time director in October 2012 and has been MD since September 2014. He is also Vice-Chairman & MD of Aarti Industries and Chairman of Aarti Pharmalabs. He takes over as Chairman on 1 October 2026.

people.name: Adhish Patil
people.role: Managing Director from 1 Oct 2026 (CFO & COO until then)
people.relation: Son of retiring Chairman, MD & CEO Prakash Patil
people.bio: Holds a bachelor of engineering (IT) from Mumbai University and an MBA in finance and marketing from the University of Florida's Warrington College of Business, where he was a gold medallist. He has 21 years across manufacturing operations, finance, investor relations, compliance, consulting and IT. He has been CFO since April 2014, later also COO, leading finance, technical and commercial work. He was on the 'Top 100 CFOs India 2014' list. He becomes MD for five years from 1 October 2026, subject to shareholder approval.

people.name: Harshit Savla
people.relation: Promoter-group member
people.bio: A commerce graduate who has been with the company since 1987, with over 39 years in finance, exports and administration. He helped build the API and formulation businesses. The board has proposed renewing his term for five years from June 2027.

people.name: Harit Shah
people.relation: Promoter-group member
people.stake: about 2.7% (24.37 lakh shares; FY26 annual report)
people.bio: A commerce graduate and executive director since September 1995. He has over 39 years handling sales, purchasing and exports and looks after domestic sales and exports. The board has proposed renewing his term for five years from June 2027.

people.name: Nilesh Patil
people.role: Whole-time Director (proposed at the Sept 2026 AGM)
people.bio: Holds a B.Com. and an MBA in human resource management. He has been with the company for over 33 years and is General Manager – Administration, running warehouses, factory administration and dealings with regulators. He is not related to any director and is not a promoter. He replaces Uday Patil on the board.

companies.changes: Prakash Patil, a founder and Chairman, MD & CEO, retires on 30 Sep 2026 (announced 31 Jul 2026). Rashesh Gogri adds the chairmanship and Adhish Patil becomes MD from 1 Oct 2026; no successor CFO has been named yet. Executive director Uday Patil (Prakash's brother) did not seek re-appointment at the 26 Sep 2026 AGM; Nilesh Patil was proposed in his place.

companies.styleNote: Varinder Gupta, with the company since 1986, is MD and his two sons are on the board: Vikas Gupta is Joint MD and Abhiraj Gupta is Executive Director. The chairman, Rajender Mohan Malla, is independent. Promoters own about 62%, mostly through the family firms Mayadevi Polycot and NCVI Enterprises, which have been buying on the market; Varinder Gupta himself holds about 2%.

people.name: Varinder Gupta
people.relation: Promoter; father of Vikas and Abhiraj Gupta
people.stake: 2.04% (FY26 annual report); promoter group together about 62%
people.bio: An industrialist with about 40 years in chemicals and pharma; IOL was his first employer, which he joined in September 1986. He has led its growth into one of the world's largest ibuprofen makers, backed by its own isobutyl benzene and acetyl chemicals. His FY26 pay was ₹11.58cr; total managerial pay was ₹21.75cr, about 16% of profit.

people.name: Vikas Gupta
people.relation: Son of MD Varinder Gupta; brother of Abhiraj Gupta
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. (Hons) in business management from King's College London. He joined IOL in July 2013, his first job, and works in its strategy function, guiding the chemical and pharma businesses. He was re-appointed Joint MD for five years from May 2025. His FY26 pay was ₹3.54cr.

people.name: Abhiraj Gupta
people.relation: Son of MD Varinder Gupta; brother of Vikas Gupta
people.bio: Holds a B.Sc. in management and engineering (business management) from the University of Warwick, UK. He joined IOL in September 2017 and runs the non-ibuprofen API and chemicals business, plus R&D, regulatory affairs and digital marketing. That non-ibuprofen API business has grown fast and is now over 40% of pharma sales.

people.name: Kushal Kumar Rana
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in chemistry, physics and maths, a master's in chemistry and IIM Bangalore's strategic leadership programme. He has over 33 years in pharma, earlier at Morepen Laboratories and Chemiplast Industries, and joined IOL in April 2005. He oversees quality, EHS and regulatory compliance at the plants.

people.name: Pardeep Kumar Khanna
people.bio: Holds an M.Com. and has 37 years of experience, all at IOL, which he joined in December 1995. He is the CFO and a member of the risk management committee.

people.name: Gopal Singla
people.bio: Holds a B.E. in instrumentation and has 28 years of experience. He joined from Indian Acrylics in April 2007 and heads engineering, including the plant expansions.

people.name: Dr Damandeep Singh
people.bio: Holds a PhD and has 28 years of experience, all at IOL since October 1997. He leads new product development, key to the push beyond ibuprofen.

companies.changes: No change in KMP or senior management in FY26. Vikas Gupta was re-appointed Joint MD for five years from 29 May 2025.

companies.styleNote: Founder Ramesh Babu Potluri is Chairman & MD and his eldest son Vamsi Krishna Potluri is Executive Director. His younger son Trilok Potluri and Vamsi's father-in-law, Dr S.V.S.S. Prasad, sit on the board as non-executive directors. The Potluri family and its firms own about 68%, raised through warrants converted at ₹127 a share.

people.name: Ramesh Babu Potluri
people.relation: Founder-promoter; father of Vamsi Krishna and Trilok Potluri
people.stake: 19.38% (FY26 annual report); Potluri family and firms together about 68%
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. and has over 40 years in pharma R&D, process innovation, manufacturing and business leadership. In 1990 he bought SMS Pharmaceuticals when it was a sick company, turned it profitable in the first year and built it into a leading API maker, first in ranitidine and now mainly in anti-inflammatory and HIV drugs. He has served on the board of Chemexcil and advised the Andhra Pradesh government on pharma, and is also a director of Avanti Feeds. The board has re-appointed him for five years from October 2026. His FY26 pay was ₹6.46cr.

people.name: Vamsi Krishna Potluri
people.relation: Eldest son of Chairman Ramesh Babu Potluri; brother of Trilok Potluri; son-in-law of director Dr S.V.S.S. Prasad
people.bio: A graduate of BITS Pilani, Dubai, with a master's in engineering management from Missouri University of Science and Technology, USA. He worked in supply chain at Ohm Laboratories before joining SMS at a young age. He runs operations and was re-appointed whole-time director for three years from July 2025. His FY26 pay was ₹6.46cr, the same as his father's.

people.name: T. Lakshmi Narayana
people.bio: Named by the company as CFO and senior management. The annual report does not give his education or earlier career.

companies.changes: No change in KMP or senior management in FY26. Vamsi Krishna Potluri was re-appointed from 1 Jul 2025; Ramesh Babu Potluri's re-appointment from 1 Oct 2026 went to the 2026 AGM.

companies.styleNote: The promoter group of Arun Kumar Pillai (founder of Strides) owns about 42% but he sits on the board only as a non-executive director. A hired team runs the company: MD & CEO Sandeep Rao and CFO Sarat Kumar both joined in February 2025, having worked at Tenshi Pharma. The chairman, Ramakrishnan Rajagopal, is independent. Strides, a promoter-group company, buys about a quarter of Solara's output.

people.name: Sandeep Rao
people.bio: Holds an M.Sc. in chemistry from IIT Bombay and an MBA from IIM Lucknow, with over 25 years of experience. He spent 16 years at Biocon, ending as Senior Vice President and head of the insulins business, then was VP and head of emerging-markets business development at Viatris. He was CEO of Tenshi Pharma from July 2024 before taking over at Solara in February 2025 for three years. His fixed pay is ₹3.25cr a year.

people.name: Sarat Kumar
people.role: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Investor Relations Officer
people.bio: A cost accountant (ICMAI member) with a PGDBA from IMT Ghaziabad and a Sloan Fellowship in leadership and strategy from London Business School. He has over 18 years in finance roles at Strides Pharma Science, BioCina, Torrent Power and Shell, and was CFO of Tenshi Pharma. He became CFO in February 2025.

people.name: Mohanraj Sanjeevi
people.role: Whole-time Director & Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Heads HR as Chief Human Resources Officer and joined the board as a whole-time director on 1 January 2026 for three years, after COO Mohan Muthunarayanan left the board. His fixed pay is ₹85 lakh a year. The company has not published his education or earlier career.

people.name: Vishal Mathur
people.bio: Holds an MBA from Chetana Institute of Management. He spent 16 years at Glenmark (VP, sales and marketing), was EVP and head of marketing for Emcure's API division, and was Chief Commercial Officer at Cohance Lifesciences before joining Solara in 2025.

companies.changes: Whole-time director and COO Mohan Muthunarayanan resigned on 31 Dec 2025; Mohanraj Sanjeevi joined the board on 1 Jan 2026. Non-executive director Kartheek Chintalapati Raju resigned on 5 Nov 2025. The MD, CFO and company secretary all changed in 2025.

companies.styleNote: Two founding families run it. Sajankumar Bajaj is Chairman & MD and his daughter Namrata Bajaj is a whole-time director; Anil Jain is MD and his son Pakshal Jain is a whole-time director. Promoters own 58.3%, about 51% of it with the Bajaj family.

people.name: Sajankumar Bajaj
people.relation: Promoter; father of Namrata Bajaj
people.bio: A commerce graduate with over three decades at Bajaj Healthcare. He took it from a single plant to a drug maker with several integrated API and formulation sites, and looks after finance, marketing and procurement. He was re-appointed for three years from April 2026.

people.name: Anil Jain
people.relation: Promoter; father of Pakshal Jain
people.bio: Holds a diploma in pharmacy and has over three decades at the company, overseeing overall operations. He now leads business development, market expansion and customer relationships. He was re-appointed for three years from April 2026.

people.name: Namrata Bajaj
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman & MD Sajankumar Bajaj
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in business administration from the Indian Institute of Planning and Management, Mumbai. She has over 10 years in sales and marketing at the company and runs sales and marketing for the formulation division. She was re-appointed for three years from April 2026.

people.name: Pakshal Jain
people.relation: Son of MD Anil Jain
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in marketing and entrepreneurship from the Indian School of Management & Entrepreneurship, Mumbai. He has been with the company for over six years and oversees marketing and production for the API and formulation businesses, including contract manufacturing. He was re-appointed for three years from June 2026.

people.name: Rohan Parekh
people.bio: A Chartered Accountant with over 13 years in corporate strategy, planning and analysis, audit and treasury. He worked at Ashv Finance, Home First Finance Company and Walker Chandiok & Co before becoming CFO in April 2025.

companies.changes: CFO Dayashankar Patel resigned on 15 Apr 2025; Rohan Parekh took over the next day. Whole-time director Dhananjay Hatle resigned on 5 Jun 2025. Independent directors Sandeep Shah (became non-executive director) and Yaqoob Ali resigned in 2025; Hemant Karnik and Ram Banarse completed their terms in Jan 2026. Promoters and others converted warrants into 20.8 lakh shares at ₹338 in March 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Amit Bakshi is Chairman and MD and owns 42%. Two fellow founders, Inderjeet Singh Negi and Kaushal Shah, are executive directors. The annual report says none of the directors are related to each other. Promoters together own 54%.

people.name: Amit Bakshi
people.relation: Founder and main promoter
people.bio: Amit Bakshi founded Eris in 2007 in Ahmedabad and has been on the board since then. Before that he spent more than a decade in pharma sales and marketing, most recently at Intas Pharmaceuticals, which he left along with three colleagues to start Eris. He set up Eris as a branded chronic-therapy company selling cardiac and diabetes medicines to Indian doctors, and has since grown it through acquisitions, including the Biocon branded formulations, Swiss Parenterals and insulin businesses. EY named him Entrepreneur of the Year in 2013. He was re-appointed MD for five years from April 2026 to March 2031. His son, Parv Bakshi, works in the company in a non-board role.

people.name: Inderjeet Singh Negi
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: Inderjeet Singh Negi has been on the Eris board since the company started and runs supply chain and sales administration. He previously worked at several drug companies, including Sun Pharma and Intas Pharma, and has more than 22 years of experience. He is a science graduate from HNB Garhwal University. His son Sarthak Negi works in the company in a non-board role.

people.name: Kaushal Kamlesh Shah
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter; not related to the other directors
people.bio: Kaushal Shah has been with Eris since it was founded and is responsible for manufacturing, strategic sourcing and distribution. He has about 27 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry. He holds a commerce degree from Gujarat University and a postgraduate diploma in management from the Som-Lalit Institute of Management Studies. He retires by rotation and is up for re-appointment at the September 2026 AGM.

people.name: Sachin Shah
people.bio: Sachin Shah has been Eris's Chief Financial Officer since December 2012, before the company's 2017 listing. He is named as senior management and a key managerial person in the FY26 annual report and presents the numbers on the quarterly calls. He also sits on the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Milind Talegaonkar
people.bio: Milind Talegaonkar is Eris's Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and is listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report. He handles the company's filings with the stock exchanges and board matters.

companies.changes: Executive Director and COO Krishnakumar Vaidyanathan (ex-EY corporate finance partner, IIM Calcutta MBA) resigned in September 2026, effective 30 Sep 2026, to pursue opportunities outside the company; no successor named yet. Independent director Rajeev Dalal retired in Dec 2025 and Vineet Varma joined in Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder V.C. Nannapaneni is Chairman and MD, and his son Rajeev is Vice Chairman and CEO. Two long-serving employees are executive directors. The founder owns 15.7% directly; the promoter group, including family investment companies, owns 49.4%.

people.name: V.C. Nannapaneni
people.relation: Founder; father of Rajeev Nannapaneni
people.bio: Venkaiah Chowdary Nannapaneni founded Natco in Hyderabad in 1981. He has a postgraduate pharmacy degree from Andhra University and a master's in pharmaceutical administration from Brooklyn College of Pharmacy in New York. He spent about 13 years in the US working in the R&D departments of drug companies before returning to India to start Natco. He built it into a company known for first-to-market generics, especially in cancer. He is also managing trustee of the NATCO Trust, the group's charity. Like the other executive directors, he is now re-appointed one year at a time (latest term from April 2026).

people.name: Rajeev Nannapaneni
people.relation: Son of the Chairman
people.bio: Rajeev Nannapaneni is the founder's son and runs the company day to day as Vice Chairman and CEO. He has an undergraduate degree from Tufts University in the US. He worked at Merrill Lynch and at Natco Systems LLC before joining Natco, where he headed new business and new product development for India and international markets.

people.name: P.S.R.K. Prasad
people.role: Executive Director & Executive Vice President (Corporate Engineering Services)
people.bio: P.S.R.K. Prasad runs Natco's corporate engineering: building and maintaining its plants. He has a mechanical engineering degree from Andhra University (1981). Before Natco he worked at the Ahmedabad Textile Industries Research Association, Coromandel Fertilizers, Stiles India and Saudi Ceramic Co. in Riyadh.

people.name: Dr. D. Linga Rao
people.bio: Dr. Linga Rao heads technical affairs, covering R&D, quality control, quality assurance and regulatory work. He has an M.Sc. in applied chemistry and a PhD in chemistry from JNTU Hyderabad. Before Natco he worked at the government-owned Indian Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd (IDPL) and at Novochem Laboratories. He has spent more than two decades at Natco.

people.name: Amit Parekh
people.bio: Amit Parekh joined Natco in late 2025 as Executive Vice President, Finance and Accounts, and became CFO on 13 February 2026 as part of planned succession. He was earlier at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, where he was head of finance for its API and pharmaceutical services (PSAI) business and led digital change in the finance function. He has more than 23 years of finance experience across healthcare, pharma, mining and engineering, telecom and chemicals, including M&A and drug in-licensing and out-licensing deals.

companies.changes: CFO S.V.V.N. Appa Rao retired on 12 Feb 2026; Amit Parekh took over on 13 Feb 2026. Kalakuntla Srinivas Rao joined as EVP, Pharma Division, in Feb 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Arun Kumar stepped back to non-executive Chairman in April 2025, and his son Aditya moved from executive director to a non-executive seat on 1 June 2026. The company is run by a hired MD and Group CEO, Badree Komandur. Arun Kumar and relatives own about 14.7%; the promoter group owns 27.9%.

people.name: Badree Komandur
people.relation: Professional; not related to the promoters
people.bio: Badree Komandur has run Strides as MD and Group CEO since June 2024, for a three-year term. He has a commerce degree from the University of Madras and is a chartered accountant, company secretary and cost accountant, with a CHRO programme from Wharton (2023). He spent over 15 years in IT and engineering companies before joining Strides in February 2010, where he led finance, tax, treasury, M&A and investor relations and was Executive Director (Finance) from 2016.

people.name: Ramaraju P.V.S. (Venkata Seetharama Raju Pakalapati)
people.since: Executive Director since June 2026; COO since March 2024; at Strides since 2007
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Ramaraju, known as Ram, joined the board as Executive Director on 1 June 2026 after two years as Chief Operating Officer. He has a master's in pharmaceutical chemistry from BITS Pilani. He worked at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, USV and Unichem Laboratories before joining the Strides group in 2007, where he held quality, manufacturing and operations roles at Strides and Stelis Biopharma (now OneSource). He runs global operations: manufacturing, supply chain and procurement.

people.name: Vikesh Kumar
people.bio: Vikesh Kumar is Group CFO and a key managerial person. He has a postgraduate diploma in management from the S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research in Mumbai and completed Wharton's Global C-Suite programme. He joined Strides in 2009 and built its global business finance function. He won CII's Leading CFO award for 'Excellence in Turnaround' in 2024.

people.name: Peter Hardwick
people.bio: Peter Hardwick runs Strides' largest market, the US, and was hired during FY26. He has a science degree from Saint Mary's University in Halifax, Canada. He spent many years at the Canadian generics maker Apotex, including as President and CEO of its US generics arm and as Chief Commercial Officer of its global generics division until August 2023. He has more than 30 years of senior experience in sales, marketing and portfolio management.

people.name: Amol Mehta
people.bio: Amol Mehta runs the non-US regulated markets (UK, Nordics, South Africa, Australia and others), Strides' fastest-growing region. He is a chemical engineer from MS University and has an MBA from the Symbiosis Institute of International Business, with executive courses at IIM Ahmedabad and the LSE. He worked at Reliance (Dorf Ketal), Nicholas Piramal and Emcure and returned to Strides in 2022.

people.name: Manjula Ramamurthy
people.bio: Manjula Ramamurthy is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and a key managerial person, as listed in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: Aditya Arun Kumar (founder's son) stepped down as Executive Director, Business Development on 31 May 2026 and became a non-executive director from 1 June 2026, in line with the promoters' stated aim to professionalise management. COO Ramaraju P.V.S. became Executive Director on 1 June 2026. Group CHRO Surabhi Loshali left in January 2026.

companies.styleNote: Founder Sanjay Shah is Chairman and MD, and Aarsh Shah, whom the annual report names as related to him, is Joint MD. Co-founder Rita Shah left the board in September 2025. The Shah family owns 52.9%.

people.name: Sanjay S. Shah
people.relation: Founder with Rita Shah; related to Joint MD Aarsh Shah
people.bio: Sanjay Shah founded Sakar Healthcare in 2004 with Rita Shah and has been a director since incorporation. He has been MD since February 2015 and was re-appointed until November 2027. He holds an MBA and a diploma in plastic technology, and worked in the pharmaceutical, mineral water and plastics industries before Sakar. He oversees production, sales, marketing and finance and has led the company's move into anti-cancer products. His pay rose to ₹2.4cr in FY26, up 233% on the year.

people.name: Aarsh S. Shah
people.relation: Promoter; related to the Chairman & MD Sanjay Shah (annual report)
people.bio: Aarsh Shah is a promoter and Joint Managing Director. He is a pharmacist and holds an MBA from Cardiff University in the UK. He works on production, international sales and marketing, and relationships with key customers. His pay was ₹1.8cr in FY26, up 200% on the year.

people.name: Sunil Marathe
people.bio: Sunil Marathe joined the board as Whole-time Director (Technical) in November 2023. He holds a master's degree in organic chemistry and has more than 30 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, quality, technology transfer and plant operations.

people.name: Sudhir Ghule
people.bio: Sudhir Ghule became COO in July 2025. He is a pharmacist with over three decades of experience at Zydus Lifesciences, Cipla, Sun Pharma and Lupin, where he headed technical and quality functions and clusters of plants. He has handled strict regulatory audits, including by the US FDA, the UK MHRA and Australia's TGA, which matters as Sakar seeks more regulated-market approvals.

people.name: Dharmesh R. Thaker
people.bio: Dharmesh Thaker has been CFO since October 2021, when he replaced the retiring Johnny George. He is a commerce graduate with more than three decades in accounting and had worked in Sakar's finance department since 2016.

people.name: Bharat S. Soni
people.bio: Bharat Soni is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and a key managerial person, as listed in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: Co-founder Rita S. Shah resigned as a non-executive director on 27 Sep 2025. Senior Vice Presidents Raviraj Karia (Finance) and Nimesh Suthar (International Business), both hired in July 2025, left during FY26. No executive changes found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Jayesh Choksi is Chairman and MD and his son Pranav is CEO. The Choksi family and its companies own about 72.5%.

people.name: Jayesh P. Choksi
people.relation: Promoter; father of CEO Pranav Choksi
people.bio: Jayesh Choksi is the promoter, Chairman and Managing Director. He has a bachelor's degree in pharmacy and more than 45 years in the pharmaceutical industry. He built Gufic into a group with businesses across Sparsh, critical care, Aesthaderm, infertility and APIs. Vipula Jayesh Choksi holds another 10.0%, and promoter companies Zircon Teconica and Gufic Pvt Ltd hold 20.5% and 10.2%.

people.name: Pranav J. Choksi
people.relation: Son of the Chairman & MD
people.bio: Pranav Choksi joined Gufic in 2004 and runs the company as CEO. He has a bachelor's in pharmacy from the Institute of Chemical Technology, Mumbai, and a master's in biotechnology from Johns Hopkins University in the US, where he specialised in cancer vaccines. He has led the international push and the plant approvals from the EU, Brazil's ANVISA, Health Canada and Australia's TGA. He also leads the investor calls.

people.name: Pankaj J. Gandhi
people.since: Re-appointed for five years from September 2026
people.relation: Non-promoter
people.bio: Pankaj Gandhi is a non-promoter executive director who handles regulatory liaison. He has a commerce degree from the University of Mumbai and more than 30 years of experience dealing with drug regulators and managing regulatory affairs.

people.name: Nagesh Yarrabathina
people.bio: Nagesh Yarrabathina is COO and heads the list of senior management in the FY26 annual report. He also sits on the board's risk management committee.

people.name: Devkinandan B. Roonghta
people.bio: Devkinandan Roonghta is CFO and a key managerial person. He sits on the risk management committee and joins the investor calls with the CEO.

people.name: Ami Shah
people.bio: Ami Shah is Company Secretary and a key managerial person, as listed in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: Pankaj Gandhi re-appointed Whole-time Director for five years from 7 Sep 2026. Rajesh Kaul joined in July 2025 as Senior President of the Sparsh cluster; Rasik Kulkarni (SVP, Ferticare and Aesthaderm) left in June 2025. No KMP changes found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founder Habil Khorakiwala is Executive Chairman; his sons Murtaza (MD) and Huzaifa (Executive Director) sit on the board, and his daughter Zahabiya, a non-executive director, became Executive Co-chairperson of the Swiss subsidiary Wockhardt Bio AG in May 2026 to lead US sales of the new antibiotics. The family holds 49.1%, almost all through trusts.

people.name: Dr. Habil Khorakiwala
people.since: Founder; re-appointed Executive Chairman for five years from March 2025
people.relation: Founder; father of Murtaza, Huzaifa and Zahabiya Khorakiwala
people.stake: 0.37% directly (FY26 annual report); family and its trusts together 49.09%
people.bio: Habil Khorakiwala founded Wockhardt and is an alumnus of Purdue University and Harvard Business School; Purdue later gave him an honorary doctorate. Nearly three decades ago he chose to keep funding antibiotic discovery when most of the industry had left it, and Wockhardt says it has since spent over US$800 million on research. That effort produced Zaynich, which the company calls the first new drug fully discovered and developed in India to win US FDA approval. He is a former President of FICCI, chairs the FICCI Life Sciences Council and was Chancellor of Jamia Hamdard University. Shareholders are asked to approve pay of up to ₹10cr a year from March 2027, within a ₹15cr ceiling.

people.name: Dr. Murtaza Khorakiwala
people.relation: Son of the Executive Chairman; brother of Huzaifa and Zahabiya
people.bio: Murtaza Khorakiwala has been Managing Director since April 2009. He is a medical graduate from GS Medical College, Mumbai, and has an MBA from the University of Illinois in the US. He runs the company day to day and fronts its investor calls. He was President of the Bombay Management Association in 2018 and of ICC India in 2020-21.

people.name: Dr. Huzaifa Khorakiwala
people.relation: Son of the Executive Chairman; brother of Murtaza and Zahabiya
people.bio: Huzaifa Khorakiwala joined Wockhardt in July 1996 and has led several of its businesses; he has been an Executive Director since April 2009. He holds a master's in business management from the Yale School of Management. He is also Trustee and CEO of the Wockhardt Foundation, whose Mobile 1000 programme runs 200 mobile clinics in rural India. His 'Dr.' title comes from honorary doctorates.

people.name: Deepak R. Madnani
people.bio: Deepak Madnani became CFO in June 2022 after more than a decade in finance leadership roles at Wockhardt. He is a commerce graduate with a master's degree in financial management. Before Wockhardt he worked in finance at Lifestyle Retail and Spencer's. He has about 22 years of experience in financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow, audit and compliance.

people.name: Dr. Mahesh V. Patel
people.role: Chief Scientific Officer, New Drug Discovery
people.bio: Mahesh Patel heads Wockhardt's new-drug research, the source of its six novel antibiotics including Zaynich. He has a PhD from the University of Bombay and did postdoctoral work at the US National Institutes of Health. He worked at Ranbaxy Research Laboratories and Hoechst India before joining Wockhardt in May 1998.

people.name: Annapurna Das
people.role: President, India Business & NCE Emerging Markets
people.bio: Annapurna Das runs the India business and the launch of Wockhardt's new antibiotics in emerging markets. She has 27 years of experience in emerging markets, with senior roles at MSD, GSK, Sanofi and Takeda.

people.name: Rashmi Mamtura
people.bio: Rashmi Mamtura is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and one of the company's key managerial personnel, as listed in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: Dr. Sanjeev Kumar Sharma, President - Manufacturing, Quality & R&D, resigned on 2 Feb 2026 for personal reasons. Zahabiya Khorakiwala named Executive Co-chairperson of Wockhardt Bio AG from 4 May 2026 at US$250,000 a year (needs shareholder approval as a related-party role).

companies.styleNote: The founder, the late Vijay Batra, died in 2020-21 and his sons now run it: Rahul Batra is Chairman and MD and his brother Varun is Joint MD. Most of the stake sits with promoter Mrs. Neeraj Batra (63.9%); the brothers hold under 0.5% each. Promoters own about 59% on the latest pattern.

people.name: Rahul Batra
people.since: Whole-time Director since 2015; CMD since January 2021
people.relation: Son of founder Vijay Batra; brother of Joint MD Varun Batra
people.bio: Rahul Batra became Chairman and MD in January 2021 after the sudden death of his father, founder Vijay Kumar Batra; he had been a whole-time director since February 2015. He holds a Master of Science in business and management from the University of Strathclyde in Scotland. He runs marketing and sales. He is also a director of the group companies Adley Formulations, Adley Lab and BT Associates. He was paid ₹1.51cr in FY26.

people.name: Varun Batra
people.since: Whole-time Director since 2015; Joint MD since January 2021
people.relation: Son of founder Vijay Batra; brother of the Chairman & MD
people.bio: Varun Batra became Joint MD in January 2021, having been a whole-time director since February 2015. He holds a degree in business management from Toronto, Canada. He is responsible for production and export sales. He is also a director of Adley Formulations, Adley Lab and BT Associates, and was paid ₹1.51cr in FY26.

people.name: Balwant Singh
people.relation: Not related to the other directors
people.bio: Balwant Singh is a whole-time director and has been on the board since at least 2021. The annual reports do not give his background. He was paid ₹32.9 lakh in FY26.

people.name: Ashutosh Shukla
people.relation: Not related to the other directors
people.bio: Ashutosh Shukla, 48, joined the board as a whole-time director in January 2022 and has worked at Beta for about seven years. He has more than 25 years of sales and marketing experience at pharmaceutical companies and an Executive MBA from the Symbiosis Institute of Business Management. The 2026 AGM is asked to re-appoint him for five years from January 2027.

people.name: Nipun Arora
people.bio: Nipun Arora is CFO and is listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report. The report does not give his background.

people.name: Rajni Brar
people.bio: Rajni Brar is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and a key managerial person, as listed in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: No board changes in FY26. The AGM notice of 3 Sep 2026 proposes re-appointing Ashutosh Shukla as whole-time director for 2027-2032. No executive exits found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Promoter Anil Kumar Karusala is Chairman and MD and his wife Vijitha Gorrepati is a whole-time director. Kunal Kakumanu, grandson of the MD's mother Aruna Karusala, joined as an executive director in August 2026, when Aruna left the board. A hired CEO runs the plants. Promoters own about 51%.

people.name: Anil Kumar Karusala
people.relation: Promoter; son of Aruna Karusala; husband of Vijitha Gorrepati
people.bio: Anil Kumar Karusala is a promoter and has been Chairman and MD since joining the board in November 2021. He has more than 31 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, mainly in manufacturing and commercial operations. He won a national MSME award for outstanding entrepreneurship in 2009. Under him the company bought Australia's Noumed Pharmaceuticals in 2025 and listed through an IPO in March 2026. He is being re-appointed MD for three years from January 2027.

people.name: Vijitha Gorrepati
people.relation: Wife of the Chairman & MD; daughter-in-law of Aruna Karusala
people.bio: Vijitha Gorrepati is a promoter and the largest individual shareholder. She has a commerce degree from Andhra University and more than 14 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, working on operations and business development. She is also an independent director of Phyto Chem (India) Ltd. She is being re-appointed for three years from January 2027.

people.name: Kunal Kakumanu
people.relation: Grandson of promoter Aruna Karusala
people.bio: Kunal Kakumanu joined the board as an executive director on 11 August 2026 for three years. He has a law degree (LL.B.) from the University of Delhi and a BA (Honours) in political science. He has about three years of experience in corporate and commercial law and has appeared before the High Courts, NCLT, ITAT and arbitration tribunals.

people.name: D.B. Venkoji Prakash
people.bio: Venkoji Prakash became CEO in August 2025. He holds a B.Pharm, an MBA and a PGDBAM. He came from Stanex Drugs & Chemicals and earlier worked at Concord Drugs, Nectar Laboratories and Vista Pharmaceuticals. He oversees manufacturing, production planning, quality, product development and regulatory compliance.

people.name: Anil Kumar
people.relation: Not the same person as the MD
people.bio: Anil Kumar became CFO in September 2025, replacing Sanjay Kandhari. He is a cost accountant (ICWAI) with about 28 years in finance. He came from Innovare Labs and has worked at Laurus Labs and Neuland Laboratories. He handles planning, budgeting, capital allocation and internal controls.

people.name: Gurumoorthy Kamma
people.bio: Gurumoorthy Kamma joined in July 2025 to run quality assurance and regulatory compliance. He holds an M.Sc. and has about 16 years of experience at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, Medreich and Aurobindo Pharma, which he joined from.

people.name: Mark Thulborne
people.bio: Mark Thulborne runs Noumed Pharmaceuticals, the Australian subsidiary bought in 2025, and is named in the annual report as part of the business leadership.

companies.changes: Aruna Karusala (promoter, MD's mother) resigned as a non-executive director on 11 Aug 2026. Company Secretary Shivali Aggarwal resigned, leaving by 12 Oct 2026. Kunal Kakumanu appointed Executive Director on 11 Aug 2026. CFO Sanjay Kandhari left in Sep 2025.

companies.styleNote: The French parent Sanofi (with Hoechst) owns 60.4% and places its own managers here; there is no family. The MD, Deepak Arora, is a Sanofi group executive, and two Sanofi executives (Eric Mansion and Vaibhav Karandikar) sit as non-executive directors. Rahul Bhatnagar became non-executive Chairman in April 2026. Top jobs have turned over fast: three MDs in 2025 and the CFO leaves on 30 Sep 2026.

people.name: Deepak Arora
people.relation: Sanofi group executive
people.bio: Deepak Arora became MD on 27 October 2025 for three years, and is also Sanofi's country lead and general manager for pharma in India. He has a bachelor's degree in botany and zoology from the University of Lucknow and an MBA from Indira Gandhi National Open University. He has more than 30 years in pharma sales, marketing and general management across North America, Europe, the Middle East and Africa. His last job before Sanofi was Country President of AstraZeneca in South Africa. The central government approved his appointment in April 2026.

people.name: Mahadev Gawade
people.relation: Not related to any director
people.bio: Mahadev Gawade joined the board in August 2025 for three years and runs the Goa plant, replacing the retiring Renee Amonkar. He has a bachelor's degree in pharmacy from Pune University and an MBA in operations management from ITM University. He has more than 20 years in pharma logistics and manufacturing, focused on efficiency and cost cutting, and was previously Production and OPEX Head at Sandoz India.

people.name: Sudipta Chakraborty
people.role: Executive Director & Head of Legal, India
people.bio: Sudipta Chakraborty, 44, became an executive director on 1 March 2026 for three years and leads the legal function. She graduated from the National Law School of India University, Bengaluru, in 2005 (BA LLB Hons). She has more than two decades of legal, compliance and tax experience across Asia-Pacific and China. Her last role was Vice President, Group Legal & Compliance at the Aditya Birla Group.

people.name: Haresh Vala
people.bio: Haresh Vala became Company Secretary and Compliance Officer in September 2025, replacing Arjun Thakkar. He is a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India.

companies.changes: CFO and Whole-time Director Rachid Ayari steps down on 30 Sep 2026 to move to another Sanofi role; a successor has not been named. Rodolfo Hrosz stepped down as MD in April 2025 (left the board Feb 2026); Rachid Ayari was interim MD from Jul to Oct 2025. Suresh Babu (Diabetes sales head) left in Feb 2026 and Debajit Roy replaced him in Jun 2026.

companies.styleNote: Chairman Suresh Kare, who has led the company for decades, is now non-executive. His daughter Aditi Panandikar is MD, and long-time executive Sundeep Bambolkar is Joint MD. Another daughter, Madhura Kare, holds a paid position in the company (₹61 lakh in FY26). The Kare family, its trust and holding companies own 58.9%.

people.name: Aditi Kare Panandikar
people.since: MD since February 2022; re-appointment proposed from February 2027
people.relation: Daughter of Chairman Suresh Kare; sister of Madhura Kare
people.bio: Aditi Panandikar has been MD since February 2022, having earlier run domestic marketing, the API business, HR, technical operations and business development. She is a pharmacy graduate with a master's in pharmaceutical administration from The Ohio State University and has studied patent law. Fortune India listed her among its 100 most powerful women in business in 2025 and 2026, and she is Honorary General Secretary of the Indian Drug Manufacturers' Association. The board has re-appointed her from February 2027, subject to a special resolution because the company had no profit in FY26.

people.name: Sundeep V. Bambolkar
people.since: With the group since 1982; Joint MD since February 2012
people.relation: Not related to the promoters
people.bio: Sundeep Bambolkar joined the group in 1982 and has been Joint MD since February 2012. He has a science degree and an MBA from Mumbai University, a diploma in entrepreneurship management, and completed the ISB-Kellogg Global Advanced Management Programme. He has 40-plus years in finance, operations, purchase, projects and international business, and is responsible for formulation manufacturing, supply chain, finance and the international business. He won the CFO 100 'Winning Edge in Cost Management' award in 2011 and 2012.
