people.name: Pramod Ghorpade
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (President, Finance & Group CFO)
people.bio: Pramod Ghorpade is a chartered accountant and Indoco's Group CFO. Before Indoco he was India country CFO at the Teva group and held finance roles at Watson Pharmaceuticals, including Controller for India.

people.name: Dr. Kavita Inamdar
people.bio: Dr. Kavita Inamdar is Chief Technical Officer and is listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report. Her remit matters as the Goa sterile plants await a US FDA re-inspection.

people.name: Rajesh Usgaonker
people.bio: Rajesh Usgaonker heads Indian sales and marketing, taking over from Ajay Karajagi, who retired in November 2025. He is listed as senior management in the FY26 annual report.

people.name: Ramanathan Hariharan
people.bio: Ramanathan Hariharan is Company Secretary, Compliance Officer and Head of Legal, and a key managerial person.

companies.changes: Ajay Karajagi (President, Sales & Marketing) retired on 30 Nov 2025. Sudhir Kadam joined as Senior Vice President, Human Capital, on 28 Jul 2026. Aditi Panandikar re-appointed MD from 15 Feb 2027, subject to shareholder approval. In FY26 the Kare family moved shares into a new Kare Family Private Trust (14.2%).

companies.styleNote: The Dhanuka group bought Orchid out of insolvency and runs it. Manish Dhanuka is MD and Mridul Dhanuka is Whole-time Director. Dhanuka group founder Ram Gopal Agarwal is non-executive Chairman, and promoter Arjun Dhanuka (4.8%) is a non-executive director. The annual report says the board members are not relatives of each other under company law. Dhanuka Laboratories, the promoters' own company, merged into Orchid on 10 July 2026. The promoter group owns about 69.8%.

people.name: Manish Dhanuka
people.relation: Promoter (Dhanuka group)
people.stake: 10.94% (FY26 annual report, including shares allotted under the Dhanuka Laboratories merger); promoter group about 69.8%
people.bio: Manish Dhanuka is Orchid's Managing Director. He has a B.Tech in chemical engineering from IIT Delhi and an MS in chemical engineering from the University of Akron in the US. He has more than 30 years of experience in pharmaceutical research, operations, commercial, marketing and finance. In his FY26 letter he framed the July 2026 merger of the promoters' Dhanuka Laboratories into Orchid as giving the company control of its chain from starting materials to finished sterile medicine. His personal guarantee backs part of the working-capital loans. The FY25 annual report said he held no Orchid shares directly; his stake came through the merger.

people.name: Mridul Dhanuka
people.relation: Promoter group (Dhanuka family)
people.stake: 0.54% via Mridul Dhanuka HUF (FY26 annual report)
people.bio: Mridul Dhanuka is a chemical engineer with an MBA and has been with the Dhanuka group since 2005. The company credits him with expanding the group's production capacity, building a new manufacturing plant and reorganising the supply chain from buying to selling. He is described as the driving force behind the company's new business line.

people.name: Sunil Kumar Gupta
people.bio: Sunil Kumar Gupta is CFO and a key managerial person, and signs the financial statements with the MD. The annual reports do not give his background.

people.name: Kapil Dayya
people.bio: Kapil Dayya is Company Secretary and Compliance Officer and a key managerial person, as listed in the FY26 annual report.

companies.changes: No director or KMP changes found in FY26 or since the annual report. The Dhanuka Laboratories merger took effect on 10 July 2026, raising the promoters' direct holdings.

companies.styleNote: China's Fosun Pharma controls the company through Fosun Pharma Industrial Pte, which owns 51.8% (June 2026). Fosun sits on the board only through non-executive directors; the business is run by hired managers, led by Executive Chairman Srinivas Sadu. The founding Raju/Penmetsa family no longer runs it.

people.name: Srinivas Sadu
people.bio: Holds a master's in industrial pharmacy from Long Island University (New York), an MBA from the University of Maryland, and a postgraduate certificate in finance and management from the London School of Business and Finance. Before Gland he was a product manager and business lead at Natco Pharma and a product manager in consumer health at SmithKline Beecham. He joined Gland in 2000, became Chief Operating Officer in 2011 and Managing Director & CEO in 2019, and moved up to Executive Chairman in January 2025. He has worked on business development, manufacturing, supply chain and strategy for over two decades, and is the long-serving face of the company to investors.

people.name: Deepak Sapra
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from the Indian Railways Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Jamalpur, with a management degree from IIM Bangalore; he was a Chevening Scholar at the University of Bradford and a Fulbright Fellow at Carnegie Mellon. He has about 27 years of executive experience, over 23 of them in pharma. Most recently he was CEO of API and Services at Dr. Reddy's Laboratories, running a business-to-business unit spanning generics, contract manufacturing (CDMO) and active ingredients, and sat on the board of Aurigene Pharma Services. He fills the CEO seat left empty since the previous CEO left at the end of April 2026.

people.name: Ravi Shekhar Mitra
people.bio: A qualified chartered accountant and company secretary who also completed the General Management Program at the Wharton School. He has more than 20 years of experience in financial management, planning, strategy and investor relations in pharma and related industries. He joined Gland as CFO in 2019, a year before its 2020 stock-market listing, and has stayed in the role since.

companies.changes: CEO Shyamakant Giri resigned in Feb 2026 and left on 30 Apr 2026; Deepak Sapra (ex-Dr. Reddy's) was named CEO in Aug 2026 and joins on 16 Nov 2026. COO Satnam Singh Loomba retired on 31 Mar 2026.

companies.styleNote: A family business: founder Ashok Kumar Windlass is a whole-time director and his sons Hitesh (MD) and Manoj (Joint MD) run the company, alongside a hired CEO & CFO, Komal Gupta. Hitesh's wife Prachi Jain Windlass is a non-executive director. The board chairman, Vivek Dhariwal, is independent. Promoters own 63.3% (June 2026), mostly through the AKW WBL Family Private Trust (40.6%).

people.name: Hitesh Windlass
people.relation: Son of founder Ashok Kumar Windlass; brother of Joint MD Manoj Kumar Windlass; husband of director Prachi Jain Windlass
people.stake: Under 0.01% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); family and family trust together 63.3%
people.bio: Worked as a process engineer at Intel Corporation in the US before joining the family business. He has about 18 years of management experience at Windlas. He set up the domestic trade-generics, over-the-counter brands and export businesses, and drives technical operations, quality, manufacturing and financial strategy. The board re-appointed him MD from 30 April 2025 for five years.

people.name: Manoj Kumar Windlass
people.relation: Son of founder Ashok Kumar Windlass; brother of MD Hitesh Windlass
people.stake: Under 0.01% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); family and family trust together 63.3%
people.bio: Has over 20 years of experience in product development, operations, procurement and portfolio management. He set up the contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) services and products division, which is the company's main business. The board re-appointed him Joint MD from 30 April 2025 for five years.

people.name: Ashok Kumar Windlass
people.relation: Founder; father of Hitesh and Manoj Kumar Windlass
people.stake: 21.3% (June 2026 shareholding pattern); family and family trust together 63.3%
people.bio: The founder and promoter of the company. He oversees administration, legal matters and engineering. He is a former chairman of the Confederation of Indian Industry's Uttarakhand State Council and received the Uttarakhand Ratan award in 2018. He is also a director of group companies Windlas Exports and Ashok Vimla Trusteeship Services, the trustee of the family trust that holds the largest block of shares. Shareholders approved his re-appointment as whole-time director from 3 May 2026.

people.name: Komal Gupta
people.role: Chief Executive Officer & Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: A chartered accountant, company secretary and cost accountant with nearly 20 years in strategy, finance, operations and supply chain. Before Windlas she worked at the Anand Automotive group (Perfect Circle India, Anand Automotive Systems) and at DSM Sinochem Pharmaceuticals India. She joined Windlas as CFO and was promoted to CEO in February 2023 after more than seven years with the company, keeping the CFO job as well. She was named CII Young CFO of the Year in 2023 and is on the CFO100 Roll of Honour for 2025.

people.name: Pawan Kumar Sharma
people.bio: Has more than 25 years of experience in the pharma industry. As executive director he manages the company's legal, commercial and administrative work. He holds no directorship or full-time role in any other company.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. Komal Gupta has held both the CEO and CFO jobs since Feb 2023; the company said then it would hire a separate CFO, but has not named one.

companies.styleNote: Founder Dr. D. R. Rao is Executive Chairman and his two sons run the company: Saharsh is CEO & MD (since spring 2026) and Sucheth is Executive Vice Chairman. The CFO and other function heads are hired professionals. Promoters own about 32.6% (June 2026), mostly through the Davuluri Ownership Trust (26.0%), whose trustees are the father and both sons.

people.name: Dr. Davuluri Rama Mohan Rao
people.relation: Founder; father of Sucheth and Saharsh Davuluri
people.stake: 1.6% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); also a trustee of the Davuluri Ownership Trust (26.0%); family together about 32.6%
people.bio: Holds a master's in science from Andhra University, a postgraduate diploma in technology from IIT Kharagpur and a PhD in organic chemistry from the University of Notre Dame (US). He held senior research, production and quality roles at Glaxo India and was later director of R&D and quality at another drug company. He founded Neuland in 1984. He is a member of the Royal Society of Chemistry.

people.name: Davuluri Saharsh Rao
people.relation: Son of the Executive Chairman; younger brother of Executive Vice Chairman Sucheth
people.stake: 1.5% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); also a trustee of the Davuluri Ownership Trust (26.0%)
people.bio: An electrical engineering graduate with a master's in management information systems from the Weatherhead School of Management (Cleveland) and an MBA from the University of North Carolina. He worked in sales roles at Sify before joining Neuland in 2007. He started the custom manufacturing (contract work for innovators) business, which is now the company's largest, and oversaw marketing, IT, business development and R&D. He took over as CEO & MD in 2026, saying the aim is to be one of the world's top five ingredient-focused CDMOs within a decade.

people.name: Davuluri Sucheth Rao
people.relation: Son of the Executive Chairman; elder brother of CEO & MD Saharsh
people.stake: 2.0% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); also a trustee of the Davuluri Ownership Trust (26.0%)
people.bio: A mechanical engineer with an MBA in corporate finance and operations from the University of Notre Dame's Mendoza College of Business, and a Six Sigma Black Belt. He joined in 2002 and was chief executive from 2009 until March 2026, when he handed the role to his brother and became Executive Vice Chairman. He is on the board of the US industry body DCAT (third vice president for 2026) and is an executive member of YPO's Hyderabad chapter.

people.name: Abhijit Majumdar
people.bio: A chartered accountant and cost accountant with more than 30 years in finance. He worked at Asian Paints PPG, Berger Paints and Tata Steel, and his last job before Neuland was EVP, financial planning and controlling, at Deepak Fertilizers and Petrochemicals. His areas are accounting, working capital, tax and mergers. The board appointed him CFO in November 2022.

people.name: Dr. Sharadsrikar Venkatesan Kotturi
people.bio: Has BSc (Tech) and MSc (Tech) degrees from UDCT Bombay and a PhD from Oklahoma State University (2002), followed by medicinal chemistry research at the Research Triangle Institute in North Carolina. He has about 20 years in drug research. Before Neuland he was Senior Vice President, Operations at Piramal Pharma and held roles at GVK Bio and Tata's Advinus. He has authored more than 35 patents.

people.name: Parag Dilip Deshmukh
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Mumbai University with an MBA in human resources from IMT Ghaziabad. He has more than 24 years in active-ingredient manufacturing at Lupin, Aurobindo and Cipla, where he ran two plants. He joined Neuland in March 2025 to run its plants, focusing on efficiency and regulatory compliance.

companies.changes: Saharsh Davuluri took over as CEO & MD from his brother Sucheth in spring 2026 (announced early April); Sucheth became Executive Vice Chairman. No other executive departures found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Founder-run: the three co-founders from 2006 hold the top jobs. Ajay Bhardwaj is Chairman, MD & CEO; Dr. Ganesh Sambasivam (science) and K. C. Ravindra (operations) are whole-time directors. Ajay's son Ishaan is President. The four promoters and their families own about 71.4% (June 2026), down from 74.7% in March after promoter Aruna Ganesh sold 3.05%. True North has a nominee director.

people.name: Ajay Bhardwaj
people.relation: Co-founder; father of President Ishaan Bhardwaj
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in chemical engineering from IIT Delhi and a master's in chemical engineering from Louisiana State University. He started as a projects engineer at Max India and later was president of marketing and technical services at Biocon. He co-founded Anthem in 2006 with two Biocon/Syngene colleagues and has run it since, building a research-to-manufacturing contract business with unusually high margins. He has over 40 years in life sciences, contract research and drug manufacturing, was an EY Entrepreneur of the Year 2025 finalist, and is a founder and trustee of Plaksha University.

people.name: Ishaan Bhardwaj
people.relation: Son of the Chairman, MD & CEO Ajay Bhardwaj
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in engineering from Visvesvaraya Technological University (Belgaum) and a master's from George Washington University. He first worked at Anthem from January 2014 to December 2016, spent time at group company Anthem Cellutions, and rejoined in February 2019. He oversees purchasing, regulatory affairs, biological R&D, manufacturing and operations. He is a named promoter; he was Vice President at the 2025 listing and is now President.

people.name: Dr. Ganesh Sambasivam
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter (not related to the Bhardwajs)
people.bio: Has a BSc in chemistry from the University of Madras and an MSc in organic chemistry and a PhD in chemistry from the University of Pune. He spent more than a decade as Chief Scientific Officer of Syngene International before co-founding Anthem. He has over 30 years in process research and development and leads Anthem's science.

people.name: K. C. Ravindra (K Ravindra Chandrappa)
people.relation: Co-founder and promoter (not related to the Bhardwajs)
people.stake: 7.8% directly, plus about 2% through two family trusts he is trustee of (June 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Bangalore University. Before co-founding Anthem he worked at Cipla, Hikal and Biocon. He leads end-to-end operations: R&D, manufacturing, quality and regulatory compliance. He has more than 25 years in the pharma and biopharma industry, with a focus on running large plants to global quality standards.

people.name: Mohammed Gawir Baig
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from IIT Kharagpur with a postgraduate diploma in management from IIM Bangalore. He was a director at the investment bank O3 Capital, and earlier worked at Kea Healthcare and as a relationship manager at Standard Chartered Bank. He joined Anthem in November 2021 and led it through its July 2025 listing. Besides finance he handles planning, investor relations, ESG, HR, legal and compliance.

companies.changes: No executive changes found since the annual report. Promoter Aruna Ganesh sold her 3.05% in June 2026.

companies.styleNote: A father-and-son company: Dr. K. Ranga Raju, with the company since 1999, is executive Chairman, and his son Krishna Kanumuri is MD & CEO. The long-serving CFO, Siva Chittor, is a hired professional and also a whole-time director. The Kanumuri/Gokaraju promoter group owns about 34.5% (June 2026), mostly through family partnership firms; private-equity firm TPG is a large shareholder with a board nominee.

people.name: Krishna Kanumuri (Krishnam Raju Kanumuri)
people.since: Joined May 2004; re-appointed MD & CEO to Aug 2030
people.relation: Son of Chairman Dr. K. Ranga Raju
people.stake: 1.4% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 34.5%
people.bio: A chemical engineer from Manipal University with an MBA from the University of Kansas; he also attended the London School of Economics' 1995 summer school in financial markets. He worked at the telecom companies Sprint and Telmex before joining Sai in May 2004. As CEO he has built Sai into an integrated drug discovery, development and manufacturing partner for big pharma and biotech, including its dedicated-team model for large customers. He was re-appointed MD & CEO for five years from 1 September 2025.

people.name: Dr. K. Ranga Raju (Kanumuri Ranga Raju)
people.relation: Promoter; father of MD & CEO Krishna Kanumuri
people.stake: 0.1% directly; controls further shares as partner of two family firms, Sunflower Partners (7.4%) and Lily Partners (3.3%) (June 2026 shareholding pattern)
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in pharmacy from the University of Mysore, and bachelor's, master's and doctorate degrees in pharmacy from the Massachusetts College of Pharmacy, Boston. He has more than 40 years in the pharma industry and has been with Sai since it started in 1999, shaping its direction. He earlier sat on the board of Chemrich Fine Chemicals, a promoter-group company.

people.name: Sivaramakrishnan (Siva) Chittor
people.bio: A chartered accountant, cost accountant and qualified company secretary with more than 30 years of experience. He was administrative director and controller at IMRglobal (later CGI Information Systems & Management Consultants) and then senior vice president of shared services at Zavata. He joined Sai in January 2009 as senior vice president and head of finance, became CFO, and now also sits on the board as a whole-time director. His strengths are outsourcing, mergers and integration, restructuring and financial controls, and he was CFO through the December 2024 listing.

people.name: Dr. John Pavey
people.role: Senior Vice President & Head of Global Process R&D
people.bio: Holds a chemistry degree from the University of Oxford and a PhD in organic chemistry from the University of Liverpool, followed by postdoctoral research at the University of Cambridge. He has over 20 years in chemical development at Johnson & Johnson, UCB and AstraZeneca, taking active ingredients from discovery to commercial supply, including oligonucleotides, antibody-drug conjugates and peptides. He took over Sai's global process R&D on 1 April 2026 from the retiring Dr. Dean Edney.

companies.changes: Dr. John Pavey became head of global process R&D (senior management) on 1 Apr 2026, replacing Dr. Dean David Edney, who retired. No MD, CEO or CFO changes.

companies.styleNote: Run by its founders, the brothers Sanjeev Jain and Sandeep Jain, who are joint managing directors. A hired whole-time director runs operations and a hired CFO runs finance. The promoters own about 75.3% (June 2026): 17.2% each directly and 40.8% through the Akums Master Trust, of which the two brothers are trustees. Quadria Capital has a non-executive director.

people.name: Sanjeev Jain
people.relation: Co-founder; elder brother of Sandeep Jain
people.stake: 17.2% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); also trustee of the Akums Master Trust (40.8%); family together about 75.3%
people.bio: Started in business in 1984 with his brother, running a small wholesale medicine shop in Old Delhi with ₹1.5 lakh from their father. In 1994 the brothers set up their first plant at Bhiwadi, Rajasthan, and in 2004 they put their savings (and mortgaged their home) into a contract manufacturing plant in Haridwar, the start of Akums. He has about 40 years in pharma and handles the Delhi-side functions: purchasing, finance and marketing. He was named in Forbes India's DGEMS list in 2024 and received the India Pharma Leader award in 2018 and 2019.

people.name: Sandeep Jain
people.relation: Co-founder; younger brother of Sanjeev Jain
people.stake: 17.2% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); also trustee of the Akums Master Trust (40.8%)
people.bio: Holds a BCom from Delhi University (1987). He co-founded the family's medicine trading business in 1984 and Akums in 2004. He lives in Haridwar and oversees manufacturing and operations across the company's 14 plants. He has an honorary doctorate from Apex University, Jaipur, and has received the IDMA Quality Excellence Award and a national award from the Government of India.

people.name: Sanjay Sinha
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in pharmaceutical sciences from Ranchi University and a master's in pharmacy from the University of Delhi. Before Akums he was President of Operations (Formulations) at Ipca Laboratories and President of Operations at Famy Care, Ahmedabad. At Akums he runs plant operations and sits on the board as a whole-time director.

people.name: Sumeet Sood
people.bio: A chartered accountant with about 30 years in accounts and finance. He worked at Arthur Andersen, Hindustan Times, Amar Ujala Publications and Jubilant Life Sciences, and was group CFO of Crystal before joining Akums as CFO in February 2022. He took the company through its August 2024 stock-market listing and presents the results on earnings calls.

companies.changes: No executive changes found since the annual report.

companies.styleNote: Run by the founding brothers: Manoj Kumar Lohariwala is Chairman & Whole-time Director and Vinay Kumar Lohariwala is Managing Director. Both were re-appointed in May 2026 for another five years from March 2027. The promoters own about 50.9% (June 2026). A third founding partner of the original Innova partnership, Gian Parkash Aggarwal, is a large non-promoter shareholder.

people.name: Vinay Kumar Lohariwala
people.since: Founding partner (Innova partnership, 2006); MD, re-appointed to Mar 2032
people.relation: Promoter; brother of Chairman Manoj Kumar Lohariwala
people.bio: A mechanical engineer from Engineering College, Kota (University of Rajasthan). Before Innova he was vice-president, manufacturing at Pharmatech Health Care. In 2006 he co-founded the Innova Captab partnership with his brother and Gian Parkash Aggarwal; its business moved into the listed company in 2021. He has more than 20 years in making and marketing medicines and leads the company as MD.

people.name: Manoj Kumar Lohariwala
people.since: Founding partner (Innova partnership, 2006); re-appointed to Mar 2032
people.relation: Promoter; brother of MD Vinay Kumar Lohariwala
people.bio: Holds a BCom from Mohta College, Sadulpur (Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati University, Ajmer). Before Innova he was vice-president, marketing at Pharmatech Health Care. He co-founded the Innova Captab partnership in 2006 and has about 25–29 years in making and marketing medicines. He chairs the board as a whole-time (executive) director and is the largest individual shareholder.

people.name: Jayant Vasudeo Rao
people.bio: A chemistry graduate from the Arts, Science and Commerce College, Panvel (University of Bombay). He worked at Ebers Pharmaceuticals, Prophyla Biologicals and Lexicon Biotech, was production head at Scott-Edil Pharmacia and general manager (production and planning) at Brooks Laboratories. He has about 20 years in managing production of medicines and oversees manufacturing as a board member.

people.name: Lokesh Bhasin
people.bio: A cost and management accountant with a diploma in information systems security audit from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. He has about 20 years in corporate finance and accounts. As deputy CFO he worked on the company's December 2023 listing from start to finish, and he was promoted to CFO on 30 March 2024 after the previous CFO, Gaurav Srivastava, resigned for personal reasons.

companies.changes: No executive departures found since the annual report. In May 2026 the board re-appointed both founder brothers for 2027–2032 (subject to the AGM vote).

companies.styleNote: The Bhartia family controls it, but a hired CEO & MD, Deepak Jain (ex-Bain), has run it since October 2023. Co-founder Hari S. Bhartia stays involved as executive Co-Chairman & Whole-time Director; his brother Shyam S. Bhartia is non-executive Chairman, and Shyam's son Priyavrat and Hari's daughter Aashti are non-executive directors. Promoters own about 45.2% (June 2026), mostly through family trustee companies.

people.name: Deepak Jain
people.bio: A chemical engineer from IIT Delhi (silver medallist) with an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, where he was an industry scholar. He spent more than 18 years at Bain & Company, rising to senior partner leading its Asia-Pacific advanced manufacturing and services practice (autos, chemicals, cement), where he ran manufacturing and digital turnarounds and strategy programmes. He took over as CEO & MD on 1 October 2023 from Rajesh Kumar Srivastava. He is pushing the company towards specialty chemicals, nutrition and contract manufacturing.

people.name: Hari S. Bhartia
people.since: Co-founder of the Jubilant Bhartia Group
people.relation: Co-founder; brother of Chairman Shyam S. Bhartia; father of director Aashti Bhartia
people.stake: 0.2% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 45.2%
people.bio: A chemical engineer from IIT Delhi, which gave him its Distinguished Alumni award in 2000. With his brother Shyam he built the Jubilant Bhartia Group, which spans pharma, chemicals, food (Jubilant FoodWorks) and consumer businesses. He was President of the Confederation of Indian Industry in 2010–11 and has chaired the boards of IIM Raipur and IIT Kanpur. He is the only family member in an executive role at Ingrevia, and is also non-executive Co-Chairman of Jubilant Pharmova and Jubilant FoodWorks.

people.name: Vijay Kumar Srivastava
people.since: Joined Mar 2022; whole-time director since Nov 2024
people.bio: An IIT Kharagpur graduate with more than 25 years in manufacturing across petrochemicals, engineering polymers, agrochemicals and chemical intermediates. He began his career at UPL, spent many years at DuPont in India and abroad, and held leadership roles at Deepak Nitrite and SI Group. He joined Jubilant Ingrevia as President – Operations in March 2022 and joined the board as Chief of Operations & Whole-time Director on 1 November 2024 for five years.

people.name: Varun Gupta
people.bio: A chartered accountant (2005, all-India rank 43) who also completed an executive general management course at IIM Bangalore. After a short stint at Ernst & Young in risk advisory, he spent about 18 years at Unilever, starting as a management trainee at Hindustan Unilever and holding finance and commercial roles in India and abroad; his last job was head of finance for personal care, Unilever South Asia. He became CFO on 12 August 2024.

companies.changes: No executive changes since the annual report. During FY26 Arjun Shanker Bhartia left the board (Jul 2025) and his sister Aashti Bhartia joined as a non-executive director (Aug 2025).

companies.styleNote: A Bhartia family company run by the next generation: Priyavrat Bhartia (son of Chairman Shyam S. Bhartia) is MD and Arjun Shanker Bhartia (son of Co-Chairman Hari S. Bhartia) is Joint MD, both since June 2023. The founder brothers Shyam (Chairman) and Hari (Co-Chairman) are now non-executive promoter directors. Hired CEOs run the businesses, including Chris Preti at the US sterile-injectables CDMO. Promoters own about 47.7% (June 2026), mostly through family trustee companies.

people.name: Priyavrat Bhartia
people.since: MD since Jun 2023; on the board since May 2017
people.relation: Son of Chairman Shyam S. Bhartia; cousin of Joint MD Arjun Shanker Bhartia
people.stake: 0.9% directly (June 2026 shareholding pattern); promoter group together about 47.7%
people.bio: Holds a bachelor's in economics from Dartmouth College and an MBA from Stanford. He has about 26–29 years of industry experience, and joined the Jubilant Pharmova board as a non-executive director in May 2017. He became MD in June 2023, when his uncle Hari S. Bhartia stepped back, as part of a planned handover to the next generation. He also sits on the boards of Jubilant Ingrevia, Jubilant Industries and the family's media companies, including HT Media and Hindustan Media Ventures. Shareholders approved his continuation as MD by postal ballot in August 2026.

people.name: Arjun Shanker Bhartia
people.since: Joint MD since Jun 2023; on the board since May 2017
people.relation: Son of Co-Chairman Hari S. Bhartia; cousin of MD Priyavrat Bhartia
people.bio: A graduate of Brown University (2008) who began his career as an associate consultant at Bain & Company (2008–2010). He has about 18–19 years of industry experience and joined the board as a non-executive director in May 2017. He became Joint MD in June 2023 and is responsible for the overall management of the company under the board. He is also a director of family companies Jubilant Beverages, Jubilant Consumer and Jubilant Enpro. He was paid ₹75m in FY26, and shareholders approved his continuation in August 2026.

people.name: Ashish Mukkirwar
people.bio: Holds an MBA from IIM Calcutta and has over 20 years in corporate finance, capital markets, investor relations, mergers and strategy. He was Group Vice President & CFO of the global formulations business at Glenmark Pharmaceuticals, and earlier held senior roles in investment banking at Moelis & Company and UBS. He became CFO on 23 May 2026.

people.name: Chris Preti
people.since: President of Jubilant HollisterStier from Mar 2023
people.bio: Holds bachelor's and master's degrees in chemistry from Furman University, an MBA in international business from the University of South Carolina, and completed an executive leadership programme at Wharton. He spent about 25 years at GSK and HollisterStier Allergy in R&D, sales and marketing and operations, and was President of HollisterStier Allergy before taking over the contract manufacturing business in 2023. He leads the sterile fill-finish sites at Spokane and Montreal, including the $285m expansion with a third line and a fourth under construction. He was named a 2026 Person of Influence by the Spokane Journal of Business.

companies.changes: CFO Arun Kumar Sharma stepped down on 22 May 2026 to become adviser to the Chairmen; Ashish Mukkirwar took over on 23 May 2026. Earlier, in FY26, Group CFO and whole-time director Arvind Chokhany resigned (Sep 2025) and whole-time director Dr. Ramakrishnan Arul left the board (Aug 2025). Shareholders re-approved the MD and Joint MD in Aug 2026.
